All state lives in\n *         ContextGraphStorage (ERC-721 registry). This contract is replaceable via Hub.\n *\n * @dev The legacy `addBatchToContextGraph` attestation / inclusion-proof\n *      path is REMOVED (closes audit H2). Per-CG hosting committees and\n *      per-CG quorum were removed in SPEC_CG_MEMORY_MODEL: every CG is\n *      hosted by the sharding table at publish time, and the ACK quorum\n *      is the system parameter `parametersStorage.minimumRequiredSignatures()`.\n *      The only per-CG participant list is the EOA allow-list used for\n *      curated / PCA flows.\n *\n *      Publish authorization supports the three curator types encoded in\n *      ContextGraphStorage (see decision #22):\n *\n *        1. EOA    \u2014 publishAuthority = wallet, accountId = 0\n *                    Read path: direct address match against stored authority.\n *        2. Safe   \u2014 publishAuthority = multisig contract, accountId = 0\n *                    (Safe executes txs as msg.sender, so address equality\n *                    works transparently; ERC-1271 is not required here)\n *        3. PCA    \u2014 accountId = DKGPublishingConvictionNFT account id;\n *                    `publishAuthority` is a CREATE-TIME SNAPSHOT only.\n *                    Read path LIVE-RESOLVES `ownerOf(accountId)` and\n *                    accepts that owner or any registered agent of the\n *                    same account. The stored snapshot is IGNORED at read\n *                    time because it goes stale the moment the PCA NFT\n *                    transfers. Governance mutators (participant-agent\n *                    allow-list) similarly live-resolve via\n *                    `_isOwnerOrAuthority`, and agents are NOT granted\n *                    governance rights \u2014 only the NFT holder is.\n *                    (Closes Codex HIGH: PCA auth drift on NFT transfer.)\n *\n *      The NFT reference is resolved from the Hub on every authorization\n *      check so that a Phase 6 deployment made *after* the Phase 7 facade\n *      starts working without a facade redeployment.\n *\n *      N17 note: KAV10's current callsite still passes the recovered node\n *      signer wallet into `isAuthorizedPublisher`. That's a Phase 8 fix at\n *      the caller \u2014 this facade is responsible for the logic being correct\n *      when a correct principal is supplied.\n */\ncontract ContextGraphs is INamed, IVersioned, ContractStatus, IInitializable, ReentrancyGuard {\n    string private constant _NAME = \"ContextGraphs\";\n    string private constant _VERSION = \"10.0.4\";\n\n    ContextGraphStorage public contextGraphStorage;\n\n    // OT-RFC-53 \u2014 refs for the registration-deposit escrow. The deposit is\n    // pulled into the CSS vault at creation and credited to the staker reward\n    // pool (via EpochStorage) when consumed by publishing or swept by admin.\n    IERC20 public tokenContract;\n    ParametersStorage public parametersStorage;\n    ConvictionStakingStorage public convictionStakingStorage;\n    EpochStorage public epochStorage;\n    Chronos public chronos;\n\n    /// @notice Emitted when a CG registration deposit is pulled at creation.\n    event ContextGraphRegistrationDeposited(\n        uint256 indexed contextGraphId,\n        address indexed payer,\n        uint96 amount\n    );\n\n    /// @notice Emitted when an admin sweeps a CG's residual escrow to the pool.\n    event ContextGraphEscrowSwept(uint256 indexed contextGraphId, uint96 amount);\n\n    constructor(address hubAddress) ContractStatus(hubAddress) {}\n\n    function initialize() public onlyHub {\n        contextGraphStorage = ContextGraphStorage(\n            hub.getAssetStorageAddress(\"ContextGraphStorage\")\n        );\n        // OT-RFC-53 deposit stack \u2014 resolve EACH dependency through a tolerant,\n        // individually-catchable Hub lookup (`getContractAddress` reverts for an\n        // unregistered name). The feature is enabled ONLY when the WHOLE stack\n        // resolves; any missing dependency leaves every ref zero and the deposit\n        // disabled (createContextGraph guards on `parametersStorage != 0`). This\n        // keeps ContextGraphs deployable on partial fixtures/upgrades without\n        // declaring the economic stack as hard deploy dependencies, and avoids\n        // the prior bug where a `try` over only the first lookup let a later\n        // lookup (Token/CSS/Epoch/Chronos) revert uncaught.\n        address ps = _tryResolveContract(\"ParametersStorage\");\n        address tok = _tryResolveContract(\"Token\");\n        address css = _tryResolveContract(\"ConvictionStakingStorage\");\n        address es = _tryResolveContract(\"EpochStorageV8\");\n        address chr = _tryResolveContract(\"Chronos\");\n        if (ps != address(0) && tok != address(0) && css != address(0) && es != address(0) && chr != address(0)) {\n            parametersStorage = ParametersStorage(ps);\n            tokenContract = IERC20(tok);\n            convictionStakingStorage = ConvictionStakingStorage(css);\n            epochStorage = EpochStorage(es);\n            chronos = Chronos(chr);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Tolerant single-contract Hub lookup: returns address(0) instead of\n    ///      reverting when the name is unregistered. Used to resolve the\n    ///      OT-RFC-53 deposit stack so a partial deployment disables the feature\n    ///      rather than bricking initialize().\n    function _tryResolveContract(string memory contractName) internal view returns (address) {\n        try hub.getContractAddress(contractName) returns (address a) {\n            return a;\n        } catch {\n            return address(0);\n        }\n    }\n\n    function name() public pure virtual returns (string memory) {\n        return _NAME;\n    }\n\n    function version() external pure virtual returns (string memory) {\n        return _VERSION;\n    }\n\n    // --- Creation ---\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Create a new context graph. Mints an ERC-721 to msg.sender.\n     * @param participantAgents         EOA allow-list (no zeros, no dups)\n     * @param metadataBatchId           Batch ID describing the CG metadata (0 if none)\n     * @param accessPolicy              0 = public/discoverable, 1 = private/curated\n     * @param publishPolicy             0 = curated, 1 = open\n     * @param publishAuthority          Curator address (required when curated; ignored when open)\n     * @param publishAuthorityAccountId Non-zero -> PCA curator type. Requires curated. Ignored when open.\n     * @param nameHash                  OT-RFC-38 / LU-6 Phase B \u2014 opt-in stable wire\n     *                                  identifier the curator commits to (intended to be\n     *                                  `keccak256(bytes(cleartextId))` so hosting cores\n     *                                  can auto-subscribe to the SWM gossip topic on\n     *                                  receipt of `ContextGraphCreated`). Pass\n     *                                  `bytes32(0)` to opt out (host-mode discovery for\n     *                                  that CG then runs through the beacon path only).\n     * @return contextGraphId           Newly assigned context graph ID (= ERC-721 token ID)\n     *\n     * @dev Hosts and ACK quorum are network-level concerns: the sharding table\n     *      supplies hosts at publish time and `parametersStorage.minimumRequiredSignatures()`\n     *      sets the quorum. CGs do not declare a per-CG hosting committee.\n     */\n    function createContextGraph(\n        address[] calldata participantAgents,\n        uint256 metadataBatchId,\n        uint8 accessPolicy,\n        uint8 publishPolicy,\n        address publishAuthority,\n        uint256 publishAuthorityAccountId,\n        bytes32 nameHash\n    ) external nonReentrant returns (uint256 contextGraphId) {\n        // Storage validates sorting/dedup/zero-rejection, but a friendly\n        // default for curated CGs: if caller passes zero authority and the\n        // policy is curated, use msg.sender.\n        address authority = publishAuthority;\n        if (publishPolicy == 0 && authority == address(0)) {\n            authority = msg.sender;\n        }\n\n        // Coherence gate: when a PCA accountId is supplied, the claimed\n        // authority MUST equal the current owner of the NFT at that accountId.\n        // See _validatePCACoherence for rationale (closes \"silent broadening\"\n        // authorization vector where a mismatched pair stacks EOA + PCA\n        // curators on the same CG).\n        _validatePCACoherence(authority, publishAuthorityAccountId);\n\n        contextGraphId = contextGraphStorage.createContextGraph(\n            msg.sender,\n            participantAgents,\n            metadataBatchId,\n            accessPolicy,\n            publishPolicy,\n            authority,\n            publishAuthorityAccountId,\n            nameHash\n        );\n\n        // OT-RFC-53: anti-spam registration deposit, held as the CG's prepaid\n        // publishing escrow. Skipped when ParametersStorage is unresolved\n        // (deposit feature off) or the param is 0 (dormant default).\n        if (address(parametersStorage) != address(0)) {\n            uint96 deposit = parametersStorage.contextGraphRegistrationDeposit();\n            if (deposit > 0) {\n                _pullRegistrationDeposit(contextGraphId, deposit);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // OT-RFC-53 \u2014 registration-deposit pull + admin sweep\n    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    /// @dev Pulls the full `deposit` TRAC (GROSS) from the creator into the CSS\n    ///      vault and records it as the CG's escrow. No treasury fee is skimmed\n    ///      HERE (at deposit) \u2014 the deposit is escrowed gross. The protocol\n    ///      treasury fee is instead taken per-publish at CONSUME, on the escrow\n    ///      actually spent (`KnowledgeAssetsLifecycle._chargeEscrowTreasuryFee`),\n    ///      at parity with the wallet path's `_addTokens` \u2014 so escrow-funded\n    ///      publishing is not a fee loophole, and an unspent or admin-swept\n    ///      deposit owes no fee. The escrow is later spent on publishing or swept\n    ///      by admin \u2014 never cash-refunded.\n    function _pullRegistrationDeposit(uint256 contextGraphId, uint96 deposit) internal {\n        IERC20 token = tokenContract;\n        uint256 allowance = token.allowance(msg.sender, address(this));\n        if (allowance < deposit) {\n            revert TokenLib.TooLowAllowance(address(token), allowance, deposit);\n        }\n        if (token.balanceOf(msg.sender) < deposit) {\n            revert TokenLib.TooLowBalance(address(token), token.balanceOf(msg.sender), deposit);\n        }\n        // The deposit is escrowed GROSS in the CSS vault and tracked gross, so the\n        // consume path subtracts it directly from the gross publish cost (no\n        // net-vs-gross mismatch). Charging at consume \u2014 not deposit \u2014 keeps\n        // the fee on real publishing: an unspent or admin-swept deposit owes none.\n        if (!token.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(convictionStakingStorage), deposit)) {\n            revert TokenLib.TransferFailed();\n        }\n        contextGraphStorage.setRegistrationEscrow(contextGraphId, deposit);\n        emit ContextGraphRegistrationDeposited(contextGraphId, msg.sender, deposit);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Admin: RETIRE a CG and reclaim its residual registration escrow\n    ///         into the staker reward pool (current epoch). For abandoned / spam\n    ///         CGs whose deposit was never spent on publishing. Deactivation is\n    ///         ATOMIC with the sweep, so this can never silently drain an ACTIVE\n    ///         CG owner's prepaid publishing budget while leaving the CG live \u2014\n    ///         sweeping a CG is retiring it. The TRAC is already in the CSS vault,\n    ///         so this only deactivates, credits the epoch pool, and clears the\n    ///         per-CG accounting. Never refunds to the depositor.\n    function sweepContextGraphEscrow(uint256 contextGraphId) external onlyHubOwner {\n        // RandomSampling invariant (RS leaf-zeroing mandate, see RandomSampling.sol):\n        // retiring a CG must not strand its sampling weight. Settle the CG's leaf to\n        // its TRUE current value first \u2014 an abandoned/expired CG (this sweep's target)\n        // settles to 0, so any stale leaf is zeroed before deactivation. A CG that\n        // still holds LIVE value is REFUSED: deactivating a weighted CG strands its\n        // leaf, and past MAX_CG_RETRIES RandomSampling reverts challenge selection.\n        // Gated on the sampling stack being deployed \u2014 always true in production; a\n        // minimal deploy without CGWeightTreeStorage has no sampling weight to strand.\n        // Storages resolved at call time (admin-only path; no cached binding to stale).\n        if (hub.isContract(\"CGWeightTreeStorage\")) {\n            CGWeightTreeStorage(hub.getContractAddress(\"CGWeightTreeStorage\")).settle(contextGraphId);\n            if (\n                ContextGraphValueStorage(hub.getContractAddress(\"ContextGraphValueStorage\"))\n                    .getCurrentCGValue(contextGraphId) != 0\n            ) {\n                revert KnowledgeAssetsLib.InvalidContextGraphConfig(\"CG has live value\");\n            }\n        }\n        // Atomic retire-then-reclaim: deactivate first so a live CG's prepaid\n        // budget can't be drained out from under its owner while the CG stays\n        // active (otReviewAgent finding). An already-inactive CG is swept as-is.\n        if (contextGraphStorage.isContextGraphActive(contextGraphId)) {\n            contextGraphStorage.deactivateContextGraph(contextGraphId);\n        }\n        uint96 swept = contextGraphStorage.clearRegistrationEscrow(contextGraphId);\n        if (swept == 0) {\n            revert KnowledgeAssetsLib.InvalidContextGraphConfig(\"no escrow\");\n        }\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        epochStorage.addTokensToEpochRange(1, currentEpoch, currentEpoch, swept);\n        emit ContextGraphEscrowSwept(contextGraphId, swept);\n    }\n\n    // --- Governance (token-holder gated) ---\n\n    modifier onlyContextGraphOwner(uint256 contextGraphId) {\n        if (contextGraphStorage.getContextGraphOwner(contextGraphId) != msg.sender) {\n            revert KnowledgeAssetsLib.NotContextGraphOwner(contextGraphId, msg.sender);\n        }\n        _;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Allow the CG NFT holder OR the configured curator (EOA/Safe\n     *         direct address, or the LIVE PCA NFT owner) to mutate the\n     *         participant-agent allow-list.\n     *\n     * @dev For open-policy CGs `publishAuthority` is `address(0)` and the\n     *      stored accountId is 0, so only the owner branch can ever pass \u2014\n     *      the authority comparison is dead code in that case. This matches\n     *      the design: open CGs don't have curators, and agent allow-lists\n     *      only matter for curated flows.\n     *\n     *      In PCA curator mode (`publishAuthorityAccountId != 0`), the stored\n     *      `publishAuthority` is a write-time snapshot that goes STALE when\n     *      the PCA NFT transfers. We therefore live-resolve the current PCA\n     *      NFT owner via `IDKGPublishingConvictionNFT.ownerOf(accountId)`\n     *      instead of trusting the stored snapshot. This closes the Codex\n     *      HIGH \"PCA auth drift on NFT transfer\" finding, where the old PCA\n     *      owner would otherwise retain governance rights on the CG after\n     *      transferring the PCA.\n     *\n     *      PCA REGISTERED AGENTS are NOT granted governance rights through\n     *      this modifier \u2014 agents can publish on behalf of the PCA owner\n     *      (see `isAuthorizedPublisher`), but only the PCA NFT holder\n     *      themselves can mutate the CG's participant-agent allow-list.\n     *      Governance lives with the account, not with its operational\n     *      wallets.\n     */\n    modifier onlyContextGraphOwnerOrAuthority(uint256 contextGraphId) {\n        if (!_isOwnerOrAuthority(contextGraphId, msg.sender)) {\n            revert KnowledgeAssetsLib.NotContextGraphOwnerOrAuthority(contextGraphId, msg.sender);\n        }\n        _;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @dev Single source of truth for owner-or-authority governance checks.\n     *      Extracted from the modifier so the same branching logic can be\n     *      reused by future governance mutators without duplicating the\n     *      PCA live-resolve dance.\n     *\n     *      Returns true when any of the following is true:\n     *        1. `caller` is the current CG NFT token holder.\n     *        2. Curator mode is EOA/Safe (accountId == 0) AND `caller` is the\n     *           stored static authority.\n     *        3. Curator mode is PCA (accountId != 0) AND `caller` is the\n     *           LIVE current owner of the PCA NFT at `accountId`. The stored\n     *           `publishAuthority` is ignored in PCA mode \u2014 it's a\n     *           create-time snapshot that goes stale on PCA transfer.\n     *\n     *      Fail-closed behavior: if the DKGPublishingConvictionNFT contract\n     *      is not resolvable from the Hub, or `ownerOf(accountId)` reverts\n     *      (account burned or never minted), governance defaults to the CG\n     *      owner branch only.\n     */\n    function _isOwnerOrAuthority(\n        uint256 contextGraphId,\n        address caller\n    ) internal view returns (bool) {\n        if (contextGraphStorage.getContextGraphOwner(contextGraphId) == caller) {\n            return true;\n        }\n\n        uint256 accountId = contextGraphStorage.getPublishAuthorityAccountId(contextGraphId);\n\n        if (accountId == 0) {\n            // EOA / Safe curator: static stored authority is authoritative.\n            (, address authority) = contextGraphStorage.getPublishPolicy(contextGraphId);\n            return caller == authority;\n        }\n\n        // PCA curator: live-resolve current NFT owner. Stored authority is\n        // ignored \u2014 it's a stale-on-transfer snapshot. Agents are NOT\n        // granted governance rights; only the NFT holder is.\n        address nftAddr;\n        try hub.getContractAddress(\"DKGPublishingConvictionNFT\") returns (address addr) {\n            nftAddr = addr;\n        } catch {\n            return false;\n        }\n        if (nftAddr == address(0)) return false;\n\n        try IDKGPublishingConvictionNFT(nftAddr).ownerOf(accountId) returns (address currentOwner) {\n            return caller == currentOwner;\n        } catch {\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    function updatePublishPolicy(\n        uint256 contextGraphId,\n        uint8 publishPolicy,\n        address publishAuthority,\n        uint256 publishAuthorityAccountId\n    ) external onlyContextGraphOwner(contextGraphId) {\n        // Coherence gate (see _validatePCACoherence): if the new config\n        // switches to PCA mode, the authority must own the target NFT.\n        _validatePCACoherence(publishAuthority, publishAuthorityAccountId);\n\n        contextGraphStorage.updatePublishPolicy(\n            contextGraphId,\n            publishPolicy,\n            publishAuthority,\n            publishAuthorityAccountId\n        );\n    }\n\n    function updatePublishAuthority(\n        uint256 contextGraphId,\n        address newAuthority,\n        uint256 newAuthorityAccountId\n    ) external onlyContextGraphOwner(contextGraphId) {\n        // Coherence gate (see _validatePCACoherence): if the rotated\n        // authority carries a non-zero accountId, the new authority must\n        // own the target NFT.\n        _validatePCACoherence(newAuthority, newAuthorityAccountId);\n\n        contextGraphStorage.updatePublishAuthority(\n            contextGraphId,\n            newAuthority,\n            newAuthorityAccountId\n        );\n    }\n\n    function addParticipantAgent(\n        uint256 contextGraphId,\n        address agent\n    ) external onlyContextGraphOwnerOrAuthority(contextGraphId) {\n        contextGraphStorage.addParticipantAgent(contextGraphId, agent);\n    }\n\n    function removeParticipantAgent(\n        uint256 contextGraphId,\n        address agent\n    ) external onlyContextGraphOwnerOrAuthority(contextGraphId) {\n        contextGraphStorage.removeParticipantAgent(contextGraphId, agent);\n    }\n\n    // --- Publish authorization ---\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Check whether `publisher` is authorized to publish to a context graph.\n     *\n     * @dev Implements the 3-curator-type model per decision #22:\n     *\n     *      - Open CGs (publishPolicy == 1) allow any non-zero principal.\n     *      - Curated + EOA curator (accountId == 0): direct address equality\n     *        against the STORED `publishAuthority`. No ERC-1271 signature\n     *        check is required at this layer.\n     *      - Curated + PCA (accountId != 0): the stored `publishAuthority`\n     *        is a CREATE-TIME SNAPSHOT that goes STALE the moment the PCA\n     *        NFT transfers. The stored snapshot is therefore IGNORED for\n     *        authorization. Instead we LIVE-RESOLVE the current PCA NFT\n     *        owner via `IDKGPublishingConvictionNFT.ownerOf(accountId)` and\n     *        accept either (a) that live owner directly or (b) a registered\n     *        agent whose `agentToAccountId(publisher) == accountId`. Both\n     *        mappings on the NFT contract are cleared by the transfer hook,\n     *        so stale agent entries automatically stop authorizing.\n     *\n     *      Branch order is IMPORTANT. Because the EOA/Safe branch matches on\n     *      the stored authority snapshot, it MUST NOT run in PCA mode \u2014 an\n     *      unconditional direct-equality check before the accountId branch\n     *      would silently authorize a stale ex-owner. (Closes Codex HIGH\n     *      \"PCA auth drift on NFT transfer\": Alice creates a CG in PCA mode,\n     *      transfers the NFT to Bob, and the stored authority still reads\n     *      Alice. The pre-fix code returned true for Alice; the fix ignores\n     *      the snapshot in PCA mode and live-resolves ownerOf(accountId)\n     *      which now returns Bob.)\n     *\n     *      The DKGPublishingConvictionNFT reference is resolved on every call\n     *      via a `try/catch` on `hub.getContractAddress(\"DKGPublishingConvictionNFT\")`.\n     *      Hub's `getContractAddress` reverts with `ContractDoesNotExist` when\n     *      the contract is not registered (see UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.get),\n     *      so the catch branch handles gracefully-degraded environments where\n     *      Phase 6 has not been deployed yet. Using a fresh lookup each call\n     *      (rather than caching on `initialize()`) lets the PCA branch start\n     *      working without a facade redeployment once Phase 6 lands. Any\n     *      resolution failure in PCA mode yields `false` (fail-closed read\n     *      path \u2014 unlike the write path, which reverts).\n     *\n     *      View-only \u2014 no state mutations.\n     *\n     *      N17 note: the external signature intentionally takes the paying\n     *      principal as `publisher` rather than the recovered publisher-node\n     *      signer. The matching caller-side fix lives in `KnowledgeAssetsV10`\n     *      Phase 8 \u2014 `_executePublishCore` and `_executeUpdateCore` both pass\n     *      `msg.sender` here instead of the recovered node wallet.\n     */\n    function isAuthorizedPublisher(\n        uint256 contextGraphId,\n        address publisher\n    ) external view returns (bool) {\n        // 0. Bounds + liveness.\n        uint256 latestId = contextGraphStorage.getLatestContextGraphId();\n        if (contextGraphId == 0 || contextGraphId > latestId) return false;\n        if (!contextGraphStorage.isContextGraphActive(contextGraphId)) return false;\n\n        // 1. Open CGs authorize any non-zero principal.\n        (uint8 policy, address storedAuthority) = contextGraphStorage.getPublishPolicy(contextGraphId);\n        if (policy == 1) {\n            return publisher != address(0);\n        }\n\n        // 2. Curated: never authorize the zero address.\n        if (publisher == address(0)) return false;\n\n        // 3. Determine curator type from accountId FIRST \u2014 we must not run\n        //    the direct-equality branch in PCA mode because the stored\n        //    authority is a stale-on-transfer snapshot in that case.\n        uint256 authorityAccountId = contextGraphStorage.getPublishAuthorityAccountId(contextGraphId);\n\n        if (authorityAccountId == 0) {\n            // 3a. EOA / Safe curator: direct address match against the\n            //     stored authority. Storage auto-rotates this field on CG\n            //     NFT transfer, so it is always live for this mode.\n            return publisher == storedAuthority;\n        }\n\n        // 3b. PCA curator: IGNORE the stored authority snapshot entirely.\n        //     Live-resolve the NFT's current owner and accept it or any\n        //     registered agent of the same account. A missing / burned NFT\n        //     yields `false` (fail-closed read path).\n        address nftAddr;\n        try hub.getContractAddress(\"DKGPublishingConvictionNFT\") returns (address addr) {\n            nftAddr = addr;\n        } catch {\n            return false;\n        }\n        if (nftAddr == address(0)) return false;\n\n        // Live owner match \u2014 supersedes the stale stored authority.\n        try IDKGPublishingConvictionNFT(nftAddr).ownerOf(authorityAccountId) returns (address currentOwner) {\n            if (publisher == currentOwner) return true;\n        } catch {\n            // Account burned or never existed \u2014 refuse gracefully.\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Registered agent of the authorized account. `agentToAccountId`\n        // is cleared by the NFT's `_update` transfer hook, so stale agent\n        // entries automatically stop authorizing post-transfer.\n        uint256 publisherAccountId = IDKGPublishingConvictionNFT(nftAddr).agentToAccountId(publisher);\n        return publisherAccountId != 0 && publisherAccountId == authorityAccountId;\n    }\n\n    // --- KA registration (Phase 8 publish flow entry point) ---\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Bind a Knowledge Asset to a Context Graph via the facade.\n     * @dev Thin wrapper over `ContextGraphStorage.registerKnowledgeAssetToContextGraph`.\n     *      Exists so Phase 8's `KnowledgeAssetsV10.publish` / `publishDirect`\n     *      can call the facade (stable interface) instead of reaching into\n     *      storage directly. `onlyContracts`-gated at the facade layer so the\n     *      entry point has one canonical caller \u2014 the KA contract \u2014 and no\n     *      direct EOA call path.\n     */\n    function registerKnowledgeAsset(\n        uint256 contextGraphId,\n        uint256 kaId\n    ) external onlyContracts {\n        contextGraphStorage.registerKnowledgeAssetToContextGraph(contextGraphId, kaId);\n    }\n\n    // --- Internal: PCA coherence validation ---\n\n    /**\n     * @notice WRITE-TIME sanity check that a claimed (authority, accountId)\n     *         pair is initially coherent for a PCA-mode CG.\n     *\n     * @dev IMPORTANT: this is a CREATE-TIME SANITY GATE, NOT a drift-\n     *      prevention guarantee. The stored `publishAuthority` is a\n     *      snapshot that this check validates ONCE at write time so the\n     *      initial config is internally consistent \u2014 \"you claimed authority\n     *      X owns account Y; we verified X == ownerOf(Y) right now.\"\n     *\n     *      Drift AFTER write (e.g. Alice creates a CG in PCA mode, then\n     *      transfers the PCA NFT to Bob) is handled by LIVE RESOLVE at\n     *      read time in `isAuthorizedPublisher` and `_isOwnerOrAuthority`,\n     *      which IGNORE the stored snapshot in PCA mode and dereference\n     *      `ownerOf(accountId)` on every call. The stored snapshot is\n     *      retained only as a write-time audit trail and is NOT used for\n     *      authorization. (Codex HIGH: PCA auth drift on NFT transfer.)\n     *\n     *      Historical rationale (still valid): the pre-live-resolve design\n     *      ORed an EOA/Safe direct-authority branch with a PCA-agent\n     *      branch, so a mismatched pair \u2014 e.g. `publishAuthority = Alice`,\n     *      `accountId = 42` where account 42 is owned by Bob \u2014 would have\n     *      silently granted TWO curators to the same CG: Alice via the EOA\n     *      branch, Bob's agents via the PCA branch. The live-resolve fix\n     *      collapses the EOA branch out of PCA mode entirely, but the\n     *      write-time coherence check is still valuable because it catches\n     *      misconfigurations where the caller passes an authority that\n     *      does not match the NFT they claim. Without it, Alice could\n     *      create a CG with `(authority = Alice, accountId = Bob's)` and\n     *      the initial authorization surface would silently be \"whoever\n     *      owns Bob's NFT now\" rather than the more obvious \"Alice\". A\n     *      clear write-time revert keeps storage honest.\n     *\n     *      Fail-closed write-path behavior (stricter than read-path):\n     *        - If the NFT contract is not resolvable via Hub (not registered,\n     *          zero address, or Hub reverts), revert with `PCANotResolvable`.\n     *          Unlike `isAuthorizedPublisher`, which gracefully degrades on a\n     *          missing NFT, a write path that fails to resolve the NFT must\n     *          revert \u2014 otherwise it lets a PCA config land without validation.\n     *          Callers who want a non-PCA CG must pass accountId == 0 and use\n     *          EOA/Safe mode instead.\n     *        - If `ownerOf(accountId)` reverts (OZ's ERC721NonexistentToken),\n     *          revert with `PCAAccountDoesNotExist`.\n     *        - If the ownership check succeeds but the owner doesn't match the\n     *          claimed authority, revert with `PCAAuthorityMismatch`.\n     *\n     *      `accountId == 0` (non-PCA / EOA / Safe / open) skips the check\n     *      entirely \u2014 EOA/Safe modes use the stored authority verbatim at\n     *      read time and there is no PCA lookup to reconcile.\n     *\n     *      `authority == address(0)` also skips: it represents either the\n     *      open-policy state (where non-zero accountId is structurally\n     *      rejected by storage with a clear \"open policy\" message \u2014 we\n     *      don't want to shadow that with a PCA-specific error) or a\n     *      malformed curated state that storage's own zero-authority\n     *      guard will reject downstream. Either way, deferring to storage\n     *      gives the caller the clearer diagnostic.\n     */\n    function _validatePCACoherence(\n        address authority,\n        uint256 accountId\n    ) internal view {\n        if (accountId == 0 || authority == address(0)) return;\n\n        // Fresh Hub lookup each call (same pattern as isAuthorizedPublisher).\n        // Write paths fail closed: if we can't resolve the NFT, we refuse to\n        // store an un-validatable PCA config.\n        address nftAddr;\n        try hub.getContractAddress(\"DKGPublishingConvictionNFT\") returns (address addr) {\n            nftAddr = addr;\n        } catch {\n            revert KnowledgeAssetsLib.PCANotResolvable(accountId);\n        }\n        if (nftAddr == address(0)) {\n            revert KnowledgeAssetsLib.PCANotResolvable(accountId);\n        }\n\n        // ownerOf reverts for never-minted tokens (OZ ERC721NonexistentToken).\n        // Wrap in try/catch so we can distinguish \"no such account\" from\n        // a live ownership mismatch.\n        address actualOwner;\n        try IDKGPublishingConvictionNFT(nftAddr).ownerOf(accountId) returns (address owner_) {\n            actualOwner = owner_;\n        } catch {\n            revert KnowledgeAssetsLib.PCAAccountDoesNotExist(accountId);\n        }\n\n        if (actualOwner != authority) {\n            revert KnowledgeAssetsLib.PCAAuthorityMismatch(accountId, authority, actualOwner);\n        }\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0xbe0f8789818454a2ef6576dc5e6e37372a8ce3dba5210acc726b2830df46e593","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/Guardian.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\nimport {HubDependent} from \"./abstract/HubDependent.sol\";\nimport {ICustodian} from \"./interfaces/ICustodian.sol\";\nimport {IERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\n\ncontract Guardian is HubDependent {\n    event TokenTransferred(address indexed custodian, uint256 amount);\n    event MisplacedEtherWithdrawn(address indexed custodian, uint256 amount);\n    event MisplacedERC20Withdrawn(address indexed custodian, address tokenContract, uint256 amount);\n\n    error ZeroAddressCustodian();\n    error CustodianNotAContract(address custodian);\n    error CustodianWithoutOwnersFunction(address custodian);\n    error CustodianHasNoOwners(address custodian);\n    error TokenTransferFailed();\n    error EtherTransferFailed();\n    error InvalidTokenContract(address tokenContractAddress);\n\n    IERC20 public tokenContract;\n\n    // solhint-disable-next-line no-empty-blocks\n    constructor(address hubAddress) HubDependent(hubAddress) {}\n\n    function initialize() public virtual onlyHub {\n        tokenContract = IERC20(hub.getContractAddress(\"Token\"));\n    }\n\n    function transferTokens(address payable custodian) external onlyHub {\n        if (custodian == address(0)) {\n            revert ZeroAddressCustodian();\n        }\n\n        uint256 contractSize;\n        assembly {\n            contractSize := extcodesize(custodian)\n        }\n        if (contractSize == 0) {\n            revert CustodianNotAContract(custodian);\n        }\n\n        ICustodian custodianContract = ICustodian(custodian);\n        bool hasOwnersFunction = false;\n        try custodianContract.getOwners() returns (address[] memory owners) {\n            hasOwnersFunction = true;\n            if (owners.length == 0) {\n                revert CustodianHasNoOwners(custodian);\n            }\n        } catch {\n            // getOwners reverted (e.g. not ICustodian); hasOwnersFunction stays false.\n        }\n        if (!hasOwnersFunction) {\n            revert CustodianWithoutOwnersFunction(custodian);\n        }\n\n        uint256 balanceTransferred = tokenContract.balanceOf(address(this));\n        bool transactionResult = tokenContract.transfer(custodian, balanceTransferred);\n\n        if (!transactionResult) {\n            revert TokenTransferFailed();\n        }\n\n        emit TokenTransferred(custodian, balanceTransferred);\n    }\n\n    function withdrawMisplacedEther() external onlyHub {\n        uint256 balance = address(this).balance;\n        if (balance > 0) {\n            (bool success, ) = msg.sender.call{value: balance}(\"\");\n            if (!success) {\n                revert EtherTransferFailed();\n            }\n        }\n        emit MisplacedEtherWithdrawn(msg.sender, balance);\n    }\n\n    function withdrawMisplacedTokens(address tokenContractAddress) external onlyHub {\n        if (tokenContractAddress == address(tokenContract)) {\n            revert InvalidTokenContract(tokenContractAddress);\n        }\n        IERC20 misplacedTokensContract = IERC20(tokenContractAddress);\n\n        uint256 balance = misplacedTokensContract.balanceOf(address(this));\n        if (balance > 0) {\n            bool transactionResult = misplacedTokensContract.transfer(msg.sender, balance);\n            if (!transactionResult) {\n                revert TokenTransferFailed();\n            }\n        }\n        emit MisplacedERC20Withdrawn(msg.sender, tokenContractAddress, balance);\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x9b0a19e3128c41dfdf8bd8b4ad9f9d04e1636053b547892c1cb1874ae56cc5a3","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/KnowledgeAssetsLifecycle.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/ReentrancyGuard.sol\";\nimport {ECDSA} from \"solady/src/utils/ECDSA.sol\";\n\n/**\n * @title KnowledgeAssetsLifecycle\n * @notice V10 publish + update contract \u2014 wires together:\n *   - ContextGraphs facade (3 curator types, atomic KA\u2194CG bind)\n *   - ContextGraphStorage (direct read for `kaToContextGraph` on update)\n *   - ContextGraphValueStorage (per-CG value ledger for value-weighted challenges)\n *   - DKGPublishingConvictionNFT (publisher discount NFT; auto-resolves agent\u2192account)\n *   - DKGKnowledgeAssets (ERC-721, tokenId == kaId)\n *\n * Two public entry points (RFC-001 unified design):\n *   - `publish` \u2014 single entrypoint with two-branch cost coverage.\n *                 Auto-detects PCA discount via\n *                 `DKGPublishingConvictionNFT.agentToAccountId(msg.sender)`:\n *                 non-zero \u21d2 discount path (NFT covers cost; TRAC was\n *                 already distributed at `createAccount` time, so the\n *                 entrypoint MUST NOT call `_distributeTokens` here);\n *                 zero \u21d2 direct-spend path (`transferFrom(msg.sender, CSS,\n *                 fullCost)` + epoch-range distribution).\n *   - `update`  \u2014 same two-branch shape applied to delta payments. The\n *                 prior `publishDirect` / `updateDirect` entrypoints are\n *                 removed (no aliases retained \u2014 RFC-001 \u00a73.7).\n *\n * `_executePublishCore` runs: author attestation verification \u2192 ACK\n * signature verification \u2192 CG existence + auth \u2192 KAS create \u2192 atomic CG\n * value diff \u2192 per-node produced-value bookkeeping. No TRAC movement\n * happens in the core \u2014 the public entry branches on cost coverage.\n *\n * ACK digest prefix (H5 closure): `block.chainid || address(this)` pins a\n * signed ACK to this contract on this chain. Replay across chains / forks\n * / contract redeployments is rejected at signature verification.\n *\n * Author attestation (RFC-001 \u00a73.1): every publish carries a verified author\n * identity. The attestation is an EIP-712 typed-data signature over\n * `(contextGraphId, merkleRoot, authorAddress, schemeVersion)` under the\n * V10.1 domain. Verification dispatches at runtime on\n * `authorAddress.code.length` \u2014 EOAs use `ECDSA.tryRecover + equality`,\n * smart-contract wallets use `IERC1271.isValidSignature`. The\n * publisher-node signature surface is removed; `publisherNodeIdentityId`\n * is now a self-claimed attribution field (RFC-001 \u00a73.6).\n *\n * Authorization:\n *   - publish: N17 closure \u2014 `isAuthorizedPublisher(msg.sender)` via facade.\n *   - update:  enforced in `_executeUpdateCore` as owner-only \u2014 the\n *              EIP-712-attested author MUST equal `ownerOf(kaId)`, independent\n *              of CG publish policy. There is no curator/PCA delegation on the\n *              update path (delegation applies to publish only). To change who\n *              may update a KA, transfer the NFT (an owner may be an EOA, a\n *              Safe via EIP-1271 for N-of-M, or an EIP-7702-delegated EOA).\n *              This supersedes the initial V10 ERC-1155\n *              `balanceOf(msg.sender, kaRange) > 0` gate (which was hijackable\n *              via ERC-1155Delta token transfers) and the V9\n *              `latestPublisher == msg.sender` gate (which gated on\n *              node-operator key). See OT-RFC-45 (owner-only update authority).\n *\n *              Key loss is a single point of failure: owner-only gives no\n *              protocol-level recovery, so for any canonical / long-lived KA,\n *              mint to a Safe (or recovery-enabled EIP-1271 account) from the\n *              first publish \u2014 transferring the NFT cannot recover an\n *              already-lost key (OT-RFC-45 \u00a75.1).\n *\n * Byte-size ceiling (decision #4 closure): updates may GROW `newByteSize`\n * beyond the original value, as long as the new `tokenAmount` covers the new\n * size \u00d7 remaining lifetime at the current stake-weighted ask. The\n * `originalByteSize` ceiling mapping is REMOVED; byte-size audit provenance\n * lives in the KAS `KnowledgeAssetByteSizeUpdated` event history.\n */\ncontract KnowledgeAssetsLifecycle is INamed, IVersioned, ContractStatus, IInitializable, ReentrancyGuard {\n    string private constant _NAME = \"KnowledgeAssetsLifecycle\";\n    // 10.1.0 \u2192 10.1.1: ReentrancyGuard perimeter on publish / update /\n    // extendKnowledgeAssetLifetime; strict-positive tokenAmount floor\n    // in `_validateTokenAmount`. ReentrancyGuard contributes one uint256\n    // storage slot at the end of the inheritance chain; KAV10 owns its\n    // slots below the inherited chain and V10 deploys are redeploy +\n    // reinit, so no storage-layout migration is required.\n    // 10.0.3 \u2192 10.0.4: curated publishes and paid legacy curated updates\n    // must carry a ciphertext commitment before entering value-weighted\n    // random-sampling state.\n    // 10.0.5 \u2192 10.1.0: OT-RFC-49 \"hosting follows access\" \u2014 the curated\n    // random-sampling commitment is the PUBLIC `_catalog` root, not the\n    // private ciphertext root (cores hold zero private bytes). PublishParams /\n    // UpdateParams ciphertext fields become `catalogRoot`/`catalogLeafCount`\n    // (same byte widths); the three commitment errors are renamed; the publish\n    // and update ACK preimages prepend `ACK_DIGEST_VERSION` (Trap 3 \u2014 raw\n    // abi.encodePacked, NOT the EIP-712 domain). Minor bump: new sampling\n    // semantics, but no inherited-slot growth in this contract.\n    // 10.0.4 \u2192 10.0.5: audit fix \u2014 the conviction (PCA discount) branch in\n    // `publish`/`update` now FALLS THROUGH to direct spend instead of\n    // reverting when `coverPublishingCost` fails for a payment reason\n    // (`InsufficientAllowance` / `AccountExpired`). Agent registration is\n    // permissionless and requires no consent (RFC-001 \u00a73.6), so a hard\n    // revert on the conviction branch let anyone register a victim against\n    // a deliberately-underfunded account and brick that victim's paid\n    // publishes/updates indefinitely. This extends the existing\n    // \"stale registration MUST NOT brick the publisher\" intent (already\n    // applied to the expired / epoch-mismatch gate) to the\n    // underfunded-active case.\n    // 2.0.0 \u2192 2.0.1 (PATCH): protocol treasury fee skimmed inside\n    // `_addTokens` (publisher pays the same gross amount; the fee is taken\n    // out of the staker-bound net). Patch-level on purpose.\n    // #1116: the EIP-712 author-attestation domain version\n    // (`_EIP712_VERSION_HASH`) is bumped \"2.0.0\" \u2192 \"3.0.0\" \u2014 a DELIBERATE\n    // breaking change for the context-graph-independent author attestation\n    // (the `contextGraphId` struct field was removed). Pre-cutover\n    // attestations no longer verify (acceptable pre-mainnet, no backcompat).\n    // 10.1.0 \u2014 OT-RFC-49 catalog model + ACK domain separation (see\n    //          `ACK_DIGEST_VERSION` below).\n    // 10.1.1 \u2014 OT-RFC-51 \"Publishing Allocation\": realized publishing no\n    //          longer credits per-node publishing allocation (K_n). The two\n    //          guarded `addEpochProducedKnowledgeValue` writes (publish core\n    //          + increase/extend delta) are removed; the publishing factor is\n    //          now fed exclusively by committed PCA allocation. The\n    //          `publisherNodeIdentityId` struct field is retained as a\n    //          self-claimed attribution (no longer scoring).\n    // 10.1.2 \u2014 Phase 10.x settle-on-spend: after each addCGValueForEpochRange\n    //          (publish / extend / update) the CG's BIT weight leaf is settled via\n    //          CGWeightTreeStorage so the value-weighted challenge draw sees fresh\n    //          weights. No ACK / attestation change \u2014 PATCH bump keeps the EIP-712\n    //          domain (major.minor \"10.1\") stable.\n    // 10.1.3 \u2014 OT-RFC-53: CG registration-deposit consume wired into\n    //          publish / update / extend (escrow-funded portion drawn from the CSS\n    //          vault; wallet/PCA covers the remainder). PATCH bump \u2014 no ACK /\n    //          EIP-712 domain change.\n    // 10.1.4 \u2014 OT-RFC-53: the escrow-funded portion now pays the protocol treasury\n    //          fee at consume, at parity with the wallet path's `_addTokens` \u2014 net\n    //          distributed to stakers, fee routed out of the CSS vault to the\n    //          treasury via `_chargeEscrowTreasuryFee`. Supersedes 10.1.3's\n    //          gross-for-gross distribution. PATCH bump \u2014 no ACK / EIP-712 change.\n    // 10.1.5 \u2014 Audit G-7: the CG value-write paths (extendKnowledgeAssetLifetime\n    //          and the _executeUpdateCore delta) revert with\n    //          CannotWriteValueToInactiveContextGraph on a deactivated CG, so a\n    //          swept CG can no longer be re-stranded with sampling weight. PATCH\n    //          bump \u2014 no ACK / EIP-712 change.\n    // 10.1.6 \u2014 extendKnowledgeAssetLifetime reward epoch-range correction: the\n    //          extension now funds [endEpoch + 1, endEpoch + epochs] (exactly\n    //          `epochs` buckets) instead of [endEpoch, endEpoch + epochs], which\n    //          double-funded endEpoch (already funded by publish through endEpoch)\n    //          and paid one epoch past the purchased lifetime. Also rejects\n    //          epochs == 0 (ZeroEpochs) before mutating/paying. The RandomSampling\n        // publishing factor is now fed exclusively by COMMITTED PCA\n        // allocation, seeded/moved in `PublishingConviction`. The former\n        // `addEpochProducedKnowledgeValue(publisherNodeIdentityId, ...)`\n        // write has been removed here. `publisherNodeIdentityId` remains a\n        // self-claimed attribution field on the publish struct but no longer\n        // drives scoring, so there is no longer a `nodeExists` gate to apply.\n    }\n\n    // ========================================================================\n    // Lifetime Extension (V8-compatible, no ACK change needed)\n    // ========================================================================\n\n    function extendKnowledgeAssetLifetime(\n        uint256 id,\n        uint40 epochs,\n        uint96 tokenAmount\n    ) external nonReentrant {\n        DKGKnowledgeAssets kas = knowledgeAssetsStorage;\n\n        (, , , uint88 byteSize, , uint40 endEpoch, uint96 oldTokenAmount, ) = kas.getKnowledgeAssetMetadata(id);\n\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch > endEpoch) {\n            revert KnowledgeAssetLib.KnowledgeAssetExpired(id, currentEpoch, endEpoch);\n        }\n\n        // Reject a zero-epoch extension BEFORE any metadata mutation or payment:\n        // it is semantically a no-op, and the reward range below\n        // ([endEpoch + 1, endEpoch + epochs]) would otherwise invert to\n        // [endEpoch + 1, endEpoch] and underflow inside EpochStorage (an internal\n        // arithmetic panic instead of a stable API error). i < identityIds.length; i++) {\n            _verifySignature(identityIds[i], messageHash, r[i], vs[i]);\n        }\n    }\n\n    function _verifySignature(\n        uint72 identityId,\n        bytes32 messageHash,\n        bytes32 _r,\n        bytes32 _vs\n    ) internal view returns (address signer) {\n        signer = ECDSA.tryRecover(messageHash, _r, _vs);\n\n        if (signer == address(0)) {\n            revert KnowledgeAssetLib.InvalidSignature(identityId, messageHash, _r, _vs);\n        }\n\n        if (\n            !identityStorage.keyHasPurpose(identityId, keccak256(abi.encodePacked(signer)), IdentityLib.OPERATIONAL_KEY)\n        ) {\n            revert KnowledgeAssetLib.SignerIsNotNodeOperator(identityId, signer);\n        }\n\n        // RFC-001 edge-publish unblocker: ACK signers must be in the active\n        // sharding table, not merely staked. The struct hash binds the publication's\n     * `merkleRoot` to a specific (authorAddress, schemeVersion, reservedKaId)\n     * \u2014 leaked signatures cannot be redirected to a different content root, a\n     * different author identity, or a different KA id/slot.\n     *\n     * The seal is intentionally context-graph-independent (#1116): an\n     * assertion can be sealed before its CG is registered on-chain. CG\n     * binding happens at publish via `PublishParams.contextGraphId` plus the\n     * separate ACK digest, not by this author signature.\n     *\n     * Replay defense is the one-shot consumption of the author-namespaced\n     * `reservedKaId` (the packed `(uint160(author) << 96) | uint96(number)`\n     * slot) at the `DKGKnowledgeAssets` layer; no `signedAtBlock` window is\n     * included in the digest (see RFC-001 \u00a73.2).\n     */\n    function _hashAuthorAttestation(\n        bytes32 _merkleRoot,\n        address _authorAddress,\n        uint8 _schemeVersion,\n        uint256 _reservedKaId\n    ) internal view returns (bytes32) {\n        bytes32 domainSeparator = keccak256(\n            abi.encode(\n                _EIP712_DOMAIN_TYPEHASH,\n                _EIP712_NAME_HASH,\n                _EIP712_VERSION_HASH,\n                block.chainid,\n                address(this)\n            )\n        );\n        bytes32 structHash = keccak256(\n            abi.encode(\n                _AUTHOR_ATTESTATION_TYPEHASH,\n                _merkleRoot,\n                _authorAddress,\n                _schemeVersion,\n                _reservedKaId\n            )\n        );\n        return keccak256(abi.encodePacked(\"\\x19\\x01\", domainSeparator, structHash));\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Verify the author attestation attached to a publish call.\n     *\n     * Branches on `authorAddress.code.length`:\n     *\n     * - **EOA** (`code.length == 0`): standard ECDSA recovery, equality with\n     *   `authorAddress`. `tryRecover` returns `address(0)` on malformed\n     *   signatures \u2014 the explicit `recovered != address(0)` check is\n     *   defense-in-depth above the outer `authorAddress != 0` revert.\n     *\n     * - **Smart-contract wallet** (`code.length > 0`): delegates to the\n     *   wallet's own `isValidSignature` \u2014 the wallet decides which\n     *   underlying keys are currently authorized, enabling key rotation,\n     *   social recovery, multi-sig, and passkey signers. The `(r, s, v)` triple is reconstructed from\n     *   the compact `(authorR, authorVS)` pair.\n     *\n     * EIP-7702 delegation works through the EIP-1271 branch automatically:\n     * a delegated EOA has `code.length > 0` (the `0xef0100 || delegate`\n     * prefix), so `staticcall(isValidSignature)` lands on the delegate's\n     * implementation.\n     */\n    function _hashUpdateAuthorAttestation(\n        uint256 kaId,\n        bytes32 newMerkleRoot,\n        address authorAddress,\n        uint8 schemeVersion\n    ) internal view returns (bytes32) {\n        bytes32 domainSeparator = keccak256(\n            abi.encode(\n                _EIP712_DOMAIN_TYPEHASH,\n                _EIP712_NAME_HASH,\n                _EIP712_VERSION_HASH,\n                block.chainid,\n                address(this)\n            )\n        );\n        bytes32 structHash = keccak256(\n            abi.encode(\n                _UPDATE_AUTHOR_ATTESTATION_TYPEHASH,\n                kaId,\n                newMerkleRoot,\n                authorAddress,\n                schemeVersion\n            )\n        );\n        return keccak256(abi.encodePacked(\"\\x19\\x01\", domainSeparator, structHash));\n    }\n\n    function _verifyUpdateAuthorAttestation(UpdateParams calldata p) internal view {\n        if (p.authorAddress == address(0)) revert AuthorRequired();\n        if (p.authorSchemeVersion != 1) revert UnsupportedAuthorScheme(p.authorSchemeVersion);\n\n        bytes32 digest = _hashUpdateAuthorAttestation(\n            p.id,\n            p.newMerkleRoot,\n            p.authorAddress,\n            p.authorSchemeVersion\n        );\n\n        if (p.authorAddress.code.length == 0) {\n            address recovered = ECDSA.tryRecover(digest, p.authorR, p.authorVS);\n            if (recovered == address(0) || recovered != p.authorAddress) {\n                revert InvalidAuthorSignature();\n            }\n        } else {\n            bytes32 s = p.authorVS & bytes32((uint256(1) << 255) - 1);\n            uint8 v = uint8((uint256(p.authorVS) >> 255) + 27);\n            bytes memory sig = abi.encodePacked(p.authorR, s, v);\n            if (\n                IERC1271(p.authorAddress).isValidSignature(digest, sig) != _ERC1271_MAGIC_VALUE\n            ) {\n                revert InvalidAuthorSignature1271();\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    function _verifyAuthorAttestation(PublishParams calldata p) internal view {\n        if (p.authorAddress == address(0)) revert AuthorRequired();\n        if (p.authorSchemeVersion != 1) revert UnsupportedAuthorScheme(p.authorSchemeVersion);\n\n        bytes32 digest = _hashAuthorAttestation(\n            p.merkleRoot,\n            p.authorAddress,\n            p.authorSchemeVersion,\n            p.reservedKaId\n        );\n\n        if (p.authorAddress.code.length == 0) {\n            // EOA branch.\n            address recovered = ECDSA.tryRecover(digest, p.authorR, p.authorVS);\n            if (recovered == address(0) || recovered != p.authorAddress) {\n                revert InvalidAuthorSignature();\n            }\n        } else {\n            // EIP-1271 branch. The expected-cost formula\n        // `(ask * byteSize * window) / 1024` flows through integer\n        // truncation; for `(ask * byteSize * window) < 1024` the\n        // expected cost collapses to 0 and the under-payment branch\n        // below becomes unreachable on `tokenAmount == 0`. The explicit\n        // floor ensures publish / lifetime-extension always charge a\n        // non-zero economic cost regardless of input rounding. The\n        // update path is unaffected (pure metadata updates skip this\n        // validator entirely \u2014 gated on `newByteSize > currentByteSize`).\n        if (tokenAmount == 0) {\n            revert KnowledgeAssetLib.InvalidTokenAmount(1, 0);\n        }\n\n        uint256 stakeWeightedAverageAsk = askStorage.getStakeWeightedAverageAsk();\n        // H7: `SafeCast.toUint96` reverts on overflow instead of silently\n        // truncating. timeRemainingInCurrentEpoch = chronos.timeUntilNextEpoch();\n        uint256 baseTokensPerFullEpoch = tokenAmount / epochs;\n        uint256 currentEpochAllocation = (baseTokensPerFullEpoch * uint256 totalTokensForFullEpochs = baseTokensPerFullEpoch * numberOfFullEpochs;\n\n        uint256 totalAllocated = currentEpochAllocation + totalTokensForFullEpochs + finalEpochAllocation;\n *\n * @dev ContextGraphs resolves a PCA agent -> account mapping when checking\n *      publish authorization for PCA curator type, and validates that a\n *      (publishAuthority, publishAuthorityAccountId) pair is coherent on\n *      create / update paths. Using a minimal interface (two view getters)\n *      instead of importing the full contract avoids a cross-module circular\n *      import risk and keeps the facade replaceable.\n *\n *      `agentToAccountId` is declared `public` in DKGPublishingConvictionNFT,\n *      so the auto-generated getter returns the account id for a registered\n *      agent (zero if the agent is not registered).\n *\n *      `ownerOf` is inherited from ERC-721: DKGPublishingConvictionNFT is an\n *      `ERC721Enumerable`, and its token IDs mirror account IDs. The CG\n *      coherence check requires the publishAuthority (account-owner marker)\n *      to equal the current owner of the account's NFT \u2014 this locks the\n *      interface to an ERC-721-backed NFT implementation and blocks drop-in\n *      replacements that don't expose `ownerOf`.\n *\n *      NOTE on revert behavior: OZ's ERC721 `ownerOf` reverts with\n *      `ERC721NonexistentToken` when the token has never been minted (i.e.\n *      the account does not exist). Callers MUST wrap in try/catch.\n */\ninterface IDKGPublishingConvictionNFT {\n    /// @notice Returns the account id a given agent is registered under, or 0.\n    function agentToAccountId(address agent) external view returns (uint256);\n\n    /// @notice Returns the current owner of an account's ERC-721 token.\n    /// @dev Reverts for non-existent tokens (no such account). Callers MUST\n    ///      use try/catch to distinguish \"no such account\" from a live miss.\n    function ownerOf(uint256 accountId) external view returns (address);\n\n    /// @notice Returns a conviction account tuple by id.\n    function accounts(\n        uint256 accountId\n    )\n        external\n        view\n        returns (\n            uint96 committedTRAC,\n            uint40 createdAtEpoch,\n            uint40 expiresAtEpoch,\n            uint40 createdAtTimestamp,\n            uint40 expiresAtTimestamp,\n            uint16 lockDurationEpochs,\n            uint16 discountBps,\n            uint16 lastSettledWindow,\n            bool fullySwept,\n            // OT-RFC-51 \"Publishing Allocation\": designated node + its\n            // re-designation rate-limit cursor.\n            uint72 primaryNode,\n            uint40 lastPrimaryNodeChangeEpoch\n        );\n\n    /// @notice Spend a publishing agent's conviction allowance for a base\n    ///         cost and fund the published KA's epoch range from escrow.\n    /// @dev Caller MUST be `KnowledgeAssetsV10` \u2014 the NFT gates this via Hub\n    ///      lookup. The NFT resolves the paying account internally from\n    ///      `agentToAccountId[publishingAgent]`, so KAV10 MUST NOT supply an\n    ///      account id (N28 closure: removes victim-account-drain vector).\n    ///\n    ///      `kaStartEpoch` / `kaEpochs` describe the published KA's\n    ///      lifetime: the discounted cost will be distributed across the\n    ///      chain epochs `[kaStartEpoch, kaStartEpoch + kaEpochs - 1]`\n    ///      (active sink). `kaEpochs` MUST be <= the account's\n    ///      `lockDurationEpochs` or the call reverts with\n    ///      `InvalidConvictionKaEpochs`.\n    ///\n    ///      Reverts:\n    ///      - `NoConvictionAccount(publishingAgent)` if agent has no account.\n    ///      - `AccountExpired(accountId, expiresAt)` if account is past lock.\n    ///      - `InvalidConvictionKaEpochs(lockDurationEpochs, kaEpochs)` if\n    ///         `kaEpochs == 0` or exceeds the account lock window.\n    ///      - `InsufficientAllowance(...)` if epoch + top-up cannot cover cost.\n    ///      - `OnlyKnowledgeAssetsV10(caller)` if msg.sender is not KAV10.\n    ///\n    ///      Does NOT physically move TRAC \u2014 TRAC is already in CSS from the\n    ///      NFT's `createAccount`/`topUp` paths. This call only updates the\n    ///      `EpochStorage` accounting (active sink distribution + lazy\n    ///      passive-sink settlement of elapsed windows) and returns the\n    ///      discounted amount for caller-side accounting.\n    function coverPublishingCost(\n        address publishingAgent,\n        uint96 baseCost,\n        uint40 kaStartEpoch,\n        uint40 kaEpochs\n    ) external returns (uint96 discountedCost);\n\n    /// @notice Public lazy settlement entry point. Sweeps elapsed billing\n    ///         windows' unspent base remainder to the staker pool, and (if\n    ///         past `expiresAtTimestamp`) the post-expiry tail\n    ///         (`topUpBalance` + committed-amount dust). Idempotent \u2014\n    ///         safe to call repeatedly; subsequent calls after the final\n    ///         sweep are no-ops.\n    function settle(uint256 accountId) external;\n}\n","keccak256":"0x9023980d56df7be279f9212a27db042b5afdb259b73988ce294f4c35338beccd","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/interfaces/IERC734Extended.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\nlibrary UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet {\n    struct Contract {\n        string name;\n        address addr;\n    }\n\n    struct Set {\n        mapping(string => uint256) stringIndexPointers;\n        mapping(address => uint256) addressIndexPointers;\n        Contract[] contractList;\n    }\n\n    error EmptyName();\n    error ZeroAddress();\n    error ContractAlreadyExists(string name);\n    error AddressAlreadyInSet(address addr);\n    error ContractDoesNotExist(string name);\n    error AddressDoesNotExist(address addr);\n\n    function append(UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Set storage self, string calldata name, address addr) internal {\n        if (keccak256(abi.encodePacked(name)) == keccak256(abi.encodePacked(\"\"))) revert EmptyName();\n        if (addr == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();\n        if (exists(self, name)) revert ContractAlreadyExists(name);\n        if (self.contractList.length > 0 && (self.addressIndexPointers[addr] != 0 || self.contractList[0].addr == addr))\n            revert AddressAlreadyInSet(addr);\n\n        self.stringIndexPointers[name] = size(self);\n        self.addressIndexPointers[addr] = size(self);\n        self.contractList.push(UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Contract(name, addr));\n    }\n\n    function update(UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Set storage self, string calldata name, address addr) internal {\n        if (addr == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();\n        if (!exists(self, name)) revert ContractDoesNotExist(name);\n\n        address currentAddr = self.contractList[self.stringIndexPointers[name]].addr;\n        if (currentAddr == addr) {\n            // Idempotent: same address already registered for this name (e.g. re-run deploy in tests).\n            return;\n        }\n        if (self.contractList.length > 0 && (self.addressIndexPointers[addr] != 0 || self.contractList[0].addr == addr))\n            revert AddressAlreadyInSet(addr);\n\n        delete self.addressIndexPointers[currentAddr];\n        self.addressIndexPointers[addr] = self.stringIndexPointers[name];\n        self.contractList[self.stringIndexPointers[name]].addr = addr;\n    }\n\n    function remove(UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Set storage self, string calldata name) internal {\n        if (!exists(self, name)) revert ContractDoesNotExist(name);\n\n        uint256 contractToRemoveIndex = self.stringIndexPointers[name];\n\n        delete self.addressIndexPointers[self.contractList[contractToRemoveIndex].addr];\n\n        UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Contract memory contractToMove = self.contractList[size(self) - 1];\n\n        self.stringIndexPointers[contractToMove.name] = contractToRemoveIndex;\n        self.addressIndexPointers[contractToMove.addr] = contractToRemoveIndex;\n        self.contractList[contractToRemoveIndex] = contractToMove;\n\n        delete self.stringIndexPointers[name];\n        self.contractList.pop();\n    }\n\n    function remove(UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Set storage self, address addr) internal {\n        if (!exists(self, addr)) revert AddressDoesNotExist(addr);\n\n        uint256 contractToRemoveIndex = self.addressIndexPointers[addr];\n\n        delete self.stringIndexPointers[self.contractList[contractToRemoveIndex].name];\n\n        UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Contract memory contractToMove = self.contractList[size(self) - 1];\n\n        self.stringIndexPointers[contractToMove.name] = contractToRemoveIndex;\n        self.addressIndexPointers[contractToMove.addr] = contractToRemoveIndex;\n        self.contractList[contractToRemoveIndex] = contractToMove;\n\n        delete self.addressIndexPointers[addr];\n        self.contractList.pop();\n    }\n\n    function get(\n        UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Set storage self,\n        string calldata name\n    ) internal view returns (UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Contract memory) {\n        if (!exists(self, name)) revert ContractDoesNotExist(name);\n\n        return self.contractList[self.stringIndexPointers[name]];\n    }\n\n    function get(\n        UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Set storage self,\n        address addr\n    ) internal view returns (UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Contract memory) {\n        if (!exists(self, addr)) revert AddressDoesNotExist(addr);\n\n        return self.contractList[self.addressIndexPointers[addr]];\n    }\n\n    function get(\n        UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Set storage self,\n        uint256 index\n    ) internal view returns (UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Contract memory) {\n        return self.contractList[index];\n    }\n\n    function getAll(\n        UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Set storage self\n    ) internal view returns (UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Contract[] memory) {\n        return self.contractList;\n    }\n\n    function getIndex(\n        UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Set storage self,\n        string calldata name\n    ) internal view returns (uint256) {\n        return self.stringIndexPointers[name];\n    }\n\n    function getIndex(UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Set storage self, address addr) internal view returns (uint256) {\n        return self.addressIndexPointers[addr];\n    }\n\n    function exists(\n        UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Set storage self,\n        string calldata name\n    ) internal view returns (bool) {\n        if (size(self) == 0) {\n            return false;\n        }\n        return\n            keccak256(abi.encodePacked(self.contractList[self.stringIndexPointers[name]].name)) ==\n            keccak256(abi.encodePacked(name));\n    }\n\n    function exists(UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Set storage self, address addr) internal view returns (bool) {\n        if (size(self) == 0) {\n            return false;\n        }\n        return addr == self.contractList[self.addressIndexPointers[addr]].addr;\n    }\n\n    function size(UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Set storage self) internal view returns (uint256) {\n        return self.contractList.length;\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x51b09c4bc2d3342e78c0a77eceff9ba5a7e694ba663535abec0e859c5e32b5ab","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/storage/AskStorage.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\nimport {ParametersStorage} from \"../storage/ParametersStorage.sol\";\nimport {INamed} from \"../interfaces/INamed.sol\";\nimport {IVersioned} from \"../interfaces/IVersioned.sol\";\nimport {IInitializable} from \"../interfaces/IInitializable.sol\";\nimport {ContractStatus} from \"../abstract/ContractStatus.sol\";\n\ncontract AskStorage is INamed, IVersioned, ContractStatus, IInitializable {\n    string private constant _NAME = \"AskStorage\";\n    string private constant _VERSION = \"10.0.2\";\n\n    ParametersStorage public parametersStorage;\n\n    uint256 public prevWeightedActiveAskSum;\n    uint256 public weightedActiveAskSum;\n\n    uint96 public prevTotalActiveStake;\n    uint96 public totalActiveStake;\n\n    // solhint-disable-next-line no-empty-blocks\n    constructor(address hubAddress) ContractStatus(hubAddress) {}\n\n    function initialize() public onlyHub {\n        parametersStorage = ParametersStorage(hub.getContractAddress(\"ParametersStorage\"));\n    }\n\n    function name() public pure virtual returns (string memory) {\n        return _NAME;\n    }\n\n    function version() external pure virtual returns (string memory) {\n        return _VERSION;\n    }\n\n    function getPricePerKbEpoch() external view returns (uint256) {\n        return getStakeWeightedAverageAsk();\n    }\n\n    function getPrevPricePerKbEpoch() external view returns (uint256) {\n        return getPrevStakeWeightedAverageAsk();\n    }\n\n    function getStakeWeightedAverageAsk() public view returns (uint256) {\n        return totalActiveStake > 0 ? weightedActiveAskSum / totalActiveStake : 0;\n    }\n\n    function getPrevStakeWeightedAverageAsk() public view returns (uint256) {\n        return prevTotalActiveStake > 0 ? prevWeightedActiveAskSum / prevTotalActiveStake : 0;\n    }\n\n    function getAskLowerBound() external view returns (uint256) {\n        return (prevWeightedActiveAskSum * parametersStorage.askLowerBoundFactor()) / prevTotalActiveStake;\n    }\n\n    function getAskUpperBound() external view returns (uint256) {\n        return (prevWeightedActiveAskSum * totalActiveStake = _totalActiveStake;\n    }\n\n    function increaseTotalActiveStake(uint96 amount) external onlyContracts {\n        totalActiveStake += amount;\n    }\n\n    function
