}\n}\n","keccak256":"0x9b7d59502990c189a7a071dde5975e152aa411bac15cd81e4c9ad2835ecdb713","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/storage/CGWeightTreeStorage.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\nimport {SafeCast} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/math/SafeCast.sol\";\n\nimport {Chronos} from \"./Chronos.sol\";\nimport {ContextGraphValueStorage} from \"./ContextGraphValueStorage.sol\";\nimport {HubDependent} from \"../abstract/HubDependent.sol\";\nimport {INamed} from \"../interfaces/INamed.sol\";\nimport {IVersioned} from \"../interfaces/IVersioned.sol\";\nimport {IInitializable} from \"../interfaces/IInitializable.sol\";\n\n/**\n * @title CGWeightTreeStorage\n * @notice Fenwick / Binary-Indexed-Tree index over Context-Graph ids for O(log)\n *         value-weighted challenge selection in RandomSampling. See\n *         docs/rfcs/scalable-weighted-cg-sampling.md.\n *\n *         - `cgWeight[cg]` is the CG's approximate current-epoch weight (the Fenwick leaf).\n *         - `bit`         holds standard BIT partial range sums over a FIXED power-of-two capacity.\n *         - `bitTotal`    is the cached \u03a3 cgWeight == prefixSum(BIT_CAPACITY).\n *\n *         `ContextGraphValueStorage` is the source of truth; this tree is an\n *         eventually-consistent fast index reconciled by `settle`. Challenge\n *         correctness never depends on weight freshness (RandomSampling's KA\n *         filter drops expired KAs after the draw), so leaves may be approximate.\n *\n * @dev CAPACITY IS FIXED AT DEPLOY \u2014 never grow it. A mapping-backed Fenwick whose\n *      logical size grows is silently wrong: when the live id count crosses a 2^k\n *      boundary, the newly-relevant internal node bit[2^k] must cover (0, 2^k] but\n *      never received the point updates written to lower leaves before it \"existed\",\n *      so prefixSum past that boundary is permanently short \u2014 no revert, bitTotal\n *      stays self-consistent, only the draw distribution is wrong. Fixing capacity up\n *      front makes every leaf's update path reach all its ancestors from the start;\n *      the mapping is sparse so unused leaves cost nothing. Because RandomSampling is\n *      a fresh-deploy contract, capacity is (re)chosen per deploy via the constructor.\n */\ncontract CGWeightTreeStorage is INamed, IVersioned, IInitializable, HubDependent {\n    using SafeCast for uint256;\n    using SafeCast for int256;\n\n    string private constant _NAME = \"CGWeightTreeStorage\";\n    string private constant _VERSION = \"1.0.0\";\n\n    /// @dev Thrown by _bitUpdate when an id is 0 (Fenwick is 1-based; lowbit(0)==0 loops\n    ///      forever) or >= BIT_CAPACITY (the update loop would no-op yet bitTotal would\n    ///      still move \u2014 silently breaking the \u03a3-consistency invariant). Real guard, not\n    ///      just \"size capacity big enough\": defense-in-depth vs the monotonic CG counter.\n    error CgIdOutOfBitCapacity(uint256 cg, uint256 capacity);\n    error CapacityNotPowerOfTwo(uint256 capacity);\n    error NotBackfilling();\n\n    event WeightSet(uint256 indexed cg, uint256 oldWeight, uint256 newWeight);\n    event BackfillFinalized(uint256 bitTotal);\n\n    Chronos public chronos;\n    ContextGraphValueStorage public contextGraphValueStorage;\n\n    /// @notice Fixed power-of-two capacity; valid CG ids are 1..BIT_CAPACITY-1.\n    uint256 public immutable BIT_CAPACITY;\n\n    mapping(uint256 index => uint256) internal bit; // Fenwick partial range sums\n    mapping(uint256 cg => uint256) public cgWeight; // explicit per-CG leaf (O(1) reads)\n    uint256 public bitTotal; // cached \u03a3 cgWeight == prefixSum(BIT_CAPACITY)\n    mapping(uint256 cg => uint256) public cgSettledEpoch; // epoch the leaf was last reconciled to\n    bool public backfillLocked; // true during migration seeding; gates `seed`\n\n    constructor(address hubAddress, uint256 bitCapacity) HubDependent(hubAddress) {\n        // Power-of-two so the descent's top step is exactly BIT_CAPACITY and lowbit math is clean.\n        if (bitCapacity == 0 || (bitCapacity & (bitCapacity - 1)) != 0) {\n            revert CapacityNotPowerOfTwo(bitCapacity);\n        }\n        BIT_CAPACITY = bitCapacity;\n        backfillLocked = true; // released by finishBackfill() once seeding completes\n    }\n\n    function initialize() public virtual override onlyHub {\n        chronos = Chronos(hub.getContractAddress(\"Chronos\"));\n        contextGraphValueStorage = ContextGraphValueStorage(hub.getContractAddress(\"ContextGraphValueStorage\"));\n    }\n\n    function name() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _NAME;\n    }\n\n    function version() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _VERSION;\n    }\n\n    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Fenwick primitives\n    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    /// @dev Standard Fenwick point update by a signed delta; keeps bitTotal in sync.\n    function _bitUpdate(uint256 i, int256 delta) internal {\n        // Guard first (unconditional): an out-of-range/zero id must revert even on a no-op delta,\n        // matching the docstring's defense-in-depth intent against the monotonic CG counter.\n        if (i == 0 || i >= BIT_CAPACITY) revert CgIdOutOfBitCapacity(i, BIT_CAPACITY);\n        if (delta == 0) return;\n        for (uint256 x = i; x <= BIT_CAPACITY; x += (x & (~x + 1))) {\n            bit[x] = (bit[x].toInt256() + delta).toUint256(); // never underflows: see invariants\n        }\n        // Slither flags this cached-total SSTORE as \"costly op in a loop\" via the settleMany/\n        // seedMany batch call stacks; updating bitTotal once per leaf change is required and is\n        // the whole point of the cached total (O(1) reads).\n        // slither-disable-next-line costly-loop\n        bitTotal = (bitTotal.toInt256() + delta).toUint256();\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Smallest index whose prefix sum is STRICTLY greater than `r` (mirrors the\n    ///         legacy `running > r` straddle). Capacity is a fixed power of two, so the top\n    ///         step is BIT_CAPACITY \u2014 no highest-bit computation needed. Caller guarantees\n    ///         `r < bitTotal`.\n    function findStrictGt(uint256 r) public view returns (uint256 idx) {\n        uint256 cum = 0;\n        idx = 0;\n        for (uint256 step = BIT_CAPACITY; step != 0; step >>= 1) {\n            uint256 next = idx + step;\n            if (next <= BIT_CAPACITY && cum + bit[next] <= r) {\n                // <= r \u21d2 still go right\n                idx = next;\n                cum += bit[next];\n            }\n        }\n        idx += 1; // first index that pushes the running sum strictly past r\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Renormalized strict-gt search over (all weighted CGs \\ `excluded`).\n    ///         Subtracts each excluded leaf's contribution DURING the descent, which\n    ///         reproduces the legacy \"re-summed adjustedTotal\" distribution exactly \u2014\n    ///         do NOT replace with an \"advance to next nonzero leaf\" walk (that skews the\n    ///         distribution and starves the tail). Caller guarantees `r < workingTotal`.\n    ///         O(excluded.length \u00b7 log).\n    function findStrictGtExcluding(uint256 r, uint256[] memory excluded) public view returns (uint256 idx) {\n        uint256 cum = 0;\n        idx = 0;\n        for (uint256 step = BIT_CAPACITY; step != 0; step >>= 1) {\n            uint256 next = idx + step;\n            if (next > BIT_CAPACITY) continue;\n            // bit[next] covers ids (idx, next]; net out any excluded leaves in that span.\n            // Cannot underflow: excluded leaves in (idx, next] are a subset of bit[next]'s sum.\n            uint256 nodeSum = bit[next] - _excludedInRange(idx + 1, next, excluded);\n            if (cum + nodeSum <= r) {\n                idx = next;\n                cum += nodeSum;\n            }\n        }\n        idx += 1;\n        // idx can never be an excluded CG: its leaf was netted out of every enclosing nodeSum.\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Working total for a renormalized draw = bitTotal \u2212 \u03a3 current weight of excluded ids.\n    ///         Recompute per attempt (a prior settle may have moved bitTotal).\n    function workingTotal(uint256[] memory excluded) public view returns (uint256) {\n        return bitTotal - _excludedSum(excluded);\n    }\n\n    function _excludedInRange(uint256 lo, uint256 hi, uint256[] memory excluded) internal view returns (uint256 s) {\n        uint256 n = excluded.length;\n        for (uint256 j = 0; j < n; j++) {\n            uint256 e = excluded[j];\n            if (e >= lo && e <= hi) s += cgWeight[e];\n        }\n    }\n\n    function _excludedSum(uint256[] memory excluded) internal view returns (uint256 s) {\n        uint256 n = excluded.length;\n        for (uint256 j = 0; j < n; j++) s += cgWeight[excluded[j]];\n    }\n\n    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Migration seeding (permissioned, only while backfill-locked)\n    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    /// @notice Set a CG's leaf to `weight` during the one-time migration backfill.\n    ///         Restricted to the locked window so weights can only be injected during\n    ///         seeding; post-unlock the only writer is `settle` (reconcile to truth).\n    function seed(uint256 cg, uint256 weight) external onlyContracts {\n        if (!backfillLocked) revert NotBackfilling();\n        _setWeight(cg, weight);\n    }\n\n    function seedMany(uint256[] calldata cgs, uint256[] calldata weights) external onlyContracts {\n        if (!backfillLocked) revert NotBackfilling();\n        uint256 n = cgs.length;\n        require(n == weights.length, \"len mismatch\");\n        for (uint256 k = 0; k < n; k++) _setWeight(cgs[k], weights[k]);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice End the migration backfill; enables the prod draw/settle path in RandomSampling.\n    ///         One-way and not re-callable, so an accidental double-call reverts loudly rather than\n    ///         silently re-emitting. Recovery from a premature call is a fresh redeploy (capacity is\n    ///         immutable and chosen per deploy anyway).\n    function finishBackfill() external onlyContracts {\n        if (!backfillLocked) revert NotBackfilling();\n        backfillLocked = false;\n        emit BackfillFinalized(bitTotal);\n    }\n\n    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Lazy settlement (the only place truth meets the index)\n    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    /// @notice Reconcile a CG's leaf to its true current-epoch weight in the ledger, and\n    ///         finalize the ledger so subsequent reads of this CG are O(1). Permissionless\n    ///         by design (settle-on-spend, settle-on-miss, keeper): finalizeCGValueUpTo is\n    ///         onlyContracts but the call originates from this Hub-registered contract.\n    // Slither: the \"reentrancy\" detectors flag the state writes after finalizeCGValueUpTo/\n    // getCGValueAtEpoch, but those callees are TRUSTED Hub-registered storage contracts that do\n    // pure storage math \u2014 no ETH/token transfer, no low-level call, no untrusted callback \u2014 so\n    // there is no reentrancy surface. State-after-call ordering is required (finalize must run\n    // before the value read).\n    // slither-disable-next-line reentrancy-no-eth,reentrancy-benign,reentrancy-events\n    function settle(uint256 cg) public {\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch > 0) contextGraphValueStorage.finalizeCGValueUpTo(cg, currentEpoch - 1);\n        uint256 truth = contextGraphValueStorage.getCGValueAtEpoch(cg, currentEpoch);\n        _setWeight(cg, truth);\n        cgSettledEpoch[cg] = currentEpoch;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Permissionless batch settle (keeper backstop for dormant / under-stated CGs).\n    // Slither: external calls inside the loop are unavoidable for a batch settle; each callee is\n    // a trusted Hub storage contract (see settle). The batch is caller-bounded.\n    // slither-disable-next-line calls-loop\n    function settleMany(uint256[] calldata cgs) external {\n        uint256 n = cgs.length;\n        for (uint256 k = 0; k < n; k++) settle(cgs[k]);\n    }\n\n    function _setWeight(uint256 cg, uint256 weight) internal {\n        uint256 cached = cgWeight[cg];\n        if (weight != cached) {\n            _bitUpdate(cg, weight.toInt256() - cached.toInt256());\n            cgWeight[cg] = weight;\n            emit WeightSet(cg, cached, weight);\n        }\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x9b4baa467419c4cf062be3b9f611e197c125f7d5aa3b61039bbfff8a6ace95b0","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/storage/Chronos.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\ncontract Chronos {\n    uint256 public immutable START_TIME;\n    uint256 public immutable EPOCH_LENGTH;\n\n    error InvalidStartTime();\n    error InvalidEpochLength();\n\n    constructor(uint256 _startTime, uint256 _epochLength) {\n        if (_startTime <= 0) {\n            revert InvalidStartTime();\n        }\n        if (_epochLength <= 0) {\n            revert InvalidEpochLength();\n        }\n\n        START_TIME = _startTime;\n        EPOCH_LENGTH = _epochLength;\n    }\n\n    function startTime() external view returns (uint256) {\n        return START_TIME;\n    }\n\n    function epochLength() external view returns (uint256) {\n        return EPOCH_LENGTH;\n    }\n\n    function getCurrentEpoch() external view returns (uint256) {\n        if (block.timestamp < START_TIME) {\n            return 1;\n        }\n        return ((block.timestamp - START_TIME) / EPOCH_LENGTH) + 1;\n    }\n\n    function epochAtTimestamp(uint256 timestamp) external view returns (uint256) {\n        if (timestamp < START_TIME) {\n            return 1;\n        }\n        return ((timestamp - START_TIME) / EPOCH_LENGTH) + 1;\n    }\n\n    function timeUntilNextEpoch() external view returns (uint256) {\n        if (block.timestamp < START_TIME) {\n            return START_TIME + EPOCH_LENGTH - block.timestamp;\n        }\n        // Slither: `block.timestamp % EPOCH_LENGTH` is flagged as weak-PRNG\n        // because miners can nudge `block.timestamp` within a small window.\n        // This is deterministic time math, NOT randomness \u2014 the modulo\n        // computes \"seconds elapsed since the start of the current epoch\",\n        // which has the same minor miner-influence as `block.timestamp`\n        // itself does (already trusted protocol-wide for epoch advancement).\n        // No randomness derivation, no PRNG semantics.\n        // slither-disable-next-line weak-prng\n        uint256 elapsed = (block.timestamp - START_TIME) % EPOCH_LENGTH;\n        return EPOCH_LENGTH - elapsed;\n    }\n\n    function hasEpochElapsed(uint256 epochNumber) external view returns (bool) {\n        return block.timestamp >= (START_TIME + (epochNumber - 1) * EPOCH_LENGTH);\n    }\n\n    function timestampForEpoch(uint256 epochNumber) external view returns (uint256) {\n        if (epochNumber == 0) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        return START_TIME + (epochNumber - 1) * EPOCH_LENGTH;\n    }\n\n    function elapsedTimeInCurrentEpoch() external view returns (uint256) {\n        if (block.timestamp < START_TIME) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        // Slither weak-prng \u2014 deterministic time math, not randomness.\n        // See `timeUntilNextEpoch` above for the long-form rationale.\n        // slither-disable-next-line weak-prng\n        return (block.timestamp - START_TIME) % EPOCH_LENGTH;\n    }\n\n    function totalElapsedTime() external view returns (uint256) {\n        if (block.timestamp < START_TIME) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        return block.timestamp - START_TIME;\n    }\n\n    function isChronosActive() external view returns (bool) {\n        return block.timestamp >= START_TIME;\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x1c1fa02e0ea347116b72bf3d9df60a3fedce60a02f4c0f7b6ebdf9379cf68ced","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/storage/ContextGraphStorage.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\nimport {Guardian} from \"../Guardian.sol\";\nimport {KnowledgeAssetsLib} from \"../libraries/KnowledgeAssetsLib.sol\";\nimport {INamed} from \"../interfaces/INamed.sol\";\nimport {IVersioned} from \"../interfaces/IVersioned.sol\";\nimport {ERC721} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC721/ERC721.sol\";\nimport {ERC721Enumerable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC721/extensions/ERC721Enumerable.sol\";\n\n/**\n * @title ContextGraphStorage\n * @notice ERC-721 registry for Context Graphs. Each CG is an NFT \u2014 the token holder\n *         has management authority (publish policy, participants).\n *\n * Inherits Guardian for Hub-based access control and ERC721Enumerable for\n * transferable governance tokens. The logic facade (ContextGraphs.sol) remains\n * stateless and replaceable; all state lives here.\n *\n * Design notes:\n *   - Per-CG hosting committees and per-CG quorum were removed in\n *     SPEC_CG_MEMORY_MODEL. Every CG is hosted by the network's sharding\n *     table at publish time, and the ACK quorum is the system parameter\n *     `parametersStorage.minimumRequiredSignatures()`. The CG records only\n *     the participant-agent allow-list (addresses used for curated / PCA\n *     flows).\n *   - 3 curator types are supported via (publishAuthority, publishAuthorityAccountId):\n *       EOA      -> publishAuthority = wallet, accountId = 0\n *       Safe     -> publishAuthority = multisig contract, accountId = 0\n *       PCA      -> publishAuthority = account-owner address (read-only marker),\n *                   accountId = DKGPublishingConvictionNFT account ID\n *     The facade is responsible for resolving curator type at publish time.\n *   - `kaToContextGraph` reverse lookup and `_contextGraphKAList` forward list\n *     are written via `registerKnowledgeAssetToContextGraph` (called from the publish flow\n *     in Phase 8) and read by Phase 10 random sampling.\n *   - The legacy `addBatchToContextGraph` / `_contextGraphBatches` /\n *     `_attestedRoots` / `verifyTripleInclusion` surface is REMOVED. The\n *     deleted Merkle-inclusion path closes audit finding H2 (forged inclusion\n *     proofs via caller-supplied storage address).\n */\ncontract ContextGraphStorage is INamed, IVersioned, Guardian, ERC721Enumerable {\n    string private constant _NAME = \"ContextGraphStorage\";\n    // 10.0.3 \u2014 KC\u2192KA terminology: public getters renamed getContextGraphKCCount/At/List \u2192\n    //          getContextGraphKaCount/At/List (ABI selector change; no behavior change).\n    // 10.0.4 \u2014 OT-RFC-53: per-CG registration-escrow accounting (get/set/decrease/\n    //          clear) consumed by the deposit pull + admin sweep. ABI surface addition.\n    // 10.0.6 \u2014 Decoupled sampling list: a SECOND per-CG array (`_samplingKAList`)\n    //          drives random sampling and is the one the keeper compacts, while\n    //          `_contextGraphKAList` stays strictly append-only as the\n    //          registration-ordinal source the off-chain chain-reconciler reads\n    //          (`getContextGraphKaCount/At`). Pruning expired KAs from sampling no\n    //          longer mutates that ordinal, so the reconciler's [watermark, head)\n    //          cursor can never skip a later publish. Adds getSamplingKaCount/At;\n    //          swapRemoveSamplingKnowledgeAssetAt now targets the sampling list.\n    string private constant _VERSION = \"10.0.6\";\n\n    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Bounds on participant list \u2014 anti-griefing cap.\n    //\n    // MAX_PARTICIPANT_AGENTS bounds both the O(n^2) creation-time dedup and\n    // the O(n) shift-left in `removeParticipantAgent` to ~1.3M gas worst case.\n    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------\n    uint256 public constant MAX_PARTICIPANT_AGENTS = 256;\n\n    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Storage layout \u2014 fresh design (no prior deployments to preserve).\n    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    uint256 private _contextGraphCounter;\n\n    // Core context graph metadata (no participant list; that lives in its\n    // own mapping to avoid struct\u2194dynamic-array mutability constraints).\n    mapping(uint256 contextGraphId => KnowledgeAssetsLib.ContextGraph) private _contextGraphs;\n\n    // Participant agents: EOA addresses authorised to publish into a curated\n    // CG (used as an allow-list for Safe / PCA-agent flows). Insertion order\n    // preserved; duplicates rejected.\n    // Slither: mappings are zero-initialized by the language (no slot is\n    // written until first key insertion). The \"uninitialized-state\" rule\n    // fires on declaration-without-initializer, but there is no\n    // initializer syntax for mappings \u2014 Solidity rejects it. False\n    // positive for every public/private mapping in the codebase.\n    // slither-disable-next-line uninitialized-state\n    mapping(uint256 contextGraphId => address[]) private _participantAgents;\n\n    // Non-zero when curator type is PCA: the DKGPublishingConvictionNFT\n    // account ID whose registered agents are authorised to publish.\n    mapping(uint256 contextGraphId => uint256) private _publishAuthorityAccountId;\n\n    // OT-RFC-38 / LU-6 Phase B \u2014 opt-in stable identifier the curator\n    // commits to at create time. Set to `keccak256(bytes(cleartextId))`\n    // by the agent layer so the wire form of SWM gossip (topic,\n    // envelope `contextGraphId`, signing payload, host-mode store key)\n    // is chain-derivable and privacy-preserving (cleartext never leaves\n    // the local node). Hosting cores that hear `ContextGraphCreated`\n    // read this and auto-subscribe to `dkg/context-graph/{nameHash}/\n    // shared-memory` in host mode \u2014 no off-chain discovery channel\n    // required for registered CGs. Zero indicates a CG that didn't\n    // commit to a name hash (curator chose not to opt in, or it pre-\n    // dates this surface); host-mode auto-subscribe is then governed\n    // by the discovery beacon path instead.\n    mapping(uint256 contextGraphId => bytes32) private _contextGraphNameHash;\n\n    // KA -> CG reverse lookup (Phase 10 random sampling).\n    // Public for convenience; zero means \"not registered\".\n    mapping(uint256 kaId => uint256 contextGraphId) public kaToContextGraph;\n\n    // CG -> [KA IDs] APPEND-ONLY registration list. This is the per-CG\n    // registration-ordinal source the off-chain chain-reconciler walks as\n    // `[watermark, head)` (head = getContextGraphKaCount) \u2014 so it MUST stay\n    // append-only: never reorder, never shrink. Sampling pruning happens on\n    // `_samplingKAList` below, never here.\n    mapping(uint256 contextGraphId => uint256[]) private _contextGraphKAList;\n\n    // CG -> [live KA IDs] COMPACTED list that drives within-CG random sampling.\n    // Written alongside `_contextGraphKAList` on registration, but the keeper\n    // (`RandomSampling.pruneExpiredKnowledgeAssets` \u2192 `swapRemoveSamplingKnowledgeAssetAt`)\n    // swap-pops EXPIRED KAs out of THIS list only. Decoupling the sampling\n    // enumeration from the append-only registration ordinal lets the draw shed\n    // dead slots without corrupting the reconciler cursor. Read via\n    // getSamplingKaCount/At; the two lists diverge over time by design.\n    //\n    // POPULATION INVARIANT: `registerKnowledgeAssetToContextGraph` is the SOLE\n    // writer of both arrays and always appends to them together \u2014 there is no\n    // setter or migration that writes `_contextGraphKAList` alone. So a CG can\n    // never hold registrations in the append-only list without the matching\n    // sampling entries (the \"pre-existing KAs invisible to sampling\" state is\n    // unreachable). This is a fresh-design, non-proxy contract deployed empty for\n    // V10 (both lists populate from genesis); should a future deployment ever\n    // need to preserve CG state, the migration MUST seed both arrays together.\n    mapping(uint256 contextGraphId => uint256[]) private _samplingKAList;\n\n    // OT-RFC-53 \u2014 per-CG registration-deposit escrow (anti-spam). Accounting\n    // only: the TRAC itself is custodied in the CSS vault (mirrors\n    // PublishingConviction's committed-TRAC model). Set at on-chain CG\n    // creation, decremented as the owner spends it on publishing into the CG,\n    // cleared on an admin sweep to the staker reward pool.\n    mapping(uint256 contextGraphId => uint96) private _cgRegistrationEscrow;\n\n    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Events\n    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    event ContextGraphCreated(\n        uint256 indexed contextGraphId,\n        address indexed owner,\n        bytes32 indexed nameHash,\n        address[] participantAgents,\n        uint256 metadataBatchId,\n        uint8 accessPolicy,\n        uint8 publishPolicy,\n        address publishAuthority,\n        uint256 publishAuthorityAccountId\n    );\n\n    event ContextGraphDeactivated(\n        uint256 indexed contextGraphId\n    );\n\n    event PublishPolicyUpdated(\n        uint256 indexed contextGraphId,\n        uint8 publishPolicy,\n        address publishAuthority,\n        uint256 publishAuthorityAccountId\n    );\n\n    event PublishAuthorityUpdated(\n        uint256 indexed contextGraphId,\n        address newAuthority,\n        uint256 newAuthorityAccountId\n    );\n\n    event AgentParticipantAdded(\n        uint256 indexed contextGraphId,\n        address indexed agent\n    );\n\n    event AgentParticipantRemoved(\n        uint256 indexed contextGraphId,\n        address indexed agent\n    );\n\n    event KnowledgeAssetRegisteredToContextGraph(\n        uint256 indexed contextGraphId,\n        uint256 indexed kaId\n    );\n\n    constructor(\n        address hubAddress\n    ) Guardian(hubAddress) ERC721(\"DKG Context Graph\", \"DKGCG\") {}\n\n    function name() public pure virtual override(INamed, ERC721) returns (string memory) {\n        return _NAME;\n    }\n\n    function version() external pure virtual returns (string memory) {\n        return _VERSION;\n    }\n\n    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Creation\n    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Create a new context graph and mint its governance NFT.\n     * @param owner_                       Recipient of the ERC-721 (token holder == manager).\n     * @param participantAgents            EOA allow-list (no zeros, no duplicates).\n     * @param metadataBatchId              Batch ID describing the CG metadata (0 if none).\n     * @param accessPolicy                 0 = public/discoverable, 1 = private/curated.\n     * @param publishPolicy                0 = curated, 1 = open.\n     * @param publishAuthority             Curator address. Required when curated; ignored\n     *                                     (and forced to address(0)) when open.\n     * @param publishAuthorityAccountId    Non-zero for PCA curator type. Requires curated.\n     *                                     Forced to 0 when open.\n     * @param nameHash                     OT-RFC-38 / LU-6 Phase B \u2014 opt-in stable wire\n     *                                     identifier the curator commits to (intended to\n     *                                     be `keccak256(bytes(cleartextId))`, but the\n     *                                     contract is agnostic to the derivation; ANY\n     *                                     unique non-zero `bytes32` works). Hosting\n     *                                     cores in the sharding table use this to\n     *                                     auto-subscribe to the SWM gossip topic on\n     *                                     receipt of the `ContextGraphCreated` event.\n     *                                     Pass `bytes32(0)` to opt out \u2014 host-mode\n     *                                     auto-discovery for the CG then relies on the\n     *                                     gossip-beacon path (Option \u03b2).\n     *\n     * @dev Hosts and ACK quorum are network-level concerns: the sharding table\n     *      supplies hosts at publish time and `parametersStorage.minimumRequiredSignatures()`\n     *      sets the quorum. CGs do not declare a per-CG hosting committee.\n     */\n    function createContextGraph(\n        address owner_,\n        address[] calldata participantAgents,\n        uint256 metadataBatchId,\n        uint8 accessPolicy,\n        uint8 publishPolicy,\n        address publishAuthority,\n        uint256 publishAuthorityAccountId,\n        bytes32 nameHash\n    ) external onlyContracts returns (uint256 contextGraphId) {\n        if (owner_ == address(0)) {\n            revert KnowledgeAssetsLib.InvalidContextGraphConfig(\"zero address owner\");\n        }\n        if (participantAgents.length > MAX_PARTICIPANT_AGENTS) {\n            revert KnowledgeAssetsLib.InvalidContextGraphConfig(\"agents cap\");\n        }\n        if (accessPolicy > 1) {\n            revert KnowledgeAssetsLib.InvalidContextGraphConfig(\"invalid accessPolicy\");\n        }\n        if (publishPolicy > 1) {\n            revert KnowledgeAssetsLib.InvalidContextGraphConfig(\"invalid publishPolicy\");\n        }\n\n        // Curator config is policy-dependent.\n        address normalizedAuthority;\n        uint256 normalizedAccountId;\n        if (publishPolicy == 0) {\n            // Curated: authority required; accountId optional (non-zero -> PCA).\n            if (publishAuthority == address(0)) {\n                revert KnowledgeAssetsLib.InvalidContextGraphConfig(\"curated requires publishAuthority\");\n            }\n            normalizedAuthority = publishAuthority;\n            normalizedAccountId = publishAuthorityAccountId;\n        } else {\n            // Open: authority + accountId must be empty.\n            if (publishAuthority != address(0)) {\n                revert KnowledgeAssetsLib.InvalidContextGraphConfig(\"open policy: zero authority required\");\n            }\n            if (publishAuthorityAccountId != 0) {\n                revert KnowledgeAssetsLib.InvalidContextGraphConfig(\"open policy: zero accountId required\");\n            }\n            normalizedAuthority = address(0);\n            normalizedAccountId = 0;\n        }\n\n        contextGraphId = ++_contextGraphCounter;\n\n        // CEI ordering: populate ALL CG state below first; `_mint` happens\n        // last so the wrapper never observes a half-built (NFT-without-\n        // metadata-or-participants) state. `_mint` (not `_safeMint`) is\n        // intentional: `owner_` is forwarded from `ContextGraphs.create\n        // ContextGraph` as the upstream `msg.sender`, and contract owners\n        // without `IERC721Receiver` (DAO timelocks, custom multisigs,\n        // factory wrappers) are part of the supported caller set.\n        KnowledgeAssetsLib.ContextGraph storage cg = _contextGraphs[contextGraphId];\n        cg.metadataBatchId = metadataBatchId;\n        cg.active = true;\n        cg.createdAt = uint40(block.timestamp);\n        cg.accessPolicy = accessPolicy;\n        cg.publishPolicy = publishPolicy;\n        cg.publishAuthority = normalizedAuthority;\n\n        address[] storage storedAgents = _participantAgents[contextGraphId];\n        for (uint256 i; i < participantAgents.length; i++) {\n            address agent = participantAgents[i];\n            if (agent == address(0)) {\n                revert KnowledgeAssetsLib.InvalidContextGraphConfig(\"zero participant agent\");\n            }\n            // Linear dedup; small lists in practice.\n            for (uint256 j; j < i; j++) {\n                if (participantAgents[j] == agent) {\n                    revert KnowledgeAssetsLib.AgentParticipantAlreadyExists(contextGraphId, agent);\n                }\n            }\n            storedAgents.push(agent);\n        }\n\n        if (normalizedAccountId != 0) {\n            _publishAuthorityAccountId[contextGraphId] = normalizedAccountId;\n        }\n\n        if (nameHash != bytes32(0)) {\n            _contextGraphNameHash[contextGraphId] = nameHash;\n        }\n\n        _mint(owner_, contextGraphId);\n\n        emit ContextGraphCreated(\n            contextGraphId,\n            owner_,\n            nameHash,\n            participantAgents,\n            metadataBatchId,\n            accessPolicy,\n            publishPolicy,\n            normalizedAuthority,\n            normalizedAccountId\n        );\n    }\n\n    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // KA <-> CG registration (Phase 8 publish flow + Phase 10 sampling)\n    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Bind a Knowledge Asset to a Context Graph.\n     * @dev Records the reverse lookup (`kaToContextGraph[kaId] = cgId`) and\n     *      appends to BOTH per-CG lists: `_contextGraphKAList` (the append-only\n     *      registration ordinal the reconciler reads) and `_samplingKAList` (the\n     *      compactable sampling enumeration). They start identical; the keeper\n     *      later prunes expired entries from the sampling list only.\n     *      Reverts on double registration.\n     */\n    function registerKnowledgeAssetToContextGraph(\n        uint256 contextGraphId,\n        uint256 kaId\n    ) external onlyContracts {\n        if (kaId == 0) {\n            revert KnowledgeAssetsLib.InvalidContextGraphConfig(\"zero kaId\");\n        }\n        if (!_contextGraphs[contextGraphId].active) {\n            revert KnowledgeAssetsLib.ContextGraphNotActive(contextGraphId);\n        }\n        uint256 existing = kaToContextGraph[kaId];\n        if (existing != 0) {\n            revert KnowledgeAssetsLib.KnowledgeAssetAlreadyRegisteredToContextGraph(kaId, existing);\n        }\n        kaToContextGraph[kaId] = contextGraphId;\n        _contextGraphKAList[contextGraphId].push(kaId);\n        _samplingKAList[contextGraphId].push(kaId);\n        emit KnowledgeAssetRegisteredToContextGraph(contextGraphId, kaId);\n    }\n\n    event KnowledgeAssetPrunedFromSamplingList(uint256 indexed contextGraphId, uint256 indexed kaId);\n\n    /// @dev The generic swap-pop below can desync the sampling list from\n    ///      `kaToContextGraph`, so it is restricted to the RandomSampling\n    ///      contract (the sole component that prunes the list, and only for\n    ///      EXPIRED KAs \u2014 it checks `endEpoch` before calling). This is stricter\n    ///      than `onlyContracts`: it stops a future/buggy Hub contract from\n    ///      removing a LIVE KA from sampling while it still reports as registered.\n    error OnlyRandomSampling(address caller);\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Remove a Knowledge Asset from a Context Graph's SAMPLING list by\n     *         swap-and-pop.\n     * @dev Called only by `RandomSampling.pruneExpiredKnowledgeAssets` (the\n     *      permissionless keeper) to prune EXPIRED KAs, so the sampling\n     *      enumeration cannot accumulate dead slots into a within-CG sampling DoS.\n     *      Removes ONLY from `_samplingKAList` \u2014 the append-only\n     *      `_contextGraphKAList` (the reconciler's registration ordinal) is NOT\n     *      touched, so a later publish can never be skipped by the reconciler's\n     *      cursor. The `kaToContextGraph[kaId]` reverse binding is also left\n     *      intact: readers (`getKAContextGraphId`) must still resolve the KA, and\n     *      an expired KA can never be re-registered (it cannot be re-published\n     *      with the same id), so the double-registration guard stays correct.\n     *      `expectedKaId` makes the call a no-op when the slot no longer holds it\n     *      (a prior swap-pop moved a different KA into `index`) \u2014 robust to stale\n     *      indices.\n     */\n    function swapRemoveSamplingKnowledgeAssetAt(\n        uint256 contextGraphId,\n        uint256 index,\n        uint256 expectedKaId\n    ) external {\n        if (msg.sender != hub.getContractAddress(\"RandomSampling\")) {\n            revert OnlyRandomSampling(msg.sender);\n        }\n        uint256[] storage list = _samplingKAList[contextGraphId];\n        uint256 len = list.length;\n        if (index >= len || list[index] != expectedKaId) {\n            return; // stale / already moved \u2014 skip; pruned on a later draw\n        }\n        uint256 last = len - 1;\n        if (index != last) {\n            list[index] = list[last];\n        }\n        list.pop();\n        emit KnowledgeAssetPrunedFromSamplingList(contextGraphId, expectedKaId);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Return the entire KA list for a context graph as a memory array.\n     * @dev WARNING \u2014 ON-CHAIN CALLERS MUST NOT USE THIS GETTER. Gas cost is\n     *      O(n) in the list length and the ABI decode copies the full array\n     *      into memory. Phase 10 random sampling and any other on-chain\n     *      consumer MUST use `getContextGraphKaAt(cgId, index)` together\n     *      with `getContextGraphKaCount(cgId)` to fetch a single element at\n     *      a bounded cost. This full-array getter is retained for off-chain\n     *      indexers (eth_call) where the gas cost is not charged.\n     */\n    function getContextGraphKaList(\n        uint256 contextGraphId\n    ) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {\n        return _contextGraphKAList[contextGraphId];\n    }\n\n    function getContextGraphKaCount(\n        uint256 contextGraphId\n    ) external view returns (uint256) {\n        return _contextGraphKAList[contextGraphId].length;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Return a single KA id at a given index within a CG's KA list.\n     * @dev O(1) indexed accessor for on-chain consumers (Phase 10 random\n     *      sampling). Reverts with `InvalidContextGraphConfig(\"kaIndex oob\")`\n     *      on out-of-bounds access \u2014 empty list rejects all indices.\n     */\n    function getContextGraphKaAt(\n        uint256 contextGraphId,\n        uint256 index\n    ) external view returns (uint256 kaId) {\n        uint256[] storage list = _contextGraphKAList[contextGraphId];\n        if (index >= list.length) {\n            revert KnowledgeAssetsLib.InvalidContextGraphConfig(\"kaIndex oob\");\n        }\n        return list[index];\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Length of the COMPACTED sampling list (live + not-yet-pruned KAs).\n     * @dev This is the count the within-CG random-sampling draw bounds against\n     *      (`RandomSampling._pickKa`) and the keeper scans. It shrinks as the\n     *      keeper prunes expired KAs \u2014 unlike `getContextGraphKaCount`, which is\n     *      the monotonic append-only registration count.\n     */\n    function getSamplingKaCount(\n        uint256 contextGraphId\n    ) external view returns (uint256) {\n        return _samplingKAList[contextGraphId].length;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Single KA id at an index within a CG's compacted sampling list.\n     * @dev O(1) accessor for the within-CG draw + the keeper. Reverts\n     *      `InvalidContextGraphConfig(\"samplingIndex oob\")` out of bounds.\n     */\n    function getSamplingKaAt(\n        uint256 contextGraphId,\n        uint256 index\n    ) external view returns (uint256 kaId) {\n        uint256[] storage list = _samplingKAList[contextGraphId];\n        if (index >= list.length) {\n            revert KnowledgeAssetsLib.InvalidContextGraphConfig(\"samplingIndex oob\");\n        }\n        return list[index];\n    }\n\n    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Deactivation\n    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    function deactivateContextGraph(\n        uint256 contextGraphId\n    ) external onlyContracts {\n        _requireExists(contextGraphId);\n        _contextGraphs[contextGraphId].active = false;\n        emit ContextGraphDeactivated(contextGraphId);\n    }\n\n    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // OT-RFC-53 \u2014 registration-deposit escrow accounting (onlyContracts).\n    //\n    // `ContextGraphs` writes the balance at on-chain creation and clears it on\n    // an admin sweep; `KnowledgeAssetsLifecycle` decrements it as the CG owner\n    // funds publishing from the escrow. The underlying TRAC lives in the CSS\n    // vault throughout \u2014 these functions only move the per-CG accounting.\n    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    function getRegistrationEscrow(uint256 contextGraphId) external view returns (uint96) {\n        return _cgRegistrationEscrow[contextGraphId];\n    }\n\n    function setRegistrationEscrow(uint256 contextGraphId, uint96 amount) external onlyContracts {\n        _requireExists(contextGraphId);\n        _cgRegistrationEscrow[contextGraphId] = amount;\n    }\n\n    function decreaseRegistrationEscrow(uint256 contextGraphId, uint96 amount) external onlyContracts {\n        _requireExists(contextGraphId);\n        uint96 current = _cgRegistrationEscrow[contextGraphId];\n        if (amount > current) {\n            revert KnowledgeAssetsLib.InvalidContextGraphConfig(\"escrow underflow\");\n        }\n        _cgRegistrationEscrow[contextGraphId] = current - amount;\n    }\n\n    function clearRegistrationEscrow(uint256 contextGraphId) external onlyContracts returns (uint96 cleared) {\n        _requireExists(contextGraphId);\n        cleared = _cgRegistrationEscrow[contextGraphId];\n        if (cleared != 0) {\n            _cgRegistrationEscrow[contextGraphId] = 0;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Publish policy & authority\n    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Replace the publish policy + curator config in a single call.\n     * @dev When `publishPolicy == 1` (open), the new authority and accountId\n     *      MUST both be zero \u2014 open CGs have no curator.\n     */\n    function updatePublishPolicy(\n        uint256 contextGraphId,\n        uint8 publishPolicy,\n        address publishAuthority,\n        uint256 publishAuthorityAccountId\n    ) external onlyContracts {\n        _requireExists(contextGraphId);\n        if (publishPolicy > 1) {\n            revert KnowledgeAssetsLib.InvalidContextGraphConfig(\"invalid publishPolicy\");\n        }\n        if (publishPolicy == 0) {\n            if (publishAuthority == address(0)) {\n                revert KnowledgeAssetsLib.InvalidContextGraphConfig(\"curated requires publishAuthority\");\n            }\n        } else {\n            if (publishAuthority != address(0)) {\n                revert KnowledgeAssetsLib.InvalidContextGraphConfig(\"open policy: zero authority required\");\n            }\n            if (publishAuthorityAccountId != 0) {\n                revert KnowledgeAssetsLib.InvalidContextGraphConfig(\"open policy: zero accountId required\");\n            }\n        }\n\n        KnowledgeAssetsLib.ContextGraph storage cg = _contextGraphs[contextGraphId];\n        cg.publishPolicy = publishPolicy;\n        cg.publishAuthority = publishAuthority;\n        _publishAuthorityAccountId[contextGraphId] = publishAuthorityAccountId;\n\n        emit PublishPolicyUpdated(\n            contextGraphId,\n            publishPolicy,\n            publishAuthority,\n            publishAuthorityAccountId\n        );\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Update only the curator (authority + accountId), keeping policy.\n     * @dev Convenience for rotating an EOA / Safe / PCA without touching the\n     *      open/curated bit. Caller is the facade \u2014 it is responsible for\n     *      gating to the NFT owner.\n     */\n    function updatePublishAuthority(\n        uint256 contextGraphId,\n        address newAuthority,\n        uint256 newAuthorityAccountId\n    ) external onlyContracts {\n        _requireExists(contextGraphId);\n        KnowledgeAssetsLib.ContextGraph storage cg = _contextGraphs[contextGraphId];\n        if (cg.publishPolicy == 0) {\n            // Curated: authority required.\n            if (newAuthority == address(0)) {\n                revert KnowledgeAssetsLib.InvalidContextGraphConfig(\"curated requires publishAuthority\");\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Open: authority + accountId must remain empty.\n            if (newAuthority != address(0) || newAuthorityAccountId != 0) {\n                revert KnowledgeAssetsLib.InvalidContextGraphConfig(\"open policy: clear authority/accountId\");\n            }\n        }\n        cg.publishAuthority = newAuthority;\n        _publishAuthorityAccountId[contextGraphId] = newAuthorityAccountId;\n\n        emit PublishAuthorityUpdated(contextGraphId, newAuthority, newAuthorityAccountId);\n    }\n\n    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Participant agent governance\n    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    function addParticipantAgent(\n        uint256 contextGraphId,\n        address agent\n    ) external onlyContracts {\n        _requireExists(contextGraphId);\n        if (agent == address(0)) {\n            revert KnowledgeAssetsLib.InvalidContextGraphConfig(\"zero participant agent\");\n        }\n        address[] storage agents = _participantAgents[contextGraphId];\n        uint256 len = agents.length;\n        if (len >= MAX_PARTICIPANT_AGENTS) {\n            revert KnowledgeAssetsLib.InvalidContextGraphConfig(\"agents cap\");\n        }\n        for (uint256 i; i < len; i++) {\n            if (agents[i] == agent) {\n                revert KnowledgeAssetsLib.AgentParticipantAlreadyExists(contextGraphId, agent);\n            }\n        }\n        agents.push(agent);\n        emit AgentParticipantAdded(contextGraphId, agent);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Remove an agent from the participant allow-list.\n    /// @dev Shift-left preserves insertion order for deterministic off-chain\n    ///      iteration. Gas cost is bounded by MAX_PARTICIPANT_AGENTS\n    ///      (~1.3M gas worst case at the 256-entry cap).\n    function removeParticipantAgent(\n        uint256 contextGraphId,\n        address agent\n    ) external onlyContracts {\n        _requireExists(contextGraphId);\n        address[] storage agents = _participantAgents[contextGraphId];\n        uint256 len = agents.length;\n\n        for (uint256 i; i < len; i++) {\n            if (agents[i] == agent) {\n                // Shift left to preserve insertion order (no swap-pop).\n                for (uint256 j = i; j < len - 1; j++) {\n                    agents[j] = agents[j + 1];\n                }\n                agents.pop();\n                emit AgentParticipantRemoved(contextGraphId, agent);\n                return;\n            }\n        }\n        revert KnowledgeAssetsLib.AgentParticipantNotFound(contextGraphId, agent);\n    }\n\n    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Read APIs\n    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    function getContextGraph(\n        uint256 contextGraphId\n    ) external view returns (\n        address owner_,\n        address[] memory participantAgents,\n        uint256 metadataBatchId,\n        bool active,\n        uint256 createdAt,\n        uint8 accessPolicy,\n        uint8 publishPolicy,\n        address publishAuthority,\n        uint256 publishAuthorityAccountId\n    ) {\n        _requireExists(contextGraphId);\n        KnowledgeAssetsLib.ContextGraph storage cg = _contextGraphs[contextGraphId];\n        return (\n            ownerOf(contextGraphId),\n            _participantAgents[contextGraphId],\n            cg.metadataBatchId,\n            cg.active,\n            cg.createdAt,\n            cg.accessPolicy,\n            cg.publishPolicy,\n            cg.publishAuthority,\n            _publishAuthorityAccountId[contextGraphId]\n        );\n    }\n\n    function getParticipantAgents(\n        uint256 contextGraphId\n    ) external view returns (address[] memory) {\n        return _participantAgents[contextGraphId];\n    }\n\n    function isParticipantAgent(\n        uint256 contextGraphId,\n        address agent\n    ) external view returns (bool) {\n        address[] storage agents = _participantAgents[contextGraphId];\n        for (uint256 i; i < agents.length; i++) {\n            if (agents[i] == agent) return true;\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    function getContextGraphOwner(\n        uint256 contextGraphId\n    ) external view returns (address) {\n        return ownerOf(contextGraphId);\n    }\n\n    function isContextGraphActive(\n        uint256 contextGraphId\n    ) external view returns (bool) {\n        return _contextGraphs[contextGraphId].active;\n    }\n\n    function getPublishPolicy(\n        uint256 contextGraphId\n    ) external view returns (uint8 publishPolicy, address publishAuthority) {\n        KnowledgeAssetsLib.ContextGraph storage cg = _contextGraphs[contextGraphId];\n        return (cg.publishPolicy, cg.publishAuthority);\n    }\n\n    function getAccessPolicy(\n        uint256 contextGraphId\n    ) external view returns (uint8) {\n        return _contextGraphs[contextGraphId].accessPolicy;\n    }\n\n    function getPublishAuthorityAccountId(\n        uint256 contextGraphId\n    ) external view returns (uint256) {\n        return _publishAuthorityAccountId[contextGraphId];\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice OT-RFC-38 / LU-6 Phase B \u2014 committed name hash for the CG.\n     *         Returns `bytes32(0)` when the curator opted out at create\n     *         time (rare; expected only for CGs that pre-date the\n     *         Phase B surface or want to rely on the discovery-beacon\n     *         path exclusively).\n     */\n    function getNameHash(\n        uint256 contextGraphId\n    ) external view returns (bytes32) {\n        return _contextGraphNameHash[contextGraphId];\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice True iff the CG carries curated (encrypted) payloads \u2014 i.e.,\n     *         the ACCESS policy is curated, regardless of publish policy.\n     *\n     * Originally this checked `publishPolicy == 0`, but that conflated two\n     * orthogonal axes: \"who can read\" (access) vs. \"who can publish\".\n     * The ciphertext-commitment branch on the KAv10 publish path needs\n     * to know whether the payload is ENCRYPTED, which is an access-policy\n     * question. The \"curated access + open publish\" combo (anyone in the\n     * allowlist may publish, but readers must still decrypt) is a valid\n     * configuration and must accept ciphertext commitments.\n     *\n     * Used by `RandomSampling._pickWeightedChallenge` step 2 to decide\n     * whether the per-KA ciphertext-commitment filter applies (RFC-39\n     * Phase A.5). Both call sites converge on this access-policy check.\n     */\n    function getIsCurated(\n        uint256 contextGraphId\n    ) external view returns (bool) {\n        return _contextGraphs[contextGraphId].accessPolicy != 0;\n    }\n\n    function getLatestContextGraphId() external view returns (uint256) {\n        return _contextGraphCounter;\n    }\n\n    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Internal\n    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    function _requireExists(uint256 contextGraphId) internal view {\n        _requireOwned(contextGraphId);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @dev Override required by Solidity for ERC721Enumerable.\n     */\n    function supportsInterface(\n        bytes4 interfaceId\n    ) public view virtual override(ERC721Enumerable) returns (bool) {\n        return super.supportsInterface(interfaceId);\n    }\n\n    function _increaseBalance(\n        address account,\n        uint128 value\n    ) internal virtual override(ERC721Enumerable) {\n        super._increaseBalance(account, value);\n    }\n\n    function _update(\n        address to,\n        uint256 tokenId,\n        address auth\n    ) internal virtual override(ERC721Enumerable) returns (address) {\n        address from = super._update(to, tokenId, auth);\n\n        // On transfer (not mint/burn, not self-transfer): if the curated\n        // publishAuthority was the previous owner, auto-rotate it to the new\n        // owner so governance follows the NFT and the old owner can't keep\n        // publishing. Always clear the PCA accountId \u2014 the new owner is\n        // unlikely to be the same PCA, and they must explicitly opt back into\n        // PCA mode if desired.\n        //\n        // Self-transfers (`from == to`) are no-ops for governance: without the\n        // `from != to` guard the branch below would trivially evaluate true\n        // (publishAuthority == from == to) and silently clear the accountId.\n        if (from != address(0) && to != address(0) && from != to) {\n            KnowledgeAssetsLib.ContextGraph storage cg = _contextGraphs[tokenId];\n            if (cg.publishAuthority == from) {\n                cg.publishAuthority = to;\n                _publishAuthorityAccountId[tokenId] = 0;\n                emit PublishAuthorityUpdated(tokenId, to, 0);\n            }\n        }\n\n        return from;\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x0f3cdbe9ee4186cc46702bce4f91ad71d7612b482c3e4a03ab6853bfaffce3b1","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/storage/ContextGraphValueStorage.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\nimport {SafeCast} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/math/SafeCast.sol\";\n\nimport {Chronos} from \"./Chronos.sol\";\nimport {HubDependent} from \"../abstract/HubDependent.sol\";\nimport {INamed} from \"../interfaces/INamed.sol\";\nimport {IVersioned} from \"../interfaces/IVersioned.sol\";\n\n/**\n * @title ContextGraphValueStorage\n * @notice Lightweight per-CG and global per-epoch TRAC value tracker for V10\n *         value-weighted challenges. Mirrors `EpochStorage.sol` diff/cumulative\n *         finalize pattern at lines 149-174 / 279-310 exactly, but scaled to\n *         int256/uint256 because publish values are wei-of-TRAC and exceed uint96.\n *\n * Design rationale (see V10_CONTRACTS_REDESIGN_v2.md \u00a7\"Data in\n * ContextGraphValueStorage\"): a KA published with value `V` for `lifetime`\n * epochs contributes `V / lifetime` per epoch during its active window\n * [startEpoch, startEpoch + lifetime - 1]. Expiry is handled implicitly by the\n * negative diff written at `startEpoch + lifetime`. No cleanup, no keeper.\n *\n * `addCGValueForEpochRange` uses plain integer division per the spec. A couple\n * wei of rounding dust per publish is acceptable \u2014 this mapping is used for\n * challenge weighting, not reward distribution.\n *\n * The dormant shard mappings (`cgShard`, `shardKnowledgeValue`) are reserved\n * storage slots for future V11 sharding. Setters will be added alongside the\n * V11 logic contracts; no API exists today.\n */\ncontract ContextGraphValueStorage is INamed, IVersioned, HubDependent {\n    string private constant _NAME = \"ContextGraphValueStorage\";\n    string private constant _VERSION = \"10.0.2\";\n\n    event CGValueAddedForEpochRange(\n        uint256 indexed cgId,\n        uint256 startEpoch,\n        uint256 endEpoch,\n        uint256 lifetime,\n        uint256 value,\n        uint256 perEpoch\n    );\n    event CGValueFinalized(uint256 indexed cgId, uint256 startEpoch, uint256 endEpoch);\n    event GlobalValueFinalized(uint256 startEpoch, uint256 endEpoch);\n\n    error ZeroLifetime();\n    error ZeroValue();\n    error NegativeCumulative();\n    error BackfillForbidden();\n    error FutureOrCurrentEpoch();\n\n    Chronos public chronos;\n\n    // Per-CG diff/cumulative ledgers.\n    mapping(uint256 cgId => mapping(uint256 epoch => int256)) public cgValueDiff;\n    mapping(uint256 cgId => mapping(uint256 epoch => uint256)) public cgValueCumulative;\n    mapping(uint256 cgId => uint256) public cgLastFinalizedEpoch;\n\n    // Global diff/cumulative ledgers (sum across all CGs).\n    mapping(uint256 epoch => int256) public totalValueDiff;\n    mapping(uint256 epoch => uint256) public totalValueCumulative;\n    uint256 public globalLastFinalizedEpoch;\n\n    /// @dev Reserved storage slots for future V11 sharding. Setters will be\n    ///      added alongside the V11 logic contracts; no API exists today.\n    mapping(uint256 cgId => uint256) public cgShard;\n    mapping(uint256 shardId => mapping(uint256 epoch => uint256)) public shardKnowledgeValue;\n\n    constructor(address hubAddress) HubDependent(hubAddress) {}\n\n    function initialize() public onlyHub {\n        chronos = Chronos(hub.getContractAddress(\"Chronos\"));\n    }\n\n    function name() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _NAME;\n    }\n\n    function version() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _VERSION;\n    }\n\n    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // State mutators\n    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Record that `value` TRAC will be paid for `cgId` spread evenly\n     *         across `lifetime` epochs starting at `startEpoch`. Each epoch in\n     *         [startEpoch, startEpoch + lifetime - 1] receives `value/lifetime`.\n     * @dev Mirrors `EpochStorage.addTokensToEpochRange`. Finalizes per-CG and\n     *      global ledgers up to `currentEpoch - 1` after the diff writes so\n     *      stale epochs are crystallized before the next read. Rounding dust is\n     *      discarded per the spec (challenge weighting, not reward payout).\n     *\n     *      Invariant: `startEpoch >= currentEpoch`. Backfilling into an\n     *      already-finalized epoch would corrupt `cgValueCumulative` silently\n     *      because the cumulative at that epoch has already been crystallized\n     *      and subsequent reads hit the fast path. Reverts `BackfillForbidden`\n     *      if the caller tries.\n     *\n     *      Retraction / expiry is automatic via the paired negative diff\n     *      written at `startEpoch + lifetime`. There is no removal function\n     *      by design: Phase 8 value-changing ops (CREATE, byte-size-grow\n     *      UPDATE, lifetime extension) are all positive deltas, and natural\n     *      expiry is handled by the diff ledger itself.\n     */\n    function addCGValueForEpochRange(\n        uint256 cgId,\n        uint256 startEpoch,\n        uint256 lifetime,\n        uint256 value\n    ) external onlyContracts {\n        if (lifetime == 0) {\n            revert ZeroLifetime();\n        }\n        if (value == 0) {\n            revert ZeroValue();\n        }\n\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (startEpoch < currentEpoch) {\n            revert BackfillForbidden();\n        }\n\n        uint256 perEpoch = value / lifetime;\n        int256 perEpochSigned = SafeCast.toInt256(perEpoch);\n\n        cgValueDiff[cgId][startEpoch] += perEpochSigned;\n        cgValueDiff[cgId][startEpoch + lifetime] -= perEpochSigned;\n\n        totalValueDiff[startEpoch] += perEpochSigned;\n        totalValueDiff[startEpoch + lifetime] -= perEpochSigned;\n\n        if (currentEpoch > 1) {\n            _finalizeCGValueUpTo(cgId, currentEpoch - 1);\n            _finalizeGlobalValueUpTo(currentEpoch - 1);\n        }\n\n        emit CGValueAddedForEpochRange(\n            cgId,\n            startEpoch,\n            startEpoch + lifetime - 1,\n            lifetime,\n            value,\n            perEpoch\n        );\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Crystallizes `cgValueCumulative[cgId]` up to `epoch` so\n     *         subsequent reads at or below `epoch` become O(1). Safe to call\n     *         repeatedly: a call with `epoch <= cgLastFinalizedEpoch[cgId]`\n     *         is a no-op.\n     * @dev Intended to be called by RandomSampling before a challenge draw\n     *      (see V10_CONTRACTS_REDESIGN_v2 \"On challenge generation\"), but any\n     *      Hub-registered contract may call it. Reads stay pure `view`; this\n     *      is the state-changing half of the \"finalize then read\" pattern.\n     * @dev Reverts FutureOrCurrentEpoch if `epoch` is at or beyond the current\n     *      epoch. Only past epochs may be finalized; current-epoch reads always\n     *      take the simulation path to reflect in-flight diff writes.\n     */\n    function finalizeCGValueUpTo(uint256 cgId, uint256 epoch) external onlyContracts {\n        if (epoch >= chronos.getCurrentEpoch()) {\n            revert FutureOrCurrentEpoch();\n        }\n        if (epoch <= cgLastFinalizedEpoch[cgId]) {\n            return;\n        }\n        _finalizeCGValueUpTo(cgId, epoch);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Crystallizes `totalValueCumulative` up to `epoch`. See\n     *         {finalizeCGValueUpTo} for semantics.\n     * @dev Reverts FutureOrCurrentEpoch if `epoch` is at or beyond the current\n     *      epoch. Only past epochs may be finalized; current-epoch reads always\n     *      take the simulation path to reflect in-flight diff writes.\n     */\n    function finalizeGlobalValueUpTo(uint256 epoch) external onlyContracts {\n        if (epoch >= chronos.getCurrentEpoch()) {\n            revert FutureOrCurrentEpoch();\n        }\n        if (epoch <= globalLastFinalizedEpoch) {\n            return;\n        }\n        _finalizeGlobalValueUpTo(epoch);\n    }\n\n    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Read helpers\n    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    /// @notice Active per-epoch contribution of `cgId` at `epoch` (sum of all\n    ///         active KAs' per-epoch values at that epoch). Returns the\n    ///         simulated value if the epoch has not been finalized yet.\n    function getCGValueAtEpoch(uint256 cgId, uint256 epoch) public view returns (uint256) {\n        if (epoch <= cgLastFinalizedEpoch[cgId]) {\n            return cgValueCumulative[cgId][epoch];\n        }\n        return _simulateCGValueFinalization(cgId, epoch);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Global sum across all CGs of active per-epoch contributions at `epoch`.\n    function getTotalValueAtEpoch(uint256 epoch) public view returns (uint256) {\n        if (epoch <= globalLastFinalizedEpoch) {\n            return totalValueCumulative[epoch];\n        }\n        return _simulateGlobalValueFinalization(epoch);\n    }\n\n    function getCurrentCGValue(uint256 cgId) external view returns (uint256) {\n        return getCGValueAtEpoch(cgId, chronos.getCurrentEpoch());\n    }\n\n    function getCurrentTotalValue() external view returns (uint256) {\n        return getTotalValueAtEpoch(chronos.getCurrentEpoch());\n    }\n\n    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Internal finalization\n    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    function _finalizeCGValueUpTo(uint256 cgId, uint256 epoch) internal {\n        uint256 lastFinalized = cgLastFinalizedEpoch[cgId];\n        if (epoch <= lastFinalized) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        uint256 startEpoch = lastFinalized + 1;\n        int256 running;\n        if (lastFinalized > 0) {\n            running = int256(cgValueCumulative[cgId][lastFinalized]);\n        }\n\n        for (uint256 e = startEpoch; e <= epoch; e++) {\n            running += cgValueDiff[cgId][e];\n            // Cumulative values are non-negative by construction (positive diffs\n            // at startEpoch are always matched by negative diffs at\n            // startEpoch+lifetime). Revert defensively on underflow.\n            if (running < 0) {\n                revert NegativeCumulative();\n            }\n            cgValueCumulative[cgId][e] = uint256(running);\n        }\n\n        cgLastFinalizedEpoch[cgId] = epoch;\n\n        emit CGValueFinalized(cgId, startEpoch, epoch);\n    }\n\n    function _finalizeGlobalValueUpTo(uint256 epoch) internal {\n        uint256 lastFinalized = globalLastFinalizedEpoch;\n        if (epoch <= lastFinalized) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        uint256 startEpoch = lastFinalized + 1;\n        int256 running;\n        if (lastFinalized > 0) {\n            running = int256(totalValueCumulative[lastFinalized]);\n        }\n\n        for (uint256 e = startEpoch; e <= epoch; e++) {\n            running += totalValueDiff[e];\n            if (running < 0) {\n                revert NegativeCumulative();\n            }\n            totalValueCumulative[e] = uint256(running);\n        }\n\n        globalLastFinalizedEpoch = epoch;\n\n        emit GlobalValueFinalized(startEpoch, epoch);\n    }\n\n    function _simulateCGValueFinalization(uint256 cgId, uint256 epoch) internal view returns (uint256) {\n        uint256 lastFinalized = cgLastFinalizedEpoch[cgId];\n        if (epoch <= lastFinalized) {\n            return cgValueCumulative[cgId][epoch];\n        }\n\n        int256 running;\n        if (lastFinalized > 0) {\n            running = int256(cgValueCumulative[cgId][lastFinalized]);\n        }\n\n        for (uint256 e = lastFinalized + 1; e <= epoch; e++) {\n            running += cgValueDiff[cgId][e];\n            // Unify policy with the mutate path (`_finalizeCGValueUpTo`): a\n            // negative running total would signal ledger corruption and is an\n            // unrecoverable invariant break. Reverting here \u2014 even from a view\n            // function \u2014 gives RPC clients immediate visibility instead of\n            // silently clamping to zero.\n            if (running < 0) {\n                revert NegativeCumulative();\n            }\n        }\n\n        return uint256(running);\n    }\n\n    function _simulateGlobalValueFinalization(uint256 epoch) internal view returns (uint256) {\n        uint256 lastFinalized = globalLastFinalizedEpoch;\n        if (epoch <= lastFinalized) {\n            return totalValueCumulative[epoch];\n        }\n\n        int256 running;\n        if (lastFinalized > 0) {\n            running = int256(totalValueCumulative[lastFinalized]);\n        }\n\n        for (uint256 e = lastFinalized + 1; e <= epoch; e++) {\n            running += totalValueDiff[e];\n            if (running < 0) {\n                revert NegativeCumulative();\n            }\n        }\n\n        return uint256(running);\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x672a3540bac7f8d4f74a2dca2610d6254f800e6f468ce8ea4d1f5a8738ee092c","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/storage/ConvictionStakingStorage.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\nimport {Chronos} from \"./Chronos.sol\";\nimport {Guardian} from \"../Guardian.sol\";\nimport {ICustodian} from \"../interfaces/ICustodian.sol\";\nimport {INamed} from \"../interfaces/INamed.sol\";\nimport {IVersioned} from \"../interfaces/IVersioned.sol\";\nimport {HubLib} from \"../libraries/HubLib.sol\";\nimport {StakingLib} from \"../libraries/StakingLib.sol\";\nimport {IERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\nimport {SafeERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol\";\n\n/**\n * @title ConvictionStakingStorage\n * @notice Primary accounting store AND TRAC vault for V10 staking.\n *\n * V10 architecture (post-consolidation, v4.0.0):\n *   - CSS is the single source of truth for V10 staking: NFT-keyed positions,\n *     per-node stake aggregates, per-epoch operator-fee/net-rewards flags,\n *     per-node operator-fee balances + withdrawal queue, AND the TRAC vault.\n *     There is no separate `StakingStorage` in the V10 hot path.\n *   - The TRAC custody role moved here from V8 `StakingStorage` in v4.0.0:\n *     CSS now extends `Guardian`, so its `tokenContract` reference and\n *     `transferStake` outflow function come from the same base every V10\n *     publish/payment contract uses for vault-routed deposits. Vault-target\n *     consumers (`KnowledgeAssetsLifecycle`, `DKGKnowledgeAssets`, `Paymaster`,\n *     `PublishingConvictionAccount`, `DKGPublishingConvictionNFT`,\n *     `DKGStakingConvictionNFT`) resolve `hub.getContractAddress(\"ConvictionStakingStorage\")`\n *     for both deposits (TRAC `transferFrom` to CSS) and withdrawals\n *     (`StakingV10` calls `cs.transferStake`).\n *   - Migration to V10 is MANDATORY: every V8 delegator becomes a V10 NFT\n *     position. `RandomSampling.calculateNodeScore` therefore reads the\n *     timestamp-accurate effective stake here (raw TRAC \u00d7 active conviction\n *     multipliers), while raw stake gates still read `nodeStakeV10`. V8\n *     `StakingStorage` is deployed-but-unused dead code post-consolidation;\n *     only `StakingV10._convertToNFT` reads it (V8\u2192V10 drain at cutover).\n *\n * Rewards model (D19 \u2014 compound-into-raw):\n *   - The previous split-bucket model (separate `rewards` sidecar that\n *     always earned 1x) has been removed. Claimed rewards compound into\n *     `raw`, so they take on the position's current lock multiplier.\n *   - `cumulativeRewardsClaimed` is now a statistic-only counter for\n *     UI/indexer consumption; it never enters effective-stake math.\n *\n * Tier model (D20 \u2014 mutable wall-clock tier ladder):\n *   - Tier durations and multipliers are stored in `_tiers` (keyed by\n *     `lockTier` id). The baseline ladder seeded at `initialize()` is\n *     {0\u2192(0s, 1x), 1\u2192(30d, 1.5x), 3\u2192(90d, 2x), 6\u2192(180d, 3.5x), 12\u2192(366d, 6x)}.\n *   - `expiryTimestamp = block.timestamp + duration`, rounded UP to the\n *     next 12-hour expiry bucket. The upward rounding keeps the promised\n *     minimum lock duration while coalescing per-block dust stakes into\n *     one queue slot per half-day.\n *   - New tiers can be appended via `addTier` (HubOwner or multisig owner).\n *     Existing tiers can be deactivated via `deactivateTier` to stop\n *     accepting NEW fresh stakes, but relock / migration paths still\n *     honor the original commitment (existence-only check). The model is\n *     additive-only: once added a tier id cannot be removed.\n *\n * Effective-stake accounting (D26 \u2014 timestamp-accurate):\n *   - Each node carries a `runningNodeEffectiveStake[id]` settled at\n *     `nodeLastSettledAt[id]`, plus a sorted queue of pending boost-\n *     expiry drops (`nodeExpiryTimes[id]` / `nodeExpiryDrop[id][ts]`)\n *     with a monotonic head cursor `nodeExpiryHead[id]`.\n *   - `settleNodeTo(id, ts)` advances the running stake to `ts` by\n *     draining all expiry entries whose timestamp is <= ts. Called by\n *     every CSS mutator before applying its own delta, and by\n *     `RandomSampling.submitProof` before integrating score.\n *   - This replaces the v2.x epoch-diff accumulator (effectiveStakeDiff,\n *     nodeEffectiveStakeDiff, lastFinalizedEpoch, finalize*). Past-epoch\n *     effective-stake snapshots are no longer reconstructable from CSS;\n *     consumers that need them should settle and read \"current\" state.\n */\ncontract ConvictionStakingStorage is INamed, IVersioned, Guardian {\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n\n    string private constant _NAME = \"ConvictionStakingStorage\";\n    // Version history:\n    //   1.1.0 \u2014 split-bucket rewards, discrete tier ladder.\n    //   1.2.0 \u2014 V10-native pending-withdrawal storage (create/delete/get).\n    //   2.0.0 \u2014 V10 canonical store (positions + per-node aggregates +\n    //           absorbed DelegatorsInfo + tier constants).\n    //   2.1.0 \u2014 Mutable D20 tier ladder (lockTier rename, _tiers mapping).\n    //   2.2.0 \u2014 D14/D25 atomic-withdraw & in-place redelegate (removed\n    //           PendingWithdrawal).\n    //   3.0.0 \u2014 D26 timestamp-accurate effective-stake accounting:\n    //           * `Position.expiryEpoch` \u2192 `Position.expiryTimestamp`\n    //             (uint40 seconds-since-unix-epoch, NOT a Chronos epoch).\n    //           * Per-node running effective-stake with a sorted pending-\n    //             expiry queue. (uint256(raw) * uint256(oldMultiplier18)) / SCALE18\n            : uint256(raw);\n        _applyNodeStakeDelta(identityId, -int256(effectiveNowOld));\n        if (oldStillBoosted && oldMultiplier18 > SCALE18) {\n            uint256 oldBoost = (uint256(raw) * (uint256(oldMultiplier18) - SCALE18)) / SCALE18;\n            _cancelNodeExpiry(identityId, oldExpiryTs, oldBoost);\n        }\n\n        // --- Install new contribution (fresh lock starts now) ---\n        uint40 newExpiryTs = _computeExpiryTimestamp(newLockTier);\n        uint256 effectiveNowNew = (uint256(raw) * uint256(newMultiplier18)) / SCALE18;\n        _applyNodeStakeDelta(identityId, int256(effectiveNowNew));\n        if (newLockTier > 0 && newMultiplier18 > SCALE18) {\n            uint256 newBoost = (uint256(raw) * (uint256(newMultiplier18) - SCALE18)) / SCALE18;\n            _scheduleNodeExpiry(identityId, newExpiryTs, newBoost);\n        }\n\n        // --- Write new position preserving stats; delete old ---\n        positions[newTokenId] = Position({\n            raw: raw,\n            lockTier: newLockTier,\n            expiryTimestamp: newExpiryTs,\n            identityId: identityId,\n            cumulativeRewardsClaimed: old.cumulativeRewardsClaimed,\n            multiplier18: newMultiplier18,\n            lastClaimedEpoch: old.lastClaimedEpoch,\n            migrationEpoch: old.migrationEpoch\n        });\n        delete positions[oldTokenId];\n\n        // --- Per-node enumeration ---\n        _popNodeToken(identityId, oldTokenId);\n        _pushNodeToken(identityId, newTokenId);\n\n        // v10.0.3 \u2014 carries follow the position across the burn-mint so\n        // same-epoch redelegate\u2192relock sequences keep their pointers.\n        // `newTokenId` is freshly minted (monotonic counter, \"New token\n        // used\" guard above) so its carry list starts empty.\n        RewardCarry[] storage oldCarries = rewardCarries[oldTokenId];\n        uint256 carryCount = oldCarries.length;\n        if (carryCount > 0) {\n            RewardCarry[] storage newCarries = rewardCarries[newTokenId];\n            for (uint256 i; i < carryCount; i++) {\n                newCarries.push(oldCarries[i]);\n            }\n            delete rewardCarries[oldTokenId];\n        }\n\n        // nodeStakeV10 is invariant \u2014 same identity, same raw. No emit.\n\n        emit PositionReplaced(\n            oldTokenId,\n            newTokenId,\n            identityId,\n            raw,\n            newLockTier,\n            newExpiryTs,\n            newMultiplier18\n        );\n    }\n\n    function setLastClaimedEpoch(uint256 tokenId, uint32 epoch) external onlyContracts {\n        require(positions[tokenId].identityId != 0, \"No position\");\n        positions[tokenId].lastClaimedEpoch = epoch;\n        emit LastClaimedEpochUpdated(tokenId, epoch);\n    }\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //        v10.0.3 \u2014 Reward-carry mutators (see struct docs)\n    // ============================================================\n\n    /// @notice Record a pointer to an RSS delegator-score slot the\n    ///         position's current node/key no longer reaches. Idempotent\n    ///         per (identityId, epoch, delegatorKey): the RSS slot\n    ///         accumulates across repeat visits (e.g. A\u2192B\u2192A\u2192C in one\n    ///         epoch), so a single pointer integrates all of them.\n    function addRewardCarry(\n        uint256 tokenId,\n        uint72 identityId,\n        uint32 epoch,\n        bytes32 delegatorKey\n    ) external onlyContracts {\n        require(positions[tokenId].identityId != 0, \"No position\");\n        RewardCarry[] storage list = rewardCarries[tokenId];\n        uint256 len = list.length;\n        for (uint256 i; i < len; i++) {\n            RewardCarry storage c = list[i];\n            if (c.identityId == identityId && c.epoch == epoch && c.delegatorKey == delegatorKey) {\n                return;\n            }\n        }\n        require(len < MAX_REWARD_CARRIES, \"Carry limit\");\n        list.push(RewardCarry({identityId: identityId, epoch: epoch, delegatorKey: delegatorKey}));\n        emit RewardCarryAdded(tokenId, identityId, epoch, delegatorKey);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Drop every carry with `epoch <= maxEpoch` (already\n    ///         integrated by the caller's claim pass). Swap-and-pop from\n    ///         the tail so each swapped-in element was already visited.\n    function clearRewardCarries(uint256 tokenId, uint32 maxEpoch) external onlyContracts {\n        RewardCarry[] storage list = rewardCarries[tokenId];\n        uint256 removed;\n        uint256 i = list.length;\n        while (i > 0) {\n            i--;\n            if (list[i].epoch <= maxEpoch) {\n                list[i] = list[list.length - 1];\n                list.pop();\n                removed++;\n            }\n        }\n        if (removed > 0) {\n            emit RewardCarriesCleared(tokenId, maxEpoch, removed);\n        }\n    }\n\n    function getRewardCarries(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (RewardCarry[] memory) {\n        return rewardCarries[tokenId];\n    }\n\n    function setMigrationEpoch(uint256 tokenId, uint32 epoch) external onlyContracts {\n        require(positions[tokenId].identityId != 0, \"No position\");\n        positions[tokenId].migrationEpoch = epoch;\n        emit MigrationEpochSet(tokenId, epoch);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Set the V10 retroactive-claim anchor (D7).
