Prevents an admin (or a\n    ///         compromised admin) from silently rebinding the reward-history\n    ///         boundary mid-life.\n    function setV10LaunchEpoch(uint256 epoch) external onlyContracts {\n        require(v10LaunchEpoch == 0, \"V10 launch already set\");\n        v10LaunchEpoch = epoch;\n        emit V10LaunchEpochSet(epoch);\n    }\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //   Migration credit ledger mutators (onlyContracts)\n    // ============================================================\n\n    /// @notice Credit `delegator` with migrated TRAC. Driven by StakingV10's\n    ///         drain worker after the TRAC has been physically moved into this\n    ///         contract.\n    function addMigrationCredit(address delegator, uint96 total) external onlyContracts {\n        migrationCredit[delegator] += total;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Spend `amount` of `staker`'s migration credit for one allocation.\n    ///         Whether the tier-6/12 lock-credit applies is decided by the caller\n    ///         (StakingV10's allocate worker) from the chosen tier \u2014 there is no\n    ///         per-staker eligibility, so the spend is a plain debit.\n    function spendMigrationCredit(address staker, uint96 amount) external onlyContracts {\n        require(amount > 0, \"Zero amount\");\n        require(amount <= migrationCredit[staker], \"Amount exceeds credit\");\n        migrationCredit[staker] -= amount;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Set the V8\u2192V10 conviction lock-credit (seconds). The owner gate lives on the\n    ///         DKGStakingConvictionNFT entrypoint that drives this.\n    function setConvictionCreditSeconds(uint40 secondsValue) external onlyContracts {\n        require(uint256(secondsValue) < _tierDuration(6), \"credit >= tier-6 lock\");\n        convictionCreditSeconds = secondsValue;\n        emit ConvictionCreditSecondsSet(secondsValue);\n    }\n\n    function deletePosition(uint256 tokenId) external onlyContracts {\n        Position memory pos = positions[tokenId];\n        require(pos.identityId != 0, \"No position\");\n\n        uint40 tsNow = uint40(block.timestamp);\n        uint96 raw = pos.raw;\n        uint72 identityId = pos.identityId;\n        uint40 expiryTs = pos.expiryTimestamp;\n        uint64 multiplier18 = pos.multiplier18;\n        bool stillBoosted = expiryTs != 0 && tsNow < expiryTs;\n\n        _settleNodeTo(identityId, tsNow);\n\n        uint256 effectiveNow = stillBoosted\n            ? (uint256(raw) * uint256(multiplier18)) / SCALE18\n            : uint256(raw);\n        _applyNodeStakeDelta(identityId, -int256(effectiveNow));\n        if (stillBoosted && multiplier18 > SCALE18) {\n            uint256 boost = (uint256(raw) * (uint256(multiplier18) - SCALE18)) / SCALE18;\n            _cancelNodeExpiry(identityId, expiryTs, boost);\n        }\n\n        _popNodeToken(identityId, tokenId);\n        if (raw > 0) {\n            _decreaseNodeStakeV10(identityId, uint256(raw));\n        }\n\n        delete positions[tokenId];\n        // v10.0.3 \u2014 drop any leftover carries. `StakingV10.withdraw`\n        // auto-claims first, so only current-epoch (immature) carries can\n        // remain here \u2014 forfeited like all other current-epoch score.\n        delete rewardCarries[tokenId];\n        emit PositionDeleted(tokenId);\n    }\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //       D19 \u2014 Raw-only mutators (compound-into-raw model)\n    // ============================================================\n\n    function decreaseRaw(uint256 tokenId, uint96 amount) external onlyContracts {\n        Position storage pos = positions[tokenId];\n        require(pos.identityId != 0, \"No position\");\n        require(pos.raw >= amount, \"Insufficient raw\");\n        if (amount == 0) {\n            emit RawDecreased(tokenId, 0, pos.raw);\n            return;\n        }\n\n        uint40 tsNow = uint40(block.timestamp);\n        uint72 identityId = pos.identityId;\n        uint40 expiryTs = pos.expiryTimestamp;\n        uint64 multiplier18 = pos.multiplier18;\n        bool stillBoosted = expiryTs != 0 && tsNow < expiryTs;\n\n        _settleNodeTo(identityId, tsNow);\n\n        // G-6: remove the position's contribution as the ONE-SHOT delta from its\n        // current raw \u2014 floor(oldRaw*m) - floor(newRaw*m) \u2014 so the position's\n        // running-stake / boost contribution always equals floor(curRaw*m), exactly\n        // what the unwind paths (redelegate / relock / exit) later remove. No\n        // incremental-vs-one-shot floor asymmetry, so the strict helper invariants\n        // hold without saturation.\n        uint256 oldRaw = uint256(pos.raw);\n        uint256 newRaw = oldRaw - uint256(amount);\n        uint256 effDelta = stillBoosted\n            ? This replaces\n        // the prior floor(amount*m) increment, whose independent floor caused the\n        // incremental-vs-one-shot asymmetry that bricked redelegate/relock (audit\n        // G-6); the strict helper invariants now hold without saturation.\n        uint256 oldRaw = uint256(pos.raw);\n        uint256 newRaw = oldRaw + uint256(amount);\n        uint256 effDelta = stillBoosted\n            ? ((newRaw * uint256(multiplier18)) / SCALE18) - ((oldRaw * uint256(multiplier18)) / SCALE18)\n            : uint256(amount);\n        _applyNodeStakeDelta(identityId, int256(effDelta));\n\n        if pos.raw = pos.raw + amount;\n        _increaseNodeStakeV10(identityId, uint256(amount));\n\n        emit RawIncreased(tokenId, amount, pos.raw);\n    }\n\n    function addCumulativeRewardsClaimed(uint256 tokenId, uint96 amount) external onlyContracts {\n        Position storage pos = positions[tokenId];\n        require(pos.identityId != 0, \"No position\");\n The caller (KnowledgeAssetsLifecycle) computes `amount`\n    ///         (bounded by the consumed escrow) and passes the configured\n    ///         `protocolTreasury`; CSS performs only the gated transfer.\n    function transferRegistrationDepositFee(address treasury, uint96 amount) external onlyContracts {\n        // slither-disable-next-line unchecked-transfer\n        tokenContract.safeTransfer(treasury, amount);\n        emit RegistrationDepositFeeTransferred(treasury, amount);\n    }\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //                       Internal helpers\n    // ============================================================\n\n    /**\n     * @dev Wall-clock expiry computation (D26). Boosts last at least the tier\n     *      duration and expire on the next 12-hour bucket. Returns 0 for tier-0\n     *      (permanent rest state).\n     */\n    function _computeExpiryTimestamp(uint40 lockTier) internal view returns (uint40) {\n        if (lockTier == 0) return 0;\n        uint256 duration = _tierDuration(lockTier);\n        uint256 exp = block.timestamp + duration;\n        return _bucketExpiryTimestamp(exp);\n    }\n\n    function _bucketExpiryTimestamp(uint256 rawExpiry) internal pure returns (uint40) {\n        uint256 bucket = uint256(EXPIRY_BUCKET_SECONDS);\n        uint256 bucketed = ((rawExpiry + bucket - 1) / bucket) * bucket;\n        require(bucketed <= type(uint40).max, \"Expiry overflow\");\n        return uint40(bucketed);\n    }\n\n    function _pushNodeToken(uint72 identityId, uint256 tokenId) internal {\n        nodeTokenIndex[identityId][tokenId] = nodeTokens[identityId].length;\n        nodeTokens[identityId].push(tokenId);\n    }\n\n    function _popNodeToken(uint72 identityId, uint256 tokenId) internal {\n        uint256[] storage arr = nodeTokens[identityId];\n        uint256 idx = nodeTokenIndex[identityId][tokenId];\n        uint256 last = arr.length - 1;\n        if (idx != last) {\n            uint256 movedToken = arr[last];\n            arr[idx] = movedToken;\n            nodeTokenIndex[identityId][movedToken] = idx;\n        }\n        arr.pop();\n        delete nodeTokenIndex[identityId][tokenId];\n    }\n\n    function _increaseNodeStakeV10(uint72 identityId, uint256 amount) internal {\n        nodeStakeV10[identityId] += amount;\n        totalStakeV10 += amount;\n        emit NodeStakeV10Increased(identityId, amount, nodeStakeV10[identityId], totalStakeV10);\n    }\n\n    function _decreaseNodeStakeV10(uint72 identityId, uint256 amount) internal {\n        nodeStakeV10[identityId] -= amount;\n        totalStakeV10 -= amount;\n        emit NodeStakeV10Decreased(identityId, amount, nodeStakeV10[identityId], totalStakeV10);\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x52c35cbd4d06b4765f837089b13202cd1cca5023be8df9e481cdc00892acaa62","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/storage/DKGKnowledgeAssets.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\nimport {Guardian} from \"../Guardian.sol\";\nimport {ERC721} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC721/ERC721.sol\";\nimport {KnowledgeAssetLib} from \"../libraries/KnowledgeAssetLib.sol\";\nimport {INamed} from \"../interfaces/INamed.sol\";\nimport {IVersioned} from \"../interfaces/IVersioned.sol\";\nimport {HubDependent} from \"../abstract/HubDependent.sol\";\n\n/**\n * @title DKGKnowledgeAssets\n * @notice Greenfield KA storage: one ERC-721 per Knowledge Asset (`tokenId == kaId`),\n *         merkle-root history, economics, and ciphertext commitments. No ERC-1155.\n */\ncontract DKGKnowledgeAssets is INamed, IVersioned, HubDependent, ERC721, Guardian {\n\n    /// @dev `author` is the verified agent identity from the V10.1+\n    ///      author-attestation EIP-712 envelope, or `address(0)` for legacy\n    ///      callers (`KnowledgeAsset (V10.1 active path)`) that do not perform author\n    ///      attestation. Indexers SHOULD prefer this `indexed` field over\n    ///      walking storage when filtering KAs by author.\n    event KnowledgeAssetCreated(\n        uint256 indexed id,\n        address indexed author,\n        string publishOperationId,\n        bytes32 merkleRoot,\n        uint88 byteSize,\n        uint40 startEpoch,\n        uint40 endEpoch,\n        uint96 tokenAmount,\n        bool isImmutable\n    );\n    event KnowledgeAssetUpdated(\n        uint256 indexed id,\n        address indexed author,\n        string updateOperationId,\n        bytes32 merkleRoot,\n        uint256 byteSize,\n        uint96 tokenAmount\n    );\n    event KnowledgeAssetsMinted(uint256 indexed id, address indexed to, uint256 startId, uint256 endId);\n    event KnowledgeAssetsBurned(uint256 indexed id, address indexed from, uint256[] tokenIds);\n    event KnowledgeAssetPublisherUpdated(uint256 indexed id, address publisher);\n    event KnowledgeAssetMerkleRootsUpdated(uint256 indexed id, KnowledgeAssetLib.MerkleRoot[] merkleRoots);\n    event KnowledgeAssetMerkleRootAdded(uint256 indexed id, bytes32 merkleRoot);\n    event KnowledgeAssetMerkleRootRemoved(uint256 indexed id, bytes32 merkleRoot);\n    event KnowledgeAssetMintedUpdated(uint256 indexed id, uint256 minted);\n    event KnowledgeAssetBurnedUpdated(uint256 indexed id, uint256[] burned);\n    event KnowledgeAssetByteSizeUpdated(uint256 indexed id, uint256 byteSize);\n    event KnowledgeAssetChunksAmountUpdated(uint256 indexed id, uint256 chunksAmount);\n    event KnowledgeAssetTokenAmountUpdated(uint256 indexed id, uint256 tokenAmount);\n    event KnowledgeAssetStartEpochUpdated(uint256 indexed id, uint256 startEpoch);\n    event KnowledgeAssetEndEpochUpdated(uint256 indexed id, uint256 endEpoch);\n    event URIUpdate(string newURI);\n\n    /// @notice OT-RFC-49 / WS-B: a per-KA PUBLIC `_catalog` commitment was set for\n    ///         curated random sampling. Emitted by `setCatalogCommitment`, called by\n    ///         `KnowledgeAssetsLifecycle._executePublishCore` immediately after\n    ///         `createKnowledgeAsset` when the publish input carries a non-zero\n    ///         `(catalogRoot, catalogLeafCount)` pair AND the owning CG is curated.\n    ///         Off-chain indexers consume this to know which KAs participate in the\n    ///         curated-CG sampling lottery (the picker treats missing commitments as\n    ///         \"skip this KA\").\n    event KnowledgeAssetCatalogCommitmentSet(\n        uint256 indexed id,\n        bytes32 catalogRoot,\n        uint32 catalogLeafCount\n    );\n\n    // --- OT-RFC-43 Option 1 (variant 1a) errors ---\n    /// @notice The supplied packed `kaId`'s high 160 bits (`kaId >> 96`) do not\n    ///         equal the attested author. A wallet may only mint KAs within its\n    ///         own namespace (OT-RFC-43 \u00a74).\n    error KaIdNamespaceMismatch(uint256 kaId, address author);\n    /// @notice The supplied (author, number) packs to a `kaId` that is already\n    ///         minted \u2014 a re-used reservation. Never a silent clobber.\n    error KaIdAlreadyMinted(uint256 kaId);\n    /// @notice `getLatestKnowledgeAssetId` is deprecated under Option 1 \u2014 ids\n    ///         are packed (author<<96)|number and not globally sequential, so a\n    ///         single \"latest id\" is meaningless.\n    error GetLatestKnowledgeAssetIdDeprecated();\n\n    string private constant _NAME = \"DKGKnowledgeAssets\";\n    string private constant _VERSION = \"10.1.0\";\n\n    string private _tokenURI;\n\n    uint256 public immutable KNOWLEDGE_ASSET_BATCH_MAX_SIZE;\n\n    // OT-RFC-43 Option 1 (variant 1a): the global auto-increment id counter is\n    // retired \u2014 KA ids are now caller-supplied packed (author<<96)|number values\n    // minted in `createKnowledgeAsset`. This storage SLOT is retained (renamed,\n    // never written) so the layout of every field below is unchanged whether\n    // this contract is freshly deployed OR upgraded in place (R3 \u2014 proxy-vs-\n    // redeploy is unresolved; keeping the gap is safe under both). Do not\n    // repurpose without resolving R3.\n    // slither-disable-next-line unused-state,constable-states\n    uint256 private _deprecatedKnowledgeAssetsCounter;\n    uint256 private _totalMintedKnowledgeAssetsCounter;\n    // V10 retired burn semantics \u2014 `burnKnowledgeAssetsTokens` is a\n    // `pure` revert stub \u2014 so this counter is intentionally never\n    // written. Solidity zero-initializes it, and `totalBurned()`\n    // correctly returns 0 for legacy ABI consumers. The Slither\n    // directive silences the rule WITHOUT changing storage layout;\n    // making this `constant` would shift every slot declared below\n    // and is out of scope for an ABI-only legacy field.\n    // slither-disable-next-line uninitialized-state\n    uint256 private _totalBurnedKnowledgeAssetsCounter;\n\n    uint96 private _totalTokenAmount;\n\n    mapping(uint256 => KnowledgeAssetLib.KnowledgeAsset) public knowledgeAssets;\n    mapping(uint256 => bool) public isKnowledgeAssetBurned;\n\n    /// @dev Parallel mapping for V10.1+ author attestation.\n    ///\n    /// Why a parallel map and not a struct field on `MerkleRoot`:\n    /// `KnowledgeAsset.merkleRoots` is a dynamic array, so\n    /// extending its element struct from 3 to 4 storage slots would\n    /// shift the slot stride of every prior root entry \u2014 already-\n    /// deployed KAs would decode their historical\n    /// `publisher`/`merkleRoot`/`timestamp` from the wrong offsets.\n    /// Layout-preserving fix: keep `MerkleRoot` at 3 slots and store\n    /// the EIP-712-recovered author identity at\n    /// `merkleRootAuthors[kaId][rootIndex]`. Both the publish AND the\n    /// update path persist a verified EIP-712 author here (OT-RFC-45\n    /// owner-only update). `address(0)` means the state change at\n    /// `rootIndex` did not carry an attestation \u2014 i.e. legacy V8/V9\n    /// mutations and admin paths (`setMerkleRoots` / `pushMerkleRoot`,\n    /// which zero the slot by design).\n    /// Indexers SHOULD prefer the indexed `author` topic on\n    /// `KnowledgeAssetCreated` / `KnowledgeAssetUpdated`\n    /// events; this on-chain mapping is the canonical lookup for\n    /// `/api/knowledge-assets/:id/author` and SPARQL author-filter queries.\n    mapping(uint256 => mapping(uint256 => address)) public merkleRootAuthors;\n\n    /// @notice OT-RFC-49: DEAD \u2014 slot preserved for storage-layout stability.\n    ///\n    /// Formerly `ciphertextChunksRoots` (RFC-39 Phase A.5 curated ciphertext\n    /// commitment). RFC-49 (\"hosting follows access\") strips private ciphertext\n    /// from cores entirely, so cores can no longer prove a ciphertext chunk \u2014\n    /// the curated random-sampling commitment is now the PUBLIC `_catalog` root\n    /// (`catalogRoots` below). This slot is intentionally retained (not deleted)\n    /// so that removing it cannot shift the base slot of `_authorKaNumberHighWater`\n    /// or any later mapping; same discipline as `_deprecatedKnowledgeAssetsCounter`.\n    /// Never read or written after RFC-49.\n    mapping(uint256 => bytes32) private _deprecatedCiphertextChunksRoots;\n\n    /// @notice OT-RFC-49: DEAD \u2014 slot preserved. Formerly `ciphertextChunkCounts`.\n    /// See `_deprecatedCiphertextChunksRoots`. Superseded by `catalogLeafCounts`.\n    mapping(uint256 => uint32) private _deprecatedCiphertextChunkCounts;\n\n    /// @notice OT-RFC-43 Option 1 (variant 1a): per-author high-water KA `number`\n    ///         (the low 96 bits of the packed kaId), stored as `maxNumber + 1` so\n    ///         the default `0` unambiguously means \"this author has never minted\".\n    ///         Lets the off-chain allocator reconcile its cold-start floor with a\n    ///         single O(1) `getMaxKaNumberForAuthor` view instead of an unbounded\n    ///         `KnowledgeAssetCreated` log scan (which overflows the `eth_getLogs`\n    ///         block-range cap on networks with deep history). Appended at the END\n    ///         of storage to preserve the slot layout of every field above (see the\n    ///         layout note on `_deprecatedKnowledgeAssetsCounter`).\n    mapping(address => uint256) private _authorKaNumberHighWater;\n\n    /// @notice OT-RFC-49 / WS-B: per-KA PUBLIC `_catalog` Merkle root \u2014 the curated\n    ///         random-sampling commitment that replaces the stripped ciphertext one.\n    ///\n    /// Used by `RandomSampling._pickWeightedChallenge` (eligibility + leaf draw) and\n    /// `RandomSampling.submitProof` for curated CGs in place of the ciphertext root.\n    /// The root commits ONLY to the public `_catalog` leaves of the latest publish \u2014\n    /// the same plaintext triples cores host and serve under\n    /// `did:dkg:context-graph:<cgId>/_catalog`. Computed off-chain by\n    /// `computeCatalogRoot` (a dedicated `V10MerkleTree` over the catalog quads only;\n    /// the private sub-roots stay in `merkleRoots[]` for proof-of-existence but are\n    /// NEVER drawn). Set by `KnowledgeAssetsLifecycle._executePublishCore` for curated\n    /// CGs. Default `bytes32(0)` is the \"no catalog commitment\" sentinel that\n    /// `RandomSampling` uses to skip this KA in the curated draw (legacy KAs read 0 \u2192\n    /// grandfathered out until they re-publish post-RFC-49).\n    ///\n    /// Appended at the END of storage (after `_authorKaNumberHighWater`) to preserve\n    /// every existing slot; new slot space cannot masquerade old ciphertext roots as\n    /// catalog roots.\n    mapping(uint256 => bytes32) public catalogRoots;\n\n    /// @notice OT-RFC-49 / WS-B: per-KA PUBLIC `_catalog` leaf count (POST sort+dedupe,\n    ///         == `V10MerkleTree.leafCount`, NOT the raw catalog-quad count).\n    ///\n    /// The leaf-count input for the `chunkId = uint256(seed) % count` draw in\n    /// `RandomSampling._pickWeightedChallenge` step 3 for curated CGs, and the bounds\n    /// check in `submitProof`. Must equal the off-chain tree's `leafCount` exactly or\n    /// an honest prover cannot build a proof for a drawn `chunkId`.\n    mapping(uint256 => uint32) public catalogLeafCounts;\n\n    constructor(\n        address hubAddress,\n        uint256 _knowledgeAssetBatchMaxSize,\n        string memory uri\n    ) ERC721(\"DKG Knowledge Asset\", \"DKA\") Guardian(hubAddress) {\n        KNOWLEDGE_ASSET_BATCH_MAX_SIZE = _knowledgeAssetBatchMaxSize;\n        _tokenURI = uri;\n    }\n\n    function name() public pure virtual override(INamed, ERC721) returns (string memory) {\n        return _NAME;\n    }\n\n    function version() external pure virtual returns (string memory) {\n        return _VERSION;\n    }\n\n    function knowledgeAssetBatchMaxSize() external view returns (uint256) {\n        return KNOWLEDGE_ASSET_BATCH_MAX_SIZE;\n    }\n\n    function createKnowledgeAsset(\n        address publisher,\n        address author,\n        uint256 kaId,\n        string calldata publishOperationId,\n        bytes32 merkleRoot,\n        uint256 knowledgeAssetsAmount,\n        uint88 byteSize,\n        uint40 startEpoch,\n        uint40 endEpoch,\n        uint96 tokenAmount,\n        bool isImmutable,\n        uint32 merkleLeafCount\n    ) external onlyContracts returns (uint256) {\n        if (knowledgeAssetsAmount != 1) {\n            revert KnowledgeAssetLib.ExceededKnowledgeAssetBatchSize(0, 0, knowledgeAssetsAmount, 1);\n        }\n\n        // OT-RFC-43 Option 1 (variant 1a): the KA id is supplied by the caller\n        // (the off-chain allocator) as a deterministic packed value\n        // kaId = (uint160(author) << 96) | uint96(number). The high 160 bits\n        // MUST equal the attested author, so a wallet can only mint within its\n        // own namespace. Unforgeable: `author` is proven by the EIP-712\n        // attestation in `KnowledgeAssetsLifecycle._verifyAuthorAttestation`\n        // before this call. NB: the namespace binds to the attested AUTHOR\n        // (EIP-712 signer / initial NFT owner), a deliberate divergence from\n        // OT-RFC-43 \u00a77's `msg.sender`/publisher diagram \u2014 the two coincide in\n        // the dominant self-publish case. The global `++_knowledgeAssetsCounter`\n        // is removed under 1a (packed-only; no post-tx canonical id).\n        if ((kaId >> 96) != uint256(uint160(author))) {\n            revert KaIdNamespaceMismatch(kaId, author);\n        }\n        // Fail fast on a re-used (author, number): the id must not already be\n        // minted. `_safeMint` below would also revert, but checking here keeps\n        // checks-effects-interactions ordering (no state mutation before the\n        // guard) and surfaces a precise error. `kaId` is guaranteed non-zero\n        // because `author != address(0)` (enforced upstream), so the `0`\n        // sentinel used by `getKnowledgeAssetId` / `isPartOfKnowledgeAsset` is\n        // never produced here.\n        if (_ownerOf(kaId) != address(0)) {\n            revert KaIdAlreadyMinted(kaId);\n        }\n        // Defense-in-depth (audit hardening): assert the KA struct slot is\n        // pristine, not merely unowned. `_ownerOf` proves the token was never\n        // minted, but `onlyContracts` setters (`setMerkleRoots` / `pushMerkleRoot`)\n        // could in principle pre-seed `knowledgeAssets[kaId]` for an unminted id,\n        // which would make the index-0 `merkleRootAuthors` write below land at the\n        // wrong index. Under the retired `++_knowledgeAssetsCounter` scheme a fresh\n        // id was structurally never-touched; with caller-supplied ids we assert it.\n        if (knowledgeAssets[kaId].merkleRoots.length != 0) {\n            revert KaIdAlreadyMinted(kaId);\n        }\n\n        uint256 knowledgeAssetId = kaId;\n\n        KnowledgeAssetLib.KnowledgeAsset storage ka = knowledgeAssets[knowledgeAssetId];\n\n        ka.merkleRoots.push(\n            KnowledgeAssetLib.MerkleRoot(publisher, merkleRoot, block.timestamp)\n        );\n        // First root of a fresh KA \u2014 index 0. `kaId` was just proven unminted\n        // above (and `_safeMint` re-enforces it), so this parallel slot is\n        // empty; the unconditional shape is kept for parity with\n        // `updateKnowledgeAsset` below, where the index can have been\n        // previously used (post-pop).\n        merkleRootAuthors[knowledgeAssetId][ka.merkleRoots.length - 1] = author;\n        ka.byteSize = byteSize;\n        ka.startEpoch = startEpoch;\n        ka.endEpoch = endEpoch;\n        ka.tokenAmount = tokenAmount;\n        ka.isImmutable = isImmutable;\n        ka.merkleLeafCount = merkleLeafCount;\n\n        unchecked {\n            _totalTokenAmount += tokenAmount;\n        }\n\n        ka.minted = 1;\n        _totalMintedKnowledgeAssetsCounter += 1;\n\n        // OT-RFC-43 Option 1: record the per-author high-water `number` BEFORE the\n        // `_safeMint` interaction (checks-effects-interactions \u2014 `_safeMint` calls\n        // `onERC721Received` on a contract recipient). Stored as `number + 1` so the\n        // default 0 means \"never minted\"; only ever raised, never lowered, so a\n        // gap-filling mint of a lower number can never regress the floor. Backs the\n        // O(1) `getMaxKaNumberForAuthor` allocator reconcile.\n        uint256 mintedNumber = uint96(knowledgeAssetId); // low 96 bits = per-author number\n        if (mintedNumber + 1 > _authorKaNumberHighWater[author]) {\n            _authorKaNumberHighWater[author] = mintedNumber + 1;\n        }\n\n        _safeMint(author, knowledgeAssetId);\n\n        emit KnowledgeAssetCreated(\n            knowledgeAssetId,\n            author,\n            publishOperationId,\n            merkleRoot,\n            byteSize,\n            startEpoch,\n            endEpoch,\n            tokenAmount,\n            isImmutable\n        );\n\n        return knowledgeAssetId;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice OT-RFC-43 Option 1 (variant 1a): the highest KA `number` already\n    ///         minted under `author` (the low 96 bits of its packed kaId), or `-1`\n    ///         if `author` has never minted a KA.\n    /// @dev    O(1) replacement for enumerating `KnowledgeAssetCreated(id, author)`\n    ///         logs. The off-chain allocator's next number for `author` is\n    ///         `getMaxKaNumberForAuthor(author) + 1`, so a brand-new author (result\n    ///         `-1`) correctly starts at number 0. Returns `int256` so \"never minted\"\n    ///         is a true sentinel rather than colliding with a legitimately-minted\n    ///         number 0.\n    ///\n    ///         PRECONDITION \u2014 not backfilled across an in-place storage upgrade.\n    ///         `_authorKaNumberHighWater` is only populated by `createKnowledgeAsset`\n    ///         from this version (10.0.4) onward. On a fresh deploy or redeploy \u2014 the\n    ///         expected path, where every KA is minted under this contract \u2014 it is\n    ///         authoritative for ALL of an author's KAs. But if this storage is\n    ///         upgraded IN PLACE over a pre-10.0.4 deployment that already minted KAs,\n    ///         those historical authors read `-1` until their next mint. Such an\n    ///         in-place upgrade is not supported unless the mapping is backfilled or\n    ///         the allocator is explicitly configured to reconcile historical mints by\n    ///         another source. The repository deployment flow is a fresh asset-storage\n    ///         redeploy/Hub rotation, not bytecode replacement over existing storage.\n    /// @param  author The attested author address (the high 160 bits of a packed kaId).\n    /// @return The highest KA `number` already minted under `author`, or `-1` if none.\n    function getMaxKaNumberForAuthor(address author) external view returns (int256) {\n        uint256 highWater = _authorKaNumberHighWater[author];\n        return highWater == 0 ? int256(-1) : int256(highWater) - 1;\n    }\n\n    function getKnowledgeAsset(\n        uint256 id\n    ) external view returns (KnowledgeAssetLib.KnowledgeAsset memory) {\n        return knowledgeAssets[id];\n    }\n\n    /// @dev `author` is the verified author identity for this update. The\n    ///      V10.1 update path attests the author (EIP-712) and enforces\n    ///      owner-only in `KnowledgeAssetsLifecycle._executeUpdateCore`\n    ///      (OT-RFC-45), so callers on that path pass a non-zero, verified\n    ///      author. `address(0)` only on admin/legacy paths that carry no\n    ///      attestation.\n    function updateKnowledgeAsset(\n        address publisher,\n        address author,\n        uint256 id,\n        string calldata updateOperationId,\n        bytes32 merkleRoot,\n        uint256 mintKnowledgeAssetsAmount,\n        uint256[] calldata knowledgeAssetsToBurn,\n        uint88 byteSize,\n        uint96 tokenAmount,\n        uint32 merkleLeafCount\n    ) external onlyContracts {\n        KnowledgeAssetLib.KnowledgeAsset storage ka = knowledgeAssets[id];\n\n        unchecked {\n            _totalTokenAmount = _totalTokenAmount - ka.tokenAmount + tokenAmount;\n        }\n\n        ka.merkleRoots.push(\n            KnowledgeAssetLib.MerkleRoot(publisher, merkleRoot, block.timestamp)\n        );\n        // Unconditional overwrite \u2014 this index may have been written by\n        // a previous create/update and then popped via `popMerkleRoot`,\n        // leaving the stale author in the parallel slot. Always write\n        // the current `author` (the verified EIP-712 author the V10.1\n        // lifecycle update path supplies; `address(0)` only on admin/legacy\n        // paths) to make the canonical mapping monotonic with the\n        // merkleRoots array.\n        merkleRootAuthors[id][ka.merkleRoots.length - 1] = author;\n        ka.byteSize = byteSize;\n        ka.tokenAmount = tokenAmount;\n        ka.merkleLeafCount = merkleLeafCount;\n\n        // Burn with an empty list is a no-op (the inner for-loop over\n        // tokenIds skips when length == 0). Mint with amount == 0 was\n        // previously unconditionally dispatched to `_mintWithoutCheck`,\n        // which reverts `MintZeroQuantity` on zero \u2014 blocking true\n        // metadata-only updates (delta == 0, no mint, no burn) that the\n        // KnowledgeAssetsV10 update flow explicitly documents as\n        // supported. Guard the mint call so metadata-only rotations work\n        // end-to-end. See Codex review round 2, finding 6.\n        if (mintKnowledgeAssetsAmount != 0 || knowledgeAssetsToBurn.length != 0) {\n            revert KnowledgeAssetLib.ExceededKnowledgeAssetBatchSize(\n                id,\n                ka.minted,\n                mintKnowledgeAssetsAmount,\n                0\n            );\n        }\n\n        emit KnowledgeAssetUpdated(id, author, updateOperationId, merkleRoot, byteSize, tokenAmount);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Lightweight update-path metadata \u2014 scalar fields only + the\n    /// pre-update merkle-root count. Intended for callers (e.g.\n    /// `KnowledgeAssetsV10._executeUpdateCore`) that need the state\n    /// summary but NOT the full history arrays.\n    ///\n    /// Problem: `getKnowledgeAssetMetadata` performs a full\n    /// storage \u2192 memory struct copy, which walks every entry of\n    /// `merkleRoots[]` and `burned[]`. Because both arrays grow\n    /// monotonically on every update, the memory cost (and thus gas\n    /// cost) of calling that getter from the update path itself scales\n    /// linearly \u2014 actually super-linearly due to EVM memory-expansion\n    /// quadratic term \u2014 with the number of prior updates. A KA with\n    /// thousands of historical entries eventually becomes un-updatable.\n    ///\n    /// This getter returns only the scalar slots and the merkle-root\n    /// chain length (as a plain `uint256`), so the update path's gas\n    /// cost is constant regardless of history.\n    ///\n    /// Codex review round 3 finding 1.\n    function getKnowledgeAssetUpdateContext(\n        uint256 id\n    )\n        external\n        view\n        returns (\n            uint256 merkleRootsCount,\n            uint256 minted,\n            uint88 byteSize,\n            uint40 endEpoch,\n            uint96 tokenAmount,\n            bool isImmutable,\n            uint32 merkleLeafCount\n        )\n    {\n        KnowledgeAssetLib.KnowledgeAsset storage ka = knowledgeAssets[id];\n        return (\n            ka.merkleRoots.length,\n            ka.minted,\n            ka.byteSize,\n            ka.endEpoch,\n            ka.tokenAmount,\n            ka.isImmutable,\n            ka.merkleLeafCount\n        );\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Leaf count for the V10 flat-KA Merkle tree at latest root\n    ///         (see `merkleLeafCount` on `KnowledgeAsset`).\n    function getMerkleLeafCount(uint256 id) external view returns (uint32) {\n        return knowledgeAssets[id].merkleLeafCount;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice OT-RFC-49 / WS-B: write the curated PUBLIC `_catalog` commitment for\n    ///         a freshly-created (or updated) KA. Caller must enforce the curated-CG\n    ///         gate \u2014 KAS does not look at `ContextGraphStorage` to keep the storage\n    ///         layer policy-free.\n    ///\n    ///         Both fields must be non-zero \u2014 partial commitments (a non-zero root\n    ///         with zero count, or vice versa) are forbidden because they would\n    ///         silently de-rail the picker (zero count \u2192 divide-by-zero in the\n    ///         catalog-leaf draw, zero root \u2192 proof verification against an empty\n    ///         tree). `KnowledgeAssetsLifecycle` normalises \"no commitment\" to a\n    ///         literal no-call (no event emitted, both slots stay at default zero).\n    ///         Unlike the stripped ciphertext commitment, the catalog commitment is\n    ///         re-set on every curated update so the random-sampling surface tracks\n    ///         the latest published `_catalog`.\n    function setCatalogCommitment(\n        uint256 id,\n        bytes32 catalogRoot,\n        uint32 catalogLeafCount\n    ) external onlyContracts {\n        require(\n            catalogRoot != bytes32(0) && catalogLeafCount > 0,\n            \"Invalid catalog commitment\"\n        );\n        catalogRoots[id] = catalogRoot;\n        catalogLeafCounts[id] = catalogLeafCount;\n\n        emit KnowledgeAssetCatalogCommitmentSet(id, catalogRoot, catalogLeafCount);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice OT-RFC-49 / WS-B: latest PUBLIC `_catalog` Merkle root for a curated\n    ///         KA, or `bytes32(0)` if no commitment was ever set (public KA, or a\n    ///         legacy curated KA that has not re-published since RFC-49).\n    ///         `RandomSampling` treats the zero sentinel as \"skip this KA in the\n    ///         curated draw\".\n    function getCatalogRoot(uint256 id) 1];\n        }\n\n        emit KnowledgeAssetMerkleRootRemoved(id, latestMerkleRoot);\n    }\n\n    function getMinted(uint256 id) external view returns (uint256) {\n        return knowledgeAssets[id].minted;\n    }\n\n    function setMinted(uint256 id, uint256 _minted) external onlyContracts {\n        knowledgeAssets[id].minted = _minted;\n\n        emit KnowledgeAssetMintedUpdated(id, _minted);\n    }\n\n    function getBurned(uint256 id) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {\n        return knowledgeAssets[id].burned;\n    }\n\n    function getBurnedAmount(uint256 id) external view returns (uint256) {\n        return knowledgeAssets[id].burned.length;\n    }\n\n    function setBurned(uint256 id, uint256[] calldata _burned) external onlyContracts {\n        knowledgeAssets[id].burned = _burned;\n\n        emit KnowledgeAssetBurnedUpdated(id, _burned);\n    }\n\n    function getByteSize(uint256 id) external view returns (uint88) {\n        return knowledgeAssets[id].byteSize;\n    }\n\n    function setByteSize(uint256 id, uint88 _byteSize) external onlyContracts {\n        knowledgeAssets[id].byteSize = _byteSize;\n\n        emit KnowledgeAssetByteSizeUpdated(id, _byteSize);\n    }\n\n    function getTokenAmount(uint256 id) external view returns (uint96) {\n        return knowledgeAssets[id].tokenAmount;\n    }\n\n    function setTokenAmount(uint256 id, uint96 _tokenAmount) external onlyContracts {\n        _totalTokenAmount = _totalTokenAmount - pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _VERSION;\n    }\n\n    function addEpochPublishingAllocation(\n        uint72 identityId,\n        uint256 epoch,\n        uint96 amount\n    ) external onlyContracts {\n        nodesEpochPublishingAllocation[identityId][epoch] += amount;\n        epochPublishingAllocation[epoch] += amount;\n\n        // Maintain the per-epoch node max so its (public) getters stay\n        // consistent. get(Node)EpochPublishingAllocation); it exists for off-chain\n    ///         observability, for which the high-water-mark semantic is correct.\n    function moveEpochPublishingAllocation(\n nodesEpochPublishingAllocation[toId][epoch] += amount; // epoch total unchanged -> K_total net-zero\n\n        if (nodesEpochPublishingAllocation[toId][epoch] > uint256 shardId,\n        uint256 startEpoch,\n        uint256 endEpoch,\n        uint96 tokenAmount\n    ) external onlyContracts {\n        // SECURITY FIX: a credit whose startEpoch is already FINALIZED is\n        // otherwise lost forever. `_finalizeEpochsUpTo` only folds `diff` for\n        // `(lastFinalizedEpoch, currentEpoch-1]` and never revisits a finalized\n        // epoch, so `diff[startEpoch] += p` at `startEpoch <= lastFinalizedEpoch`\n        // is never folded into `cumulative` (the tokens vanish \u2014 stranded in the\n        // contract with no payable pool entry) and the paired\n        // `diff[endEpoch+1] -= p` later under-credits an unrelated future epoch.\n        //\n        // Clamp the range up to `lastFinalizedEpoch + 1` \u2014 the first epoch NOT\n        // yet folded into `cumulative`, and therefore still payable (epochs above\n        // `lastFinalizedEpoch` are read via on-the-fly simulation in\n        // `getEpochPool`). This is the minimal correction: it rescues only the\n        // credits that were genuinely lost (finalized epochs) and lands them in\n        // the CLOSEST still-creditable epoch, preserving the caller's intended\n        // attribution as much as possible \u2014 PublishingConviction deliberately\n        // attributes a closed billing window to the chain epochs it overlapped,\n        // so forcing `currentEpoch` here would misattribute/delay those rewards\n        // on an idle shard. Any stricter \"settle into the current epoch\" policy\n        // belongs at the specific caller, not in this shared primitive. Clamp,\n        // don't revert: lazy past-window settlement is an intended pattern.\n        uint256 firstOpenEpoch = lastFinalizedEpoch[shardId] + 1;\n        if (startEpoch < firstOpenEpoch) {\n            startEpoch = firstOpenEpoch;\n            if (endEpoch < startEpoch) {\n                endEpoch = startEpoch;\n            }\n        }\n\n        uint256 numEpochs = endEpoch - startEpoch + 1;\n\n        uint96 totalTokens = tokenAmount + accumulatedRemainder[shardId];\n        uint96 tokensPerEpochU = uint96(totalTokens / numEpochs);\n        uint96 remainder = uint96(totalTokens % numEpochs);\n\n        accumulatedRemainder[shardId] = remainder;\n\n        int96 tokensPerEpoch = int96(tokensPerEpochU);\n\n        diff[shardId][startEpoch] += tokensPerEpoch;\n        diff[shardId][endEpoch + 1] -= tokensPerEpoch;\n\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch > 1) {\n            _finalizeEpochsUpTo(shardId, currentEpoch - 1);\n        }\n\n        emit TokensAddedToEpochRange(shardId, startEpoch, endEpoch, tokenAmount, remainder);\n    }\n\n    function payOutEpochTokens(\n        uint256 shardId,\n        uint256 epoch,\n        uint72 identityId,\n        uint96 amount\n    ) external onlyContracts {\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch > 1) {\n            _finalizeEpochsUpTo(shardId, currentEpoch - 1);\n        }\n\n        distributed[shardId][epoch] += amount;\n        nodesPaidOut[identityId][shardId][epoch] += amount;\n\n        emit shardId) external view returns (uint96) {\n        return getEpochRemainingPool(shardId, chronos.getCurrentEpoch());\n    }\n\n    function getPreviousEpochPool(uint256 shardId) external view returns (uint96) {\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch <= 1) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        return getEpochPool(shardId, currentEpoch - 1);\n    }\n\n    function getPreviousEpochRemainingPool(uint256 shardId) external view returns (uint96) {\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch <= 1) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        return getEpochRemainingPool(shardId, currentEpoch - 1);\n    }\n\n    function getEpochRangePool(uint256 shardId, uint256 startEpoch, uint256 endEpoch) external view startEpoch; epoch <= lastFinalized && epoch <= endEpoch; epoch++) {\n                totalPool += cumulative[shardId][epoch];\n            }\n        }\n\n        uint96 simulatedCumulative = lastFinalized > 0 ? cumulative[shardId][lastFinalized] : cumulative[shardId][1];\n        for (uint256 epoch = lastFinalized + 1; epoch <= endEpoch; epoch++) {\n            int96 tmp = int96(simulatedCumulative) + diff[shardId][epoch];\n            simulatedCumulative = uint96(tmp);\n            if (epoch >= startEpoch) {\n                totalPool += simulatedCumulative;\n            }\n        }\n\n        return totalPool;\n    }\n\n    function getEpochDistributedPool(uint256 shardId, uint256 epoch) external view returns (uint96) {\n        return distributed[shardId][epoch];\n    }\n\n    function getPreviousEpochDistributedPool(uint256 shardId) external view returns (uint96) {\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch <= 1) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        return distributed[shardId][currentEpoch - 1];\n    }\n\n    function getNodeEpochPaidOut(uint256 shardId, uint72 identityId, uint256 epoch) external view returns (uint96) {\n        return nodesPaidOut[identityId][shardId][epoch];\n    }\n\n    function getNodePreviousEpochPaidOut(uint256 shardId, uint72 identityId) external view returns (uint96) {\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch <= 1) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        return nodesPaidOut[identityId][shardId][currentEpoch - 1];\n    }\n\n    function _finalizeEpochsUpTo(uint256 shardId, uint256 epoch) internal {\n        uint256 startEpoch = lastFinalizedEpoch[shardId] + 1;\n        for (uint256 e = startEpoch; e <= epoch; e++) {\n            int96 prev = 0;\n            if (e > 1) {\n                prev = int96(cumulative[shardId][e - 1]);\n            }\n            cumulative[shardId][e] = uint96(prev + diff[shardId][e]);\n        }\n        lastFinalizedEpoch[shardId] = epoch;\n\n        emit EpochsFinalized(shardId, startEpoch, epoch);\n    }\n\n    function _simulateEpochFinalization(uint256 shardId, uint256 epoch) internal view returns (uint96) {\n        if (epoch <= lastFinalizedEpoch[shardId]) {\n            return cumulative[shardId][epoch];\n        }\n\n        uint96 simulatedCumulative = 0;\n        if (lastFinalizedEpoch[shardId] > 0) {\n            simulatedCumulative = cumulative[shardId][lastFinalizedEpoch[shardId]];\n        }\n\n        for (uint256 e = lastFinalizedEpoch[shardId] + 1; e <= epoch; e++) {\n            int96 prev = int96(simulatedCumulative);\n            int96 result = prev + diff[shardId][e];\n            simulatedCumulative = uint96(result);\n        }\n\n        return simulatedCumulative;\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x74fd4c074d1dbe46453f8ffb5ed1cf3db3ca100604d631b46f5be40860bd0835","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/storage/Hub.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\nimport {IContractStatus} from \"../interfaces/IContractStatus.sol\";\nimport {ICustodian} from \"../interfaces/ICustodian.sol\";\nimport {IInitializable} from \"../interfaces/IInitializable.sol\";\nimport {INamed} from \"../interfaces/INamed.sol\";\nimport {IVersioned} from \"../interfaces/IVersioned.sol\";\nimport {HubLib} from \"../libraries/HubLib.sol\";\nimport {UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet} from \"../libraries/UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.sol\";\nimport {Ownable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol\";\n\ncontract Hub is INamed, IVersioned, Ownable {\n    using UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet for UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Set;\n\n    event NewContract(string contractName, address newContractAddress);\n    event ContractChanged(string contractName, address newContractAddress);\n    event NewAssetStorage(string contractName, address newContractAddress);\n    event AssetStorageChanged(string contractName, address newContractAddress);\n    event ContractRemoved(string contractName, address contractAddress);\n    event AssetStorageRemoved(string contractName, address contractAddress);\n\n    string private constant _NAME = \"Hub\";\n    string private constant _VERSION = \"1.0.0\";\n\n    UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Set internal contractSet;\n    UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Set internal assetStorageSet;\n\n    constructor() Ownable(msg.sender) {}\n\n    // @dev Only transactions by HubController owner or one of the owners of the MultiSig Wallet\n    modifier onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner() {\n        _checkOwnerOrMultiSigOwner();\n        _;\n    }\n\n    function name() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _NAME;\n    }\n\n    function version() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _VERSION;\n    }\n\n    function setContractAddress(\n        string calldata contractName,\n        address newContractAddress\n    ) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        _setContractAddress(contractName, newContractAddress);\n    }\n\n    function setAssetStorageAddress(string calldata assetStorageName, address assetStorageAddress) external onlyOwner {\n        _setAssetStorageAddress(assetStorageName, assetStorageAddress);\n    }\n\n    function removeContractByName(string calldata contractName) external onlyOwner {\n        if (contractSet.exists(contractName)) {\n            address contractAddress = contractSet.get(contractName).addr;\n\n            contractSet.remove(contractName);\n\n            emit ContractRemoved(contractName, contractAddress);\n        }\n    }\n\n    function removeContractByAddress(address contractAddress) external onlyOwner {\n        if (contractSet.exists(contractAddress)) {\n            string memory contractName = contractSet.get(contractAddress).name;\n\n            contractSet.remove(contractAddress);\n\n            emit ContractRemoved(contractName, contractAddress);\n        }\n    }\n\n    function removeAssetStorageByName(string calldata assetStorageName) external onlyOwner {\n        if (assetStorageSet.exists(assetStorageName)) {\n            address assetStorageAddress = assetStorageSet.get(assetStorageName).addr;\n\n            assetStorageSet.remove(assetStorageName);\n\n            emit AssetStorageRemoved(assetStorageName, assetStorageAddress);\n        }\n    }\n\n    function removeAssetStorageByAddress(address assetStorageAddress) external onlyOwner {\n        if (assetStorageSet.exists(assetStorageAddress)) {\n            string memory assetStorageName = assetStorageSet.get(assetStorageAddress).name;\n\n            assetStorageSet.remove(assetStorageAddress);\n\n            emit AssetStorageRemoved(assetStorageName, assetStorageAddress);\n        }\n    }\n\n    function getContractAddress(string calldata contractName) external view returns (address) {\n        return contractSet.get(contractName).addr;\n    }\n\n    function getAssetStorageAddress(string calldata assetStorageName) external view returns (address) {\n        return assetStorageSet.get(assetStorageName).addr;\n    }\n\n    function getAllContracts() external view returns (UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Contract[] memory) {\n        return contractSet.getAll();\n    }\n\n    function getAllAssetStorages() external view returns (UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Contract[] memory) {\n        return assetStorageSet.getAll();\n    }\n\n    function isContract(string calldata contractName) external view returns (bool) {\n        return contractSet.exists(contractName);\n    }\n\n    function isContract(address selectedContractAddress) external view returns (bool) {\n        return contractSet.exists(selectedContractAddress);\n    }\n\n    function isAssetStorage(string calldata assetStorageName) external view returns (bool) {\n        return assetStorageSet.exists(assetStorageName);\n    }\n\n    function isAssetStorage(address assetStorageAddress) external view returns (bool) {\n        return assetStorageSet.exists(assetStorageAddress);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @dev Forwards a function call to a specified target contract.\n     * @notice This function can only be called by the contract owner or a multisig owner.\n     * @param target The address of the target contract.\n     * @param data The calldata containing the function signature and arguments for the target contract's function.\n     * @return result The return data of the target contract's function call.\n     */\n    function forwardCall(address target, bytes calldata data) public onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner returns (bytes memory) {\n        // Check if the target contract is registered in the Hub\n        if (!contractSet.exists(target) && !assetStorageSet.exists(target)) {\n            revert HubLib.InvalidTargetContract(target);\n        }\n\n        // Perform the function call to the target contract with the specified calldata\n        (bool success, bytes memory result) = target.call{value: 0}(data);\n\n        // If the call is unsuccessful, revert the transaction with the original revert reason\n        if (!success) {\n            assembly {\n                // Load the free memory pointer from memory slot 0x40\n                // Memory slot 0x40 is conventionally used to store the free memory pointer in Solidity, which points\n                // to the next available memory slot for storing data during the execution of a contract function.\n                let ptr := mload(0x40)\n                // Get the size of the return data from the unsuccessful call\n                let size := returndatasize()\n                // Copy the return data to the memory location pointed to by ptr\n                returndatacopy(ptr, 0, size)\n                // Revert the transaction with the return data as the revert reason\n                revert(ptr, size)\n            }\n        }\n\n        return result;\n    }\n\n    function setAndReinitializeContracts(\n        HubLib.Contract[] calldata newContracts,\n        HubLib.Contract[] calldata newAssetStorageContracts,\n        address[] calldata contractsToReinitialize,\n        HubLib.ForwardCallInputArgs[] calldata forwardCallsData\n    ) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        _setContracts(newContracts);\n        _setAssetStorageContracts(newAssetStorageContracts);\n        _reinitializeContracts(contractsToReinitialize);\n        _forwardCalls(forwardCallsData);\n    }\n\n    function _setContractAddress(string calldata contractName, address newContractAddress) internal {\n        if (contractSet.exists(contractName)) {\n            contractSet.update(contractName, newContractAddress);\n\n            address oldContractAddress = contractSet.get(contractName).addr;\n            if (_isContract(oldContractAddress)) {\n                try IContractStatus(oldContractAddress).setStatus(false) {\n                    // success\n                } catch {\n                    // Best-effort: contract may not implement IContractStatus; ignore.\n                }\n            }\n\n            emit ContractChanged(contractName, newContractAddress);\n        } else {\n            contractSet.append(contractName, newContractAddress);\n\n            emit NewContract(contractName, newContractAddress);\n        }\n\n        if (_isContract(newContractAddress)) {\n            try IContractStatus(newContractAddress).setStatus(true) {\n                // success\n            } catch {\n                // Best-effort: contract may not implement IContractStatus; ignore.\n            }\n        }\n\n        emit NewContract(contractName, newContractAddress);\n    }\n\n    function _setContracts(HubLib.Contract[] calldata newContracts) internal {\n        for (uint256 i; i < newContracts.length; ) {\n            _setContractAddress(newContracts[i].name, newContracts[i].addr);\n\n            unchecked {\n                i++;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    function _setAssetStorageAddress(string calldata assetStorageName, address assetStorageAddress) internal {\n        if (assetStorageSet.exists(assetStorageName)) {\n            emit AssetStorageChanged(assetStorageName, assetStorageAddress);\n            assetStorageSet.update(assetStorageName, assetStorageAddress);\n        } else {\n            emit NewAssetStorage(assetStorageName, assetStorageAddress);\n            assetStorageSet.append(assetStorageName, assetStorageAddress);\n        }\n    }\n\n    function _setAssetStorageContracts(HubLib.Contract[] calldata newAssetStorageContracts) internal {\n        for (uint256 i; i < newAssetStorageContracts.length; ) {\n            _setAssetStorageAddress(newAssetStorageContracts[i].name, newAssetStorageContracts[i].addr);\n\n            unchecked {\n                i++;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    function _reinitializeContracts(address[] calldata contractsToReinitialize) internal {\n        for (uint256 i; i < contractsToReinitialize.length; ) {\n            IInitializable(contractsToReinitialize[i]).initialize();\n            unchecked {\n                i++;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    function _forwardCalls(HubLib.ForwardCallInputArgs[] calldata forwardCallsData) internal {\n        for (uint256 i; i < forwardCallsData.length; ) {\n            address contractAddress;\n\n            // Try to get the contract address using getContractAddress\n            try this.getContractAddress(forwardCallsData[i].contractName) returns (address addr) {\n                contractAddress = addr;\n            } catch {\n                // If getContractAddress fails, try getAssetStorageAddress\n                try this.getAssetStorageAddress(forwardCallsData[i].contractName) returns (address addr) {\n                    contractAddress = addr;\n                } catch {\n                    revert HubLib.ContractNotRegistered(forwardCallsData[i].contractName);\n                }\n            }\n            for (uint256 j; j < forwardCallsData[i].encodedData.length; ) {\n                forwardCall(contractAddress, forwardCallsData[i].encodedData[j]);\n                unchecked {\n                    j++;\n                }\n            }\n            unchecked {\n                i++;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    function _isContract(address addr) internal view returns (bool) {\n        uint256 size;\n        assembly {\n            size := extcodesize(addr)\n        }\n        return size > 0;\n    }\n\n    function _isMultiSigOwner(address multiSigAddress) internal view returns (bool) {\n        try ICustodian(multiSigAddress).getOwners() returns (address[] memory multiSigOwners) {\n            for (uint256 i = 0; i < multiSigOwners.length; i++) {\n                if (msg.sender == multiSigOwners[i]) {\n                    return true;\n                }\n            }\n        } catch {\n            // Not a multisig or call reverted; treat as not owner.\n        }\n\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    function _checkOwnerOrMultiSigOwner() internal view virtual {\n        address hubOwner = owner();\n        if (msg.sender != hubOwner && !_isMultiSigOwner(hubOwner)) {\n            revert HubLib.UnauthorizedAccess(\"Only Hub Owner or Multisig Owner\");\n        }\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x732252bb857277a35ab314beef2dbaceb5f96ce2f6d3b83a224927e503609def","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/storage/IdentityStorage.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\nimport {HubDependent} from \"../abstract/HubDependent.sol\";\nimport {IERC734Extended} from \"../interfaces/IERC734Extended.sol\";\nimport {INamed} from ByteArr for bytes32[];\n\n    string private constant _NAME = \"IdentityStorage\";\n    string private constant _VERSION = \"10.0.2\";\n\n    uint72 public lastIdentityId;\n\n    struct Identity {\n        mapping(bytes32 => Key) keys;\n        mapping(uint256 => bytes32[]) keysByPurpose;\n    }\n\n    // operationalKey => identityId\n    mapping(bytes32 => uint72) public identityIds;\n    // operationalKeysNumber = operationalKeys.length;\n\n        for (uint256 i; i < operationalKeysNumber; ) {\n            delete identityIds[operationalKeys[i]];\n            unchecked {\n                i++;\n            }\n        }\n\n        delete identities[identityId];\n    }\n\n    function addKey(\n        uint72 identityId,\n        bytes32 _key,\n        uint256 _purpose,\n        uint256 _type\n    ) external virtual override onlyContracts {\n        Identity storage identity = identities[identityId];\n        identity.keys[_key].purpose = _purpose;\n        identity.keys[_key].keyType = _type;\n        identity.keys[_key].key = _key;\n        identity.keysByPurpose[_purpose].push(_key);\n\n        emit KeyAdded(identityId, _key, _purpose, _type);\n    }\n\n    function removeKey(uint72 identityId, bytes32 _key) external virtual override onlyContracts {\n        IdentityStorage.Identity storage identity = identities[identityId];\n\n        uint256 index;\n        (index, ) = identity.keysByPurpose[identity.keys[_key].purpose].indexOf(_key);\n        identity.keysByPurpose[identity.keys[_key].purpose].removeByIndex(index);\n\n        emit KeyRemoved(identityId, identity.keys[_key].key, identity.keys[_key].purpose, identity.keys[_key].keyType);\n\n        delete identity.keys[_key];\n    }\n\n    function keyHasPurpose(\n        uint72 identityId,\n        bytes32 _key,\n        uint256 _purpose\n    ) external view virtual override returns (bool) {\n        return identities[identityId].keys[_key].purpose == _purpose;\n    }\n\n    function getKey(\n        uint72 identityId,\n        bytes32 _key\n    ) external view virtual override returns (uint256, uint256, bytes32) {\n        return (\n Apache-2.0\n\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\nimport {HubDependent} from \"../abstract/HubDependent.sol\";\nimport {INamed} from \"../interfaces/INamed.sol\";\nimport {IVersioned} from \"../interfaces/IVersioned.sol\";\nimport {ICustodian} from \"../interfaces/ICustodian.sol\";\n\ncontract ParametersStorage is INamed, IVersioned, HubDependent {\n    event ParameterChanged(string parameterName, uint256 parameterValue);\n    /// @notice Emitted when the protocol treasury recipient changes. The\n    ///         address is carried in its own event (rather than the\n    ///         `uint256`-valued `ParameterChanged`) so off-chain indexers get a\n    ///         typed `address` field.\n    event ProtocolTreasurySet(address indexed treasury);\n\n    error ZeroShardingTableSizeLimit();\n\n    string private constant _NAME = \"ParametersStorage\";\n    // protocol treasury fee (`protocolTreasuryFee`, `protocolTreasury`,\n    // `MAX_PROTOCOL_TREASURY_FEE`) skimmed from the staker-bound TRAC on\n    // every paid publish / update / lifetime-extension.\n    string private constant _VERSION = \"10.0.4\";\n\n    uint96 public minimumStake;\n    uint96 public maximumStake;\n\n    uint256 public stakeWithdrawalDelay;\n    uint256 public nodeAskUpdateDelay;\n    uint256 public operatorFeeUpdateDelay;\n\n    uint16 public opWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation;\n    uint16 public shardingTableSizeLimit;\n\n    uint256 public minimumRequiredSignatures;\n\n    uint256 public askUpperBoundFactor;\n    uint256 public askLowerBoundFactor;\n\n    uint16 public maxOperatorFee;\n\n    uint256 public v81ReleaseEpoch;\n    uint256 public publishingConvictionEpochs;\n\n    /// @notice Protocol treasury fee in basis points (out of 10_000) skimmed\n    ///         from the staker-bound TRAC on every paid publish / update /\n    ///         lifetime-extension. The fee is taken out of the amount that\n    ///         would otherwise flow to the staker reward pool \u2014 it does NOT\n    ///         change the price a publisher pays. Default 300 (3%).\n    ///\n    ///         The fee is a no-op while `protocolTreasury == address(0)`\n    ///         (the full amount flows to stakers), so it stays dormant until\n    ///         governance wires a treasury recipient via `setProtocolTreasury`.\n    uint16 public protocolTreasuryFee;\n\n    /// @notice Recipient of the protocol treasury fee. The zero address\n    ///         disables the fee entirely regardless of `protocolTreasuryFee`.\n    address public protocolTreasury;\n\n    /// @notice Minimum TRAC deposit required to register a Context Graph\n    ///         on-chain (`ContextGraphs.createContextGraph`). The deposit is\n    ///         held as the CG's prepaid publishing escrow \u2014 spendable by the\n    ///         CG owner on publish/update/extend into that CG \u2014 and is never\n    ///         cash-refundable (residue sweeps to the staker reward pool on\n    ///         deactivation). Anti-spam for the unbounded-CG-creation DoS\n    ///         (OT-RFC-53). Setting it to 0 disables the deposit (dormant).\n    uint96 public contextGraphRegistrationDeposit;\n\n    /// @notice Hard upper bound on `protocolTreasuryFee` (10%). Bounds\n    ///         governance so the fee can never be set to an extractive level\n    ///         that would starve the staker reward pool.\n    uint16 public constant MAX_PROTOCOL_TREASURY_FEE = 1_000;\n\n    /// @notice Hard upper bound on `publishingConvictionEpochs`.\n    ///\n    /// `DKGPublishingConvictionNFT._settleElapsed` / `_finalSweep` loop\n    /// `lockDurationEpochs` times in the worst case (dormant account\n    /// settled at expiry). Each iteration costs ~30\u201350k gas\n    /// (`windowSpent` SLOAD + one or two `epochStorage.addTokensToEpochRange`\n    /// writes + a `WindowSettled` event), so an unbounded\n    /// `publishingConvictionEpochs` (the previous cap was `uint16.max`)\n    /// would let governance brick PCAs by setting the parameter past\n    /// the block-gas budget. 60 chain epochs \u2248 5 years at a 1-month\n    /// epoch length and worst-cases at ~3M gas \u2014 comfortably below\n    /// the block limit while leaving room for the surrounding\n    /// `publish` / `topUp` / NFT-transfer work.\n    uint256 public constant MAX_PUBLISHING_CONVICTION_EPOCHS = 60;\n\n    // @dev Only transactions by HubController owner or one of the owners of the MultiSig Wallet\n    modifier onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner() {\n        _checkOwnerOrMultiSigOwner();\n        _;\n    }\n\n    constructor(address hubAddress, uint256 _v81ReleaseEpoch) HubDependent(hubAddress) {\n        minimumStake = 50_000 ether;\n        maximumStake = 10_000_000 ether;\n\n        stakeWithdrawalDelay = 28 days;\n        nodeAskUpdateDelay = 1 days;\n        operatorFeeUpdateDelay = 28 days;\n\n        opWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation = 50;\n        shardingTableSizeLimit = 500;\n\n        minimumRequiredSignatures = 3;\n\n        askUpperBoundFactor = 1467000000000000000;\n        askLowerBoundFactor = 533000000000000000;\n\n        maxOperatorFee = 10_000;\n\n        // Epoch when v8.1 was released on mainnet/testnet\n        // Change if you ever redeploy delegatorsInfo contract on either network\n        v81ReleaseEpoch = _v81ReleaseEpoch;\n        publishingConvictionEpochs = 12;\n\n        // 3% default. Dormant until `protocolTreasury` is set (defaults to\n        // the zero address), so a fresh deploy behaves exactly as before\n        // until governance opts in.\n        protocolTreasuryFee = 300;\n\n        // OT-RFC-53: constructor leaves the registration deposit at 0; the\n        // standard deploy sets the live value (100 TRAC) via a post-deploy\n        // script that calls `setContextGraphRegistrationDeposit`. This protects\n        // production automatically (no manual step, no silent-off) while keeping\n        // test fixtures \u2014 which don't run that script \u2014 unaffected. Governance\n        // can retune or disable it anytime.\n    }\n\n    function name() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _NAME;\n    }\n\n    function version() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _VERSION;\n    }\n\n    function setAskUpperBoundFactor(uint256 _askUpperBoundFactor) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        askUpperBoundFactor = _askUpperBoundFactor;\n    }\n\n    function setAskLowerBoundFactor(uint256 _askLowerBoundFactor) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        askLowerBoundFactor = _askLowerBoundFactor;\n    }\n\n    function setMinimumRequiredSignatures(uint256 _minimumRequiredSignatures) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        minimumRequiredSignatures = _minimumRequiredSignatures;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"minimumRequiredSignatures\", _minimumRequiredSignatures);\n    }\n\n    function setMinimumStake(uint96 newMinimumStake) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        minimumStake = newMinimumStake;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"minimumStake\", newMinimumStake);\n    }\n\n    function setMaximumStake(uint96 newMaximumStake) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        maximumStake = newMaximumStake;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"maximumStake\", newMaximumStake);\n    }\n\n    function setStakeWithdrawalDelay(uint256 newStakeWithdrawalDelay) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        stakeWithdrawalDelay = newStakeWithdrawalDelay;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"stakeWithdrawalDelay\", newStakeWithdrawalDelay);\n    }\n\n    function setNodeAskUpdateDelay(uint256 newNodeAskUpdateDelay) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        nodeAskUpdateDelay = newNodeAskUpdateDelay;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"nodeAskUpdateDelay\", newNodeAskUpdateDelay);\n    }\n\n    function setOperatorFeeUpdateDelay(uint256 newOperatorFeeUpdateDelay) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        operatorFeeUpdateDelay = newOperatorFeeUpdateDelay;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"operatorFeeUpdateDelay\", newOperatorFeeUpdateDelay);\n    }\n\n    function setOpWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation(\n        uint16 opWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation_\n    ) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        opWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation = opWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation_;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"opWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation\", opWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation);\n    }\n\n    function setShardingTableSizeLimit(uint16 shardingTableSizeLimit_) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        // Reject 0: ShardingTable._insertNode now enforces this cap\n        // (`nodesCount >= limit` reverts ShardingTableIsFull), so a 0 limit would\n        // freeze ALL node admission (even the first insert), bricking staking. 0\n        // is never a meaningful table size \u2014 reject it rather than let it act as\n        // an implicit pause switch.\n        if (shardingTableSizeLimit_ == 0) revert ZeroShardingTableSizeLimit();\n        shardingTableSizeLimit = shardingTableSizeLimit_;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"shardingTableSizeLimit\", shardingTableSizeLimit);\n    }\n\n    function setMaxOperatorFee(uint16 maxOperatorFee_) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        maxOperatorFee = maxOperatorFee_;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"maxOperatorFee\", maxOperatorFee);\n    }\n\n    function setV81ReleaseEpoch(uint256 _v81ReleaseEpoch) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        v81ReleaseEpoch = _v81ReleaseEpoch;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"v81ReleaseEpoch\", _v81ReleaseEpoch);\n    }\n\n    function setPublishingConvictionEpochs(\n        uint256 _publishingConvictionEpochs\n    ) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        require(_publishingConvictionEpochs > 0, \"publishingConvictionEpochs must be > 0\");\n        // See `MAX_PUBLISHING_CONVICTION_EPOCHS` for the gas-budget\n        // rationale. The previous `<= type(uint16).max` bound permitted\n        // values that would gas-out PCA settlement.\n        require(\n            _publishingConvictionEpochs <= MAX_PUBLISHING_CONVICTION_EPOCHS,\n            \"publishingConvictionEpochs too large\"\n        );\n        publishingConvictionEpochs = _publishingConvictionEpochs;\n\n        emit returns (string memory) {\n        return _NAME;\n    }\n\n    function version() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _VERSION;\n    }\n\n    function incrementNodesCount() external onlyContracts {\n        nodesCount++;\n\n        emit NodesCountIncremented(nodesCount);\n    }\n\n    function decrementNodesCount() external onlyContracts {\n        nodesCount--;\n\n        emit NodesCountDecremented(nodesCount);\n    }\n\n    function createNodeObject(\n        uint256 hashRingPosition,\n        bytes calldata nodeId,\n        uint72 identityId,\n        uint72 index\n    ) external onlyContracts {\n        nodes[identityId] = ShardingTableLib.Node({\n            hashRingPosition: hashRingPosition,\n            index: index,\n            nodeId: nodeId,\n            identityId: identityId\n        });\n\n        emit NodeObjectCreated(identityId, nodeId, hashRingPosition, index);\n    }\n\n    function getNode(uint72 identityId) external view returns (ShardingTableLib.Node memory) {\n        return nodes[identityId];\n    }\n\n    function deleteNodeObject(uint72 identityId) external onlyContracts {\n        delete nodes[identityId];\n\n        emit NodeObjectDeleted(identityId);\n    }\n\n    function nodeExists(uint72 identityId) external view returns (bool) {\n        return nodes[identityId].identityId != 0;\n    }\n\n    function head() external view returns (uint72) {\n        return indexToIdentityId[0];\n    }\n\n    function getHashRingPosition(uint72 identityId) external view returns (uint256) {\n        return nodes[identityId].hashRingPosition;\n    }\n\n    function incrementNodeIndex(uint72 identityId) external onlyContracts {\n        nodes[identityId].index += 1;\n\n        emit NodeIndexIncremented(identityId, nodes[identityId].index);\n    }\n\n    function decrementNodeIndex(uint72 identityId) external onlyContracts {\n        nodes[identityId].index -= 1;\n\n        emit NodeIndexDecremented(identityId, nodes[identityId].index);\n    }\n\n    function setIdentityId(uint72 index, uint72 identityId) external onlyContracts {\n        indexToIdentityId[index] = identityId;\n\n        emit IdentityIdIndexSet(identityId, index);\n    }\n\n    function getNodeByIndex(uint72 index) external view returns (ShardingTableLib.Node memory) {\n        return nodes[indexToIdentityId[index]];\n    }\n\n    function getNeighborhoodBoundaryByIndexes(\n        uint72 leftEdgeIndex,\n        uint72 closestNodeIndex,\n        uint72 rightEdgeIndex\n    ) external view returns (ShardingTableLib.Node memory, ShardingTableLib.Node memory, ShardingTableLib.Node memory) {\n        return (\n            nodes[indexToIdentityId[leftEdgeIndex]],\n            nodes[indexToIdentityId[closestNodeIndex]],\n            nodes[indexToIdentityId[rightEdgeIndex]]\n        );\n    }\n\n    function getAdjacentIdentityIdsByIndex(uint72 index) external view returns (uint72, uint72) {\n        if (index == 0) {\n            return (ShardingTableLib.NULL, nodes[indexToIdentityId[index + 1]].identityId);\n        }\n\n        return (nodes[indexToIdentityId[index - 1]].identityId, nodes[indexToIdentityId[index + 1]].identityId);\n    }\n\n    function getHashRingPositionByIndex(uint72 index) external view returns (uint256) {\n        return nodes[indexToIdentityId[index]].hashRingPosition;\n    }\n\n    function nodeExistsByIndex(uint72 index) external view returns (bool) {\n        return nodes[indexToIdentityId[index]].identityId != 0;\n    }\n\n    function getMultipleNodes(\n        uint72 firstIdentityId,\n        uint16 nodesNumber\n    ) external view returns (ShardingTableLib.Node[] memory) {\n        ShardingTableLib.Node[] memory nodesPage = new ShardingTableLib.Node[](nodesNumber);\n\n        ShardingTableLib.Node memory currentNode = nodes[firstIdentityId];\n        for (uint256 i; i < nodesNumber; ) {\n            nodesPage[i] = currentNode;\n            currentNode = nodes[indexToIdentityId[currentNode.index + 1]];\n            unchecked {\n                i++;\n            }\n        }\n\n        return nodesPage;\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x029cd19f31b1fd4656b53c9ab62e63549b6a52429385f7630c027a6395582c07","license":"Apache-2.0"},"solady/src/utils/ECDSA.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma
